job.title: Weekend Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician/Austin, Texas
job.description:
Weekend shift Manufacturing Technicians needed for an 18 month contract to hire role located in Austin, Texas.


Hours/Days needed:  Friday-Monday 5PM-4AM- 18 % shift differential 


Base pay rate $22 to $25 per hour



What you need to bring to the table:

  • 2 to 3 years of electro mechanical assembly and testing of finished products.
  • Ability to read blueprints and electrical schematics
  • Trouble shoot and repair assemblies
  • Excellent computer skills
  • Vacuum experience
  • Semi-conductor and SAP experience is a plus

What You Will Be Doing

  • Utilizing routine work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts and wire lists, written and/or verbal instructions to build, repair and/or test electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components.
  • Performs electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repair. Identifies and corrects errors.
  • Utilizes test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components.
  • Enters data on computer terminal, such as progress, work expense and labor details. May perform computer programming, repair or software installs.
  • Details finished work.
  • Receives parts and performs audits to ensure all necessary parts are available to perform built, test and repair. Inspects parts for defects.
  • Troubleshoots and improves processes

job.title: Senior FX Operations Analyst
job.description:
Job Title:Senior FX Operations Analyst
Location:Pittsburg, PA
Type: Full Time
Salary- $95000/yr

Our client which a leading bank is seeking a detail-oriented Senior FX Operations Analyst to support fast-paced, time-sensitive foreign exchange transactions and client processing activities. This role requires strong knowledge of FX, derivatives, or cash processing, along with the ability to resolve complex operational issues, analyze data, and improve transaction-processing systems.

  • Provides complex analytics and reporting services, working to improve and automate Client Processing systems. 
  • Manages moderate to complex external client issues. 
  • Directly advises other organizational units/teams to ensure timely delivery of service, or resolution of issue.
  • Meets with organizational units/teams to ensure problems and issues are being addressed appropriately and that they are resolved in a timely manner.
  • Participates in product development, product enhancement, and system testing to ensure that products continue to accurately and efficiently process high value transactions. 
  • Solves complex problems based on an understanding and knowledge of the intricacies of the system. 
  • Integrates in-depth area knowledge with a solid understanding of industry standards and practices to provide solutions to internal and external clients. 
  • Provides support to lower level client processing roles.
  • May be responsible for allocating and checking work of other team members. 
  • May be responsible for specific supervisory review, training and approval actions.
  • Contributes to the achievement of related teams objectives
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:

  • Bachelors degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required.
  • 5-7 years of total work experience is preferred. 
  • Experience in Foreign Exchange, Derivatives, or Cash processing is highly preferred.

job.title: Trading & Onboarding Consultant
job.description:
Trading & Onboarding Consultant
Fort Mill, SC; Tempe, AZ; San Diego, CA (Hybrid)
6+ month contract
 
Job Overview:
The role will assist with advisor onboarding, platform training, conversion-data review, inbound support, post-conversion issue resolution, and updates to advisor guides and training materials. Successful candidates will be comfortable learning detailed trading workflows, communicating with financial professionals, researching issues, and managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Provide support related to model management, model assignments, restrictions, equivalents, portfolio rebalancing, and block trading workflows.
  • Assist with platform training through webinars, demonstrations, office hours, scheduled appointments, and inbound calls.
  • Help users understand documented differences between systems and workflows.
  • Review available conversion information to identify missing models, assignments, restrictions, equivalents, or other setup issues.
  • Research and document advisor, account, model, and system-related questions.
  • Escalate complex discrepancies or potentially broader conversion issues to the appropriate business or technology partner.
  • Help update job aids, FAQs, training materials, and guides explaining key differences between workflows.
  • Track advisor questions, issue ownership, status, and follow-up through resolution.
  • Support system testing, defect tracking, and post-conversion stabilization activities.
  • Maintain working knowledge of investment products, trading systems, model-based practices, and rebalancing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with Trading, Technology, Product, Operations, Training, and conversion partners.
  • Support additional trading and operational priorities as conversion demand changes.
  • Additional responsibilities may be assigned as needed.
 
Requirements:
  • 2+ years of financial services or trading operations
  • 2+ years of experience in a client-service, support, operations, or call-center environment Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to explain technical or operational information clearly
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through
  • Ability to research information across multiple systems or data sources
  • Ability to learn new platforms and workflows quickly
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities with limited direction
  • Sound judgment when identifying and escalating issues
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills
  • Advisor service and relationship support
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Clear communication
  • Process discipline and follow-through
  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn
  • Issue ownership and escalation
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • FINRA Series 7 strongly preferred
  • Financial-services, trading, or investment-operations experience
  • Knowledge of mutual funds, equities, ETFs, or options
  • Experience with model-based portfolio management or rebalancing
  • Experience supporting models, restrictions, equivalents, or trading instructions
  • Experience providing advisor or client support by phone
  • Experience supporting onboarding, training, conversions, acquisitions, or technology implementations
  • Experience with data review, reconciliation, QA/UAT testing, or issue tracking
  • Experience with ClientWorks Rebalancer, Advisor360, BETA, Model Hub, or similar trading and portfolio-management platforms

job.title: Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for a Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager to join our Retail client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of hands-on Shopify Plus experience with a strong technical background in Shopify development, systems integrations, and high-volume e-commerce environments. This individual should live within a commutable distance to Northridge, CA and be comfortable working onsite 5 days per week.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Shopify E-Commerce Manager
Compensation: $120,000–$160,000/year
Type: Full-Time
Industry: Retail

Overview We are seeking a hands-on Shopify E-Commerce & Integrations Manager to support the development, integration, optimization, and ongoing performance of a high-volume Shopify Plus environment.

This role will work across e-commerce, technology, and operations, with responsibility for Shopify development, platform integrations, troubleshooting, and supporting frequent product launches. The ideal candidate combines strong Shopify technical expertise with the ability to work across multiple business systems and thrive in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage, maintain, and enhance Shopify Plus storefront functionality
  • Develop and maintain custom Shopify functionality, including Shopify Functions
  • Perform hands-on development using Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across Shopify themes, apps, integrations, checkout functionality, and connected systems
  • Support integrations between Shopify and enterprise platforms including ERP, middleware/iPaaS, WMS, 3PL, and international commerce solutions
  • Assist with the implementation, maintenance, and optimization of system integrations and data flows
  • Support new vendor and technology integrations within the e-commerce ecosystem
  • Monitor and improve site performance, stability, and overall functionality
  • Support frequent product launches, promotions, and high-volume e-commerce events
  • Partner cross-functionally with marketing, design, operations, and technical stakeholders
  • Document integrations, technical processes, fixes, and platform improvements
  • Evaluate Shopify platform updates and new functionality that may benefit the business
  • Support international e-commerce operations and third-party logistics integrations
Technical Focus Areas
  • Shopify Plus development and administration
  • Shopify Functions
  • Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Shopify apps and custom integrations
  • ERP and order-management integrations
  • Middleware / iPaaS platforms such as Celigo or similar
  • NetSuite or comparable ERP platforms
  • WMS and fulfillment system integrations
  • 3PL integrations
  • International commerce platforms such as Global-e or similar
  • Website performance and platform stability
  • API and systems troubleshooting
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of relevant Shopify / Shopify Plus experience
  • Strong hands-on experience developing and supporting Shopify Plus environments
  • Experience working with Shopify Functions
  • Strong working knowledge of Shopify Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Experience integrating Shopify with ERP, WMS, middleware, 3PL, or other enterprise systems
  • Experience with NetSuite, Celigo, or comparable platforms strongly preferred
  • WMS integration experience strongly preferred
  • Experience supporting high-volume DTC or retail e-commerce environments
  • Experience supporting frequent product drops, launches, and rapidly changing business priorities
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across interconnected systems
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of technical issues from identification through resolution
  • Strong cross-functional communication skills
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities can shift quickly
  • Bachelor’s degree strongly preferred
  • Ability to work onsite in Northridge, CA, 5 days per week
Nice to Have
  • Experience in fashion, apparel, consumer retail, or another high-volume DTC environment
  • Experience with international e-commerce and cross-border commerce platforms
  • Experience with WMS implementations or integrations
  • Experience onboarding and integrating new technology vendors

job.title: Production Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Production Maintenance Technician for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

Job Functions:
  • Troubleshoot electrical, hydraulics, pneumatics and mechanical system in an industrial environment.
  • Determines best course of action to make repairs. Sets and/or adjusts priorities to ensure safety and reliability of production equipment and support systems.
  • Test equipment after repairs and leave equipment and area in a clean, safe condition.
  • Perform functionality and alignment checks; make adjustments, modifications, and replacements as directed.
  • Work from schematics, engineering drawings, and written or verbal instructions.
  • Operate related equipment, conduct tests and report data in prescribed format. 
  • Use predetermined methods, sequences, and setups to inspect or test specific equipment or product; making modifications and adjustments as necessary.
  • Ensure a safe and quality working environment through training, awareness, and compliance to safety guidelines and SOP’s.
  • Must maintain operational compliance with US and international regulatory agencies and guidelines (i.e. FDA, EU,HC, TGA, PIC/S, ISO, USP, NRC, cGMP, etc.).
Experience and Education Requirements:
  • Two-year degree in Electrical Automation, Industrial Maintenance, Electronics, Electrical systems, or related field required, or equivalent training in Armed Forces training schools. 
  • One or more years of relevant work experience in maintaining, troubleshooting, and repairing industrial equipment and/or automation systems, preferably in pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with and without schematics.
  • Use of voltmeter and other general-purpose test equipment
  • AC/DC electrical power systems / supplies (Preferred)
  • Industrial manufacturing equipment, automated systems (Preferred)
  • Automation electronics, electrical controls / PLCs.
  • Proximity and optical sensors, signal wiring / connectivity.
  • AC/DC motors
  • Pneumatics, hydraulics and associated controls.
  • Vacuum pumps / systems 
  • Electro-mechanical systems
  • Equipment calibration experience.
  • Building Management Systems 
  • Reverse engineering 
  • Root Cause Analysis experience.
  • Basic soldering experience.
#IND-SPG

job.title: Fiber Field Technician
job.description:
Fiber Field Technician

Join a dynamic team and play a vital role in the installation, maintenance, and monitoring of cutting-edge fiber optic networks in the IL Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Peru and Lasalle areas. As a Fiber Field Technician, you will be the frontline hero ensuring seamless connectivity, supporting both wholesale and enterprise customers. This role offers competitive pay, shift premiums, on-call pay, company vehicle, and the opportunity to make a tangible impact in the telecommunications industry.

Required Skills:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in a telecommunications environment or equivalent technical training
  • Expertise in DS3/DS1, SONET/DWDM installation and maintenance
  • Strong understanding of IP/MPLS fundamentals
  • Proficiency with test equipment such as OTDR, OSA, DS1/3, and Ethernet testing tools
  • Ability to analyze, monitor, and resolve network issues promptly
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record
  • Self-motivated with strong decision-making skills
  • Excellent PC skills and strong oral and written communication
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Cisco or Alcatel Lucent IP certifications
  • Experience with VOIP switching and maintenance
  • Fiber optics splicing and maintenance knowledge
  • SS7/STP support experience
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • College or technical degree in related field or equivalent experience
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to work day, evening, night shifts, overtime, call-ins, weekends, and holidays as needed
  • Ability to work in demanding environments and multi-task effectively
Ready to be a key contributor in a fast-paced telecommunications setting? If you’re driven, skilled, and eager to advance your career, we want to hear from you—apply today and help us keep the world connected!


Preferred Locations:  Rockford, Dekalb, Rochelle, Dixon area

job.title: Optical Engineering Technician (DAY SHIFT)
job.description:
Optical Engineering Technician (DAY SHIFT) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Hillsboro, OR.
  • Pay Rate: $28-33/hr
  • ONSITE in Hillsboro
  • DAY SHIFT: 8am-5pm Mon-Fri
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Looking for a motivated person passionate about science and technology to work on current and future projects that continue to push the boundaries of the next generation of digital lithography.
  • Work will require coordinating with key stakeholders in Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Operations to meet tight timelines, precisely, accurately, and at scale, on a daily basis for complex engineering projects that require assembling, building, testing, recording of measurements.
  • Primary task will be to support on-going manufacturing of a key sub-assembly through the test, measurement, integration and further testing.
  • Performs routine to moderately complex optical, opto-mechanical, mechanical, liquid cooling systems, functions and activities such as test, checkout, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of sub-assemblies, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.
  • Create, troubleshoot, and enhance new and existing liquid cooling circuits, fittings, routings, manifolds, flow meters, chillers, heat exchangers, and piping systems.
  • Safely operate class 1 through class 4 lasers in a clean room environment.
  • May test and troubleshoot system level and component level problems in optical, electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems.
  • Works from procedures, schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform non-routine and routine activities.
  • Compiles logbooks and follows existing test procedures with and contributes to the augmentation of existing test procedures utilizing good writing skills.
  • Observes all safety standards. Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment. Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices.

Required:
  • Recent graduates with relevant technical backgrounds who are interested in a learning-focused environment with strong mentorship opportunities, OR experience with optics handling, cleaning, and measurement experience.
  • A focus on general interferometry experience is preferred.
  • Has developed analytical skills and application of scientific methods to perform a variety of activities
  • Optical assembly and handling preferred.
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest semiconductor manufacturing companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: IT Writer & Communications Specialist
job.description:
IT WRITER & COMMUNICATIONS SPECIALIST - ONSITE IN BOSTON 

- 3 month temp position (potential to extend)
- onsite in Boston 
- $50/hr on W2 

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!!

Job Summary
Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking a dynamic IT Writer and Communications Specialist to drive Northeastern's digital transformation forward. In this pivotal role, you'll be the strategic communications leader who transforms complex technology changes into compelling narratives that inspire and empower our university community. You'll craft communication strategies that don't just inform—they guide, educate, and motivate thousands of faculty, staff, and students through major system implementations and process innovations, both big and small.

As our communications bridge between technical teams and end users, you'll translate intricate technical concepts into powerful, accessible messaging that resonates across diverse audiences. You'll collaborate at the highest levels with IT project teams, university leadership, and key business stakeholders to anticipate challenges, shape perceptions, and orchestrate communication campaigns that ensure successful technology adoption and organizational change.

Key Responsibilities Change Communication and Stakeholder Engagement (40%)

  • Develop comprehensive communication plans for IT projects that guide stakeholders through system changes, process updates, and technology implementations
  • Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, leadership, and business stakeholders to understand project impacts on different user groups
  • Create targeted messaging that explains "what's changing," "why it's changing," "how it affects you," and "what you need to do" for various stakeholder segments
  • Design and execute multi-channel communication campaigns to support organizational change initiatives
Content Development and Technical Translation (35%)

  • Write and edit compelling, accessible content for web, email, digital signage, print, user interfaces, and other communication channels
  • Translate technical concepts, system requirements, and process changes into language appropriate for diverse audiences (faculty, staff, students, administrators)
  • Develop training materials, quick reference guides, FAQs, and other resources that help users adapt to new systems and processes
  • Create informational and educational content that drives user engagement and adoption of new technologies
Cross-Functional Collaboration and Project Support (20%)

  • Partner with IT project teams to understand technical requirements, timelines, and user impacts throughout project lifecycles
  • Participate in project planning meetings to provide communications expertise and identify potential user concerns early
  • Collaborate with training teams, help desk staff, and other support functions to ensure consistent messaging across all user touchpoints
  • Work with campus-wide partners to coordinate communications and minimize change fatigue
Strategic Communication and Continuous Improvement (5%)

  • Contribute to overall IT communications strategy and help identify opportunities to improve change communication processes
  • Monitor communication effectiveness through user feedback, adoption metrics, and other data sources
  • Stay current on change management best practices and emerging communication technologies
  • Counsel leadership on communication strategies for complex or sensitive technology changes
Required Qualifications
  • Substantial experience in marketing, communications, or related field, preferably in higher education, technology, or organizational change environments
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to adapt messaging for different audiences
  • Strong technical aptitude with ability to quickly understand complex systems, processes, and technical concepts
  • Project collaboration experience with demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including technical staff, project managers, and various stakeholders
  • Change communication experience or strong interest in helping organizations and individuals navigate transitions
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills including collaborative features in Word, SharePoint, Excel, Teams, and Outlook
  • Self-directed work style with strong project management abilities and attention to detail
  • Adaptability in fast-paced, changing environments with shifting priorities
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ITIL processes, change management frameworks, or IT service management
  • Proficiency with content management systems (WordPress, Contentful, or similar) and email marketing platforms
  • Familiarity with user experience (UX) principles and user-centered design thinking
  • Experience creating multimedia content (graphics, video, interactive materials)
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards and inclusive design practices
  • Data analysis skills for measuring communication effectiveness and user engagement
  • Experience in complex organizational environments or higher education settings
AI and Technology Fluency
  • Curiosity and openness to exploring AI-powered tools for content creation, editing, optimization, and distribution
  • Interest in leveraging technology to enhance communication processes and user experiences
  • Willingness to experiment with emerging communication technologies and platforms
  • Understanding that AI literacy is increasingly important in modern communications roles
Personal Qualities
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with ability to anticipate user concerns and communication challenges
  • Empathetic approach to understanding how change impacts different user groups
  • Collaborative leadership style with ability to influence without direct authority
  • Resilience and flexibility when projects shift or timelines change
  • Commitment to continuous learning and professional development
  • Customer service orientation with focus on user success
Working Environment This is a hybrid role requiring a minimum of three days per week in the office to facilitate collaboration with project teams, stakeholders, and IT colleagues. On-campus presence is essential for building relationships, understanding user needs firsthand, and contributing to our collaborative culture

job.title: Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a temp to permanent Materials Coordinator in Carlsbad, CA.  You will support our biopharmaceutical customer with receiving, storing, staging, and distributing raw materials, components, and finished goods in accordance with cGMP (Current Good Manufacturing Practices), SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), and safety regulations. The role supports production schedules and ensures inventory accuracy while maintaining a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment.

Location:  Carlsbad, CA 
Shift:   M-F 8-4:30pm 
Pay: $25-28/hr DOE 
Duration: Contract to perm 

Responsibilities
  • Support and work within the Code of Federal Regulations Title 21, Quality Management System, Standard Operation Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions, comply with all documentation needs, and practices.  
  • Perform timely and accurate data entry in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) for material transactions.
  • Perform receipt of incoming materials. Check materials received against specifications, vendor shipping documents and purchase orders for accuracy.
  • Accurately maintain all receiving documentation to comply with internal procedures and or SOPs.
  • Follow best practices related to the systems and process that support material inventory, purchasing, and material control.  Provide recommendations and assist with implementation of improvements.
  • Work with Purchasing and  Accounts Payable to  resolve any supplier invoice issues or discrepancies.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance and Quality Control personnel, ensuring timely testing and release of materials.
  • Conduct cycle counts and wall-to-wall counts as needed.
  • Pick and stage materials for manufacturing and laboratory support.
  • Support accurate client billing and raw material traceability through timely processing of return to stock items.
  • Inspect stock for damage/product integrity. Maintain organization of work areas through 6S (sort, set, standardize, shine, sustain, safety).
  • Interact with Manufacturing and laboratory departments to reconcile inventory variances.
  • Perform packaging and shipping of materials and samples to customers and/or testing facilities. Monitor shipments and update of any potential delays.
  • Manage effective relationships with suppliers as well as internal and external clients.
  • Successfully adapt to changing priorities in a high operating tempo.

Qualifications
  • Minimum high school diploma, or equivalent
  • Preferred minimum two (2) years’ experience in materials management. Preferred minimum one (1) year experience working in Pharmaceutical environment.
  • Ability to read, understand, and carry out Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), Work Instructions and other Quality Process Documentation in English.
  • Knowledge of standard concepts, practices and procedures within the manufacturing and biologic environment preferred.
  • Microsoft Office experience

job.description:

Saturday and Sunday, 12-hour shifts.
6am-6pm.

Scope:

• Handle the following – Receive, unpack, check & verify merchandise/product ensuring accuracy.

• SW tools like SAP, Reynolds and Reynolds, Lightspeed, etc..

job.title: VP - Business Operations & Strategy
job.description:
VP - Business Operations & Strategy

Are you a visionary leader with a passion for transforming complex business operations and driving strategic growth? Join our client as the Vice President of Business Operations & Strategy and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our dynamic, rapidly scaling vacation rental platform. You will lead enterprise transformation initiatives, oversee high-impact M&A integrations, and deliver measurable results that fuel our mission to build the world’s best vacation rental company.

About the Role
As a key member of our executive team you will spearhead strategic initiatives across markets, brands, and functions. Your expertise will enable seamless integrations, operational improvements, and innovative solutions, all while collaborating with senior stakeholders to unlock value and accelerate growth. This is your chance to influence a company backed by seasoned investors and led by leaders with deep roots in hospitality, travel, and technology.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred
  • 5-8+ years in management consulting, strategy & transformation, or high-intensity business environments
  • Proven ability to structure complex problems, influence senior stakeholders, and lead initiatives end-to-end
  • Experience with M&A integration, multi-unit operations, or platform environments is advantageous
  • Exceptional analytical skills, with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capabilities
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous settings
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools for strategic work is a plus
Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Prior exposure to hospitality, travel, or private equity sectors
  • Fluency in deploying innovative operating models and process improvements
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with disciplined execution
Preferred Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; an MBA or similar qualification is highly preferred
  • Minimum of 5 years in strategy, management consulting, or operational leadership roles
  • Experience driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives
Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to travel approximately 25-35% to support integration and strategic initiatives
  • Passion for building and scaling innovative platforms with high ownership and impact mindset
If you’re ready to lead transformative change at an exciting, fast-growing company and want to make a meaningful impact in the travel and hospitality industry, we invite you to apply now. Embark on a career journey that combines strategic vision with operational excellence—your next big opportunity awaits!

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer -LI-ion Battery Management
job.description:
Electrical Design Engineer - LI-ion Battery Management

Are you passionate about advancing battery technology and driving innovation in aerospace applications? Join our dynamic team as an Electrical Design Engineer specializing in Lithium-ion Battery Management Systems (BMS). In this critical role, you'll be at the forefront of designing cutting-edge digital control, analog, and mixed-signal solutions for aviation batteries, impacting the future of sustainable flight and aerospace safety.

Role Overview:
As an Electrical Design Engineer, you will develop and refine BMS hardware from concept through certification, working on everything from voltage sensing to cell balancing and system integration. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring complex hardware and embedded software solutions to life, ensuring performance, reliability, and compliance in a high-stakes environment. Your expertise will contribute directly to safer, more efficient aerospace energy storage solutions.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Minimum of 5 years experience designing lithium-ion battery management systems (BMS)
  • Proven experience in analog and mixed-signal circuit design and PCB schematic creation
  • Strong knowledge of cell sensing, protection, isolation, and balancing circuits for lithium batteries
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite
  • Exceptional attention to detail, organization, and results-driven focus
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to troubleshoot and validate hardware prototypes effectively
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience designing to environmental and EMI standards such as RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461, or RTCA DO-311
  • Familiarity with LiFePO4 chemistry and battery safety standards
  • Knowledge of DFM & DFT principles
  • Experience supporting embedded microcontroller software and certification processes
Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (Master's preferred)
  • 5+ years designing BMS for aviation or similar high-reliability industries
  • Demonstrated success in product lifecycle management, from initial design to field application
Other Requirements:

  • On-site work in Wichita, KS
  • Willingness to work in a collaborative environment involving hardware, software, and mechanical teams
  • Good communication skills essential for team coordination
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any necessary security or certification clearances
Take your career to the next level by innovating in the rapidly evolving field of aviation battery technology. Apply now to become a vital part of our pioneering team—your expertise will shape the future of electric flight!

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer Semiconductor - $31-34/hr + insurance Austin Texas Insurance Benefits offered
job.description:
Manufacturing Engineer 
$31-34
Insurance benfits offered
Semiconductor Company in Austin
18 month contact
Monday thru Friday and overtime as required
7 am to 4 pm 
8 am to 5pm

Develops, implements, and maintains methods, operation sequence and processes in the fabrication of parts, components, sub-assemblies and final assemblies. 
Interfaces with other engineering functions to coordinate the release of product improvements and/or new products.  Launches, releases, approves and implements or issues engineering change requests as required to support design engineering and Operations with new and existing products. 
Estimates manufacturing costs, determines time standards and makes recommendations for tooling and process requirements.  Uses DFx principles to reduce manufacturing and/or product costs, and improve delivered product quality. 
Develops and uses test procedures, including assisting with the definition of test specifications with design / software engineering.  May work with test engineering on the design and development of text fixtures.  May assist in the coordination of test fixture sourcing activities. 
Gathers operational and test data and evaluates results; may takes corrective/continuous improvement actions. 
Evaluates work methods, procedures and policies.  Participates in the development and maintenance of new and existing business processes; updates as necessary to ensure current practices are documented. 
Determines root cause and corrective action analysis for issues that arise during assembly and/or test of systems; provides failure analysis report as required. 
Performs Process Failure Mode, Effects and Criticality Analysis when working with New Product Development. 
  
Other Requirements: This position may require standing for extended periods of time, walking, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, lifting, the ability to distinguish between colors, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. 
Additionally, because this position also may involve working in a clean room, the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields may be required. 
  
Functional Knowledge 
  • Demonstrates expanded conceptual knowledge in own discipline and broadens capabilities 
  Business Expertise 
  • Understands key business drivers; uses this understanding to accomplish own work 
  Leadership 
  • No supervisory responsibilities but provides informal guidance to new team members 
  Problem Solving 
  • Solves problems in straightforward situations; analyzes possible solutions using technical experience and judgment and precedents  
  Impact 
  • Impacts quality of own work and the work of others on the team; works within guidelines and policies 
  Interpersonal Skills 
  • Explains complex information to others in straightforward situations 
 Key Attributes:  
  • Location:   Austin  
 
Shift : Day Shift (7 am – 4pm with Potential for OT) Monday-Friday

job.title: Sr. Program Manager II
job.description:
This position is W2 only. No C-C Accepted

Job Title: Senior Program Manager
3 days onsite - Charlotte North Carolina 6-12 months contract to hire


Job Description
The Senior Program Manager is responsible for planning, executing, and overseeing multiple projects aligned to a shared business objective. This role provides leadership across project teams, manages dependencies and risks, oversees budgets and resources, coordinates testing efforts, and ensures stakeholders and leadership have timely visibility into program status.

Program and Project Management
Direct and manage multiple project efforts from initiation through completion.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, and critical paths.
Identify and resolve project issues, risks, conflicts, and resource constraints.
Proactively manage changes in project scope and develop appropriate mitigation and contingency plans.
Coordinate activities across business, technology, and project teams to ensure alignment with program objectives.
Track project budgets, resource allocations, and expenditures to support accurate forecasting and reporting.

Communication and Stakeholder Management
Establish the frequency, format, and content of project and program status reporting.
Communicate project expectations, priorities, risks, dependencies, and deliverables clearly to team members and stakeholders.
Analyze project results, identify problem areas, and drive resolution with appropriate teams.
Facilitate communication across business and technology stakeholders to maintain alignment and accountability.

Documentation and Planning
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, communications, status reports, proposals, budgets, estimates, and supporting documentation.
Document project dependencies, milestones, risks, issues, decisions, and action items.
Ensure project documentation remains accurate and current throughout the project lifecycle.

Management Reporting
Prepare and deliver timely program and project status reporting to management and key stakeholders.
Provide appropriate escalation of risks, issues, delays, and decisions requiring leadership attention.
Ensure decision-makers have accurate, relevant, and up-to-date information regarding project progress, financials, risks, and overall program health.

User Acceptance Testing Coordination
Coordinate and oversee User Acceptance Testing activities across business areas supporting technology projects within the program.
Ensure testing responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, issues, and completion status are clearly communicated and tracked.
Partner with business and technology teams to support issue resolution and successful completion of testing prior to implementation.

job.title: Project Engineer (Data Center Systems)
job.description:
Project Engineer (Data Center Systems) 
 
This role will support a technical program owner while partnering closely with technical leads responsible for facility developments within large?scale data centers. This role is centered on data center infrastructure: racks, cooling systems, mechanical/electrical interfaces, containment solutions, structural framing, and spatial systems integration that enable high?density compute deployments. Day?to?day, this person will participate in highly technical engineering discussions regarding evolving hardware requirements, fan coil units, cooling strategies, and holistic power, mechanical, and structural integration. They will interpret these multidisciplinary requirements and translate them into clear engineering bulletins, design documents, and decision logs.
The Project Engineer will perform or review CAD/BIM modeling (Revit, SolidWorks, and other BIM tools) to evaluate overall building systems integration. They will run and support large cross?functional meetings (often with 50+ participants) across internal teams and vendors, ensuring alignment and driving clarity across multiple concurrent workstreams. This role requires strong engineering intuition across multiple building disciplines, the ability to follow complex technical conversations without being spoon?fed, and the autonomy to drive forward ambiguous, rapidly evolving engineering requirements specific to data center infrastructure.

Must Haves:
  • 5–7 years of experience as a Project Engineer supporting data centers
  • Background in Mechanical / Electrical Engineering
  • Experience with CAD/BIM modeling tools (Revit, SolidWorks, BIM, or similar)
  • Experience supporting engineering work related to racks, cooling systems, fan coil units, or mechanical interfaces
  • Ability to follow highly technical discussions across structural, mechanical, electrical, and architectural domains
  • Experience running or supporting large cross?functional meetings
  • Strong technical writing skills for engineering bulletins, design decisions, and documentation updates
  • Ability to work with high autonomy, ask the right questions, and execute without step?by?step direction

Nice to Haves:
  • Server hall experience (rack integration, chip deployments, cooling evolution)
  • Experience at a hyperscale data center operator
  • Experience with fan coil units or cooling systems that evolve with chip/rack requirements
  • Exposure to design verification testing (DVT)
  • Familiarity with power architecture
  • Experience supporting teams deploying TPUs, GPUs, or other high?density chips

job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineering Manager for our Research and Development client in Marietta, Ohio.

Job Functions:

  • Own refrigeration system architecture and strategy aligned with product roadmaps and platform reuse initiatives.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.

job.title: Research Associate
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Research Associate in San Diego, CA. This position will support Research Associates and Scientists with laboratory experiments, assay development, and day-to-day lab operations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with assay development, high-throughput or high-content screening, mammalian cell culture, and/or production/manufacturing of lentiviral or AAV vectors.

Position: Research Associate
Rate: $24–$27/hr DOE
Location: San Diego, CA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

Responsibilities:
  • Perform and support cell-based assays using mammalian cell systems, including routine cell culture, maintenance, and experimental setup.
  • Assist with assay development, optimization, and troubleshooting, including development and refinement of experimental protocols.
  • Support high-throughput and/or high-content screening assays, including preparation, execution, and analysis of experiments.
  • Perform laboratory techniques such as PCR, Western blotting, DNA/RNA analysis, and other molecular biology methods as needed.
  • Support the production and manufacturing of lentiviral and/or AAV vectors, including upstream cell culture and related laboratory processes.
  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyze data, and communicate results to Research Associates and Scientists.
  • Assist with routine laboratory operations, including media and reagent preparation, equipment maintenance, and inventory management.
  • Collaborate with senior scientists and other team members to troubleshoot experiments and ensure project milestones are met on schedule.
Qualifications:
  • Associate's degree in Biology, Biochemistry, Molecular Biology, or a related scientific field, or HS/GED with relevant laboratory experience. Bachelor's degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of relevant laboratory experience.
  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique.
  • Experience with assay development and/or optimization strongly preferred.
  • Experience with high-throughput (HTS) and/or high-content screening (HCS) is highly desirable.
  • Experience with lentiviral or AAV production/manufacturing is strongly preferred.
  • Molecular biology experience, including PCR, Western blotting, or related techniques.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established protocols while contributing to troubleshooting and process improvement.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced research environment.
Candidates with experience in assay development, high-throughput/high-content screening, or AAV/lentiviral production are especially encouraged to apply.

job.title: Pilot Plant Operator – Critical Minerals & Water Treatment
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Pilot Plant Operator – Critical Minerals & Water Treatment in Houston, TX. This role will be a hands-on role responsible for running, maintaining, and modifying pilot-scale water treatment/processing equipment. The Pilot Plant Operator professional with 3+ years of water/wastewater treatment experience.  Strong background in conducting water sampling, in-line and lab based testing(pH, conductivity, turbidity, TDS, chemical residuals, etc.)
 
Title: Pilot Plant Operator- Critical Minerals
Pay: $30-$35/hr DOE
Location: Houston, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Role Summary:
Hands-on operator responsible for running, maintaining, and modifying pilot-scale water treatment/processing equipment
 
  • Core Responsibilities:
    • Operate and monitor pilot equipment (pumps, membranes, filtration skids, media filtration, chemical dosing systems, etc.) during test runs
    • Perform equipment setup, troubleshooting, and mechanical/process modifications to support evolving test protocols
    • Conduct water sampling, in-line and lab-based testing (pH, conductivity, turbidity, TDS, chemical residuals, etc.)
    • Handle and dose process chemicals safely, following SOPs and safety data sheets
    • Record and log operational data, test results, and equipment performance metrics accurately
    • Perform routine preventive maintenance and basic repairs on pilot systems
    • Support fabrication/assembly of equipment changes (piping, fittings, instrumentation adjustments)
    • Maintain a clean, organized, and safety-compliant warehouse/lab work area
    • Communicate results, issues, and equipment status to engineering and project leads
 
  • Required Qualifications:
    • Hands-on mechanical aptitude — comfortable working with pumps, valves, piping, and instrumentation
    • Prior experience with water/wastewater treatment or processing equipment (membranes, RO, filtration, desalination, etc.)
    • Experience handling chemicals safely (mixing, dosing, storage, PPE use)
    • Experience with pilot-scale or small-batch industrial equipment
    • Basic troubleshooting/repair skills (mechanical, electrical, or instrumentation)
    • Ability to read basic process diagrams/P&IDs and follow technical procedures
    • Comfortable with physical warehouse work (lifting, standing, working around equipment)
 
  • Preferred Qualifications:
    • Background in chemistry, chemical handling, or a related lab/industrial environment
    • Associate's degree or technical certification in process technology, chemistry, environmental science, or a related trade (not required — relevant experience can substitute
 
  • Work Environment:
    • Warehouse/pilot facility setting — active, on-your-feet, hands-on role
    • Exposure to process chemicals and testing equipment (proper PPE and training provided)

job.title: Principal ASIC Design Engineer
job.description:
Principal ASIC Design Engineer RTL / Microarchitecture / High-Performance Networking Overview Seeking a Principal ASIC Design Engineer to own front-end design for complex, high-performance silicon used in advanced networking and AI infrastructure. This role will work closely with architecture, verification, emulation, DFT, and physical design teams to translate product requirements into robust microarchitecture and production-ready RTL.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on technical leader with deep RTL design experience, multiple successful tapeouts, and a strong understanding of performance, power, area, timing, and design quality.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define microarchitecture and implement synthesizable RTL for complex ASIC blocks and subsystems.
  • Develop high-quality SystemVerilog designs optimized for performance, power, area, and timing.
  • Partner with Design Verification and Emulation teams on test strategy, debug, coverage closure, and design intent.
  • Work with Physical Design and DFT teams on synthesis, timing closure, area optimization, clocking, and test logic integration.
  • Review design reports, identify architectural or RTL bottlenecks, and drive fixes through tapeout and silicon bring-up.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years of ASIC or SoC logic design experience with strong hands-on RTL development.
  • Strong SystemVerilog experience and solid understanding of digital design fundamentals, CDC, synthesis, timing, and clocking.
  • Experience defining microarchitecture and developing complex ASIC blocks from specification through implementation.

  • Experience with Lint, CDC, RDC, formal verification, synthesis, STA, and front-end design methodology.
  • Strong scripting skills using Python, Perl, Tcl, or similar languages.
  • Experience analyzing timing, power, and area reports and making RTL or architectural changes to improve PPA.
  • Exposure to silicon bring-up and post-silicon debug.
  • Experience with high-performance networking ASICs, Ethernet switch silicon, packet processing, low-latency datapaths, NoC, SerDes integration, or AI infrastructure silicon.
  • Background in switch ASICs, NICs, DPUs, network processors, or data center networking is a strong plus.

job.title: System Administrator
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting contract opportunity for a Recruiting Systems Administrator to support a leading advanced technology organization. This position will provide day-to-day administration and operational support for the organization’s applicant tracking system (ATS), helping ensure recruiting technology, workflows, data, and user access remain accurate and reliable. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience supporting Lever or a comparable ATS and is comfortable troubleshooting system issues while partnering closely with Talent Acquisition and HR technology teams.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Recruiting Systems Administrator – Lever
Type: 3–6 Month Contract
Compensation:$38-45/hr
Location: Remote

Responsibilities
  • Provide day-to-day administration and support for the organization’s applicant tracking system, with a primary focus on Lever.
  • Maintain system configurations, recruiting workflows, user accounts, permissions, and access levels.
  • Create and maintain requisitions and job postings while ensuring system information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Troubleshoot routine ATS issues and respond to questions from recruiters, recruiting coordinators, and other system users.
  • Support recruiting workflows spanning candidate stages, interviews, offers, dispositions, and related processes.
  • Create basic reports and perform regular data audits to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Maintain accurate recruiting system records and assist with ongoing system cleanup and optimization.
  • Document system configurations, processes, troubleshooting procedures, and end-user instructions.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition Operations, recruiting teams, and HR technology stakeholders to improve the overall user experience.
  • Assist with configuration, testing, implementation, or optimization of additional recruiting technology as business needs evolve.
Qualifications
  • 1+ year of experience administering or supporting Lever, Ashby, or another applicant tracking system (ATS).
  • Hands-on experience with ATS configuration, user administration, permissions, and troubleshooting.
  • Working knowledge of recruiting processes, including requisitions, job postings, candidate workflows, interviews, offers, and dispositions.
  • Experience creating basic reports, conducting data audits, and maintaining system data integrity.
  • Ability to troubleshoot user issues and provide responsive support to recruiting and HR stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent organizational, prioritization, and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to clearly document system processes, configurations, and user instructions.
  • Comfortable learning new recruiting technologies and supporting system configuration, testing, and implementation activities.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across recruiting, operations, and technology teams.
Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Senior Laboratory Scientist (3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering)
job.description:
Senior Laboratory Scientist – 3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Senior Laboratory Scientist – 3D Bioprinting & Tissue Engineering to join an innovative biotechnology company in Philadelphia, PA. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced laboratory scientist with a strong background in mammalian cell culture, tissue engineering, and/or 3D bioprinting to play a key role in the development and execution of cutting-edge precision medicine platforms.

Location: Philadelphia, PA
Target Start Date: September 2026
Compensation: $75,000 – $85,000 annually

About the Role As a foundational laboratory hire in Philadelphia, the Senior Laboratory Scientist will serve as a hands-on laboratory leader responsible for executing 3D bioprinting and tissue engineering workflows while supporting the growth and development of the laboratory.

This individual will be responsible for daily production activities, primary human cell processing, client bioassays, laboratory documentation, and maintaining high standards for aseptic technique and GxP compliance.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead daily production of standardized 3D-bioprinted human skin models and oncology micro-tumors using proprietary bio-inks.

  • Perform human primary cell extraction, tissue dissociation, expansion, and cell banking from fresh patient surgical biopsies.

  • Execute complex client screening bioassays, including ADME-Tox and efficacy testing, while maintaining strict aseptic technique and protocol adherence.

  • Operate and troubleshoot automated bioprinting, microfluidics, and related laboratory equipment.

  • Maintain accurate laboratory records and ensure documentation meets applicable GxP and quality requirements.

  • Monitor laboratory workflows and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, consistency, and reproducibility.

  • Support the development and implementation of standardized laboratory procedures and production workflows.

  • Assist with training and mentoring junior laboratory and production personnel as the team expands.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional scientific and operational teams to support client projects and platform development.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cell Biology, Bioengineering, Tissue Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.

  • 5+ years of hands-on laboratory experience in a sterile, regulated mammalian cell culture environment.

  • Demonstrated experience working with mammalian cell culture; experience with primary human cells is highly preferred.

  • Familiarity with 3D bioprinting, tissue engineering, microfluidics, or automated laboratory systems.

  • Strong aseptic technique and experience working in a regulated or quality-focused laboratory environment.

  • Ability to troubleshoot laboratory equipment, protocols, and experimental workflows independently.

  • Strong laboratory documentation, organization, and record-keeping skills.

  • Ability to work effectively in a growing, fast-paced laboratory environment and take ownership of day-to-day laboratory operations.

Preferred Experience
  • Experience with 3D-bioprinted tissue models or organoid systems.

  • Experience processing fresh human tissue or surgical biopsy specimens.

  • Experience with bioassay development or execution, including ADME-Tox and/or efficacy testing.

  • Experience working within GxP, GLP, GMP, or other regulated laboratory environments.

  • Experience operating multi-axis automated bioprinters or microfluidic systems.

Why Join? This is an opportunity to join a rapidly growing biotechnology organization developing innovative human-relevant models for precision medicine and preclinical drug development. The Senior Laboratory Scientist will have significant hands-on ownership and the opportunity to help build laboratory operations and scientific capabilities from the ground up.

Yoh Life Sciences is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Electrical Systems Test Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Systems Test Engineer
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Systems Test Engineer to support the verification and validation (V&V) of electrical systems in autonomous vehicle platforms. This role will involve executing tests across multiple environments, developing test plans for high and low voltage components, and providing technical assistance to fellow engineers. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power electronics, electromechanical systems, and hands-on electrical lab work.

Scope:
• Support V&V activities for electrical systems in both new and existing autonomous vehicle platforms
• Execute test procedures in environments such as full vehicles, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) systems, and hardware test benches
• Collaborate with engineers to create new test plans for vehicle electrical systems, power generation modules, and low voltage batteries
• Provide technical guidance to test engineers and conductors during verification activities
• Contribute to test setup, troubleshooting, and debugging of electrical and electromechanical subsystems

Required:
• Proven experience testing power electronics and high/low voltage electrical systems
• Skilled in test planning and experimental design, with a focus on safety and repeatability
• Background in electromechanical systems that integrate hardware, electrical systems, communication protocols, and software
• Strong hands-on skills with wiring, soldering, and harness creation
• Proficient with electrical test tools including oscilloscopes, DMMs, power loads, programmable power supplies, etc.
• Experience using data acquisition tools such as Vector CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe, ETAS INCA, MDA, etc.
• Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, which may include education in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace, or related fields

Pluses:
• Experience building and debugging electromechanical systems
• Strong understanding of low-level electronic components (e.g., transistors, relays, capacitors, diodes) and their role in PCB assemblies
• Familiarity with test automation and scripting (e.g., Python, C/C++, MATLAB/Simulink)
• Experience working in environments with hardware/software integration challenges

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Technical Project Manager (Mid 3-5 years)
6+ month contract
Frisco, TX (Hybrid)
 
  • Strong ability to track multiple incidents, enhancements, projects, and priorities concurrently.
  • Provide clear, proactive, accurate, communication with our stakeholders, business partners, leadership, and technical team.
  • Bridge gaps between business and technical issues, requirements, and resources.
  • Strong sense of ownership and great team player.
 
We are seeking a highly motivated and results-oriented technical Project Manager to join our team. The ideal candidate will follow the Servant Leadership concept to lead and manage multiple projects through the full project lifecycle, ensuring that the projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.  
 
  • Project Planning and Execution:
    • Develop comprehensive project plans that align with business objectives and strategic goals.
    • Break down projects into manageable phases and tasks, assigning responsibilities to team members.
    • Coordinate cross-project activities, and identify, communicate, and mitigate cross-stream risks, issues, and dependencies.
    • Implement and manage changes and interventions to ensure program goals are achieved.
    • Analyze work product progress and provide objective reporting of project status.
    • Coordinate activities between work streams and identify changes in scope.
    • Evaluate and assess the results of the project.
    • Partner with QA to coordinate UAT (user acceptance testing) and results.
    • Ensure definition of done is met for all releases.
  • Stakeholder Management:
    • Meeting with stakeholders to make communication easy and transparent regarding project issues and decisions.
    • Establish and maintain effective communication channels with project team members, and leadership.
    • Review and analyze stakeholder requirements, ensuring their alignment with project goals.
    • Coordinate diverse perspectives from various stakeholders to produce high quality project results.
    • Manage stakeholder expectations and address concerns promptly to maintain project momentum and satisfaction.
  • Team Leadership and Motivation:
    • Provide clear direction, guidance, and support to team members, empowering them to achieve their goals.
    • Collaborate with, motivate and inspire team members to overcome challenges and deliver exceptional results.
    • Ensure open communication and a collaborative approach.
    • Identify and implement process refinements to increase team efficiency and effectiveness and pursue a path of continuous improvement.
  • Risk Mitigation and Issue Resolution:
    • Identify, assess, and prioritize potential project risks and issues.
    • Develop and implement effective strategies to mitigate risks and resolve issues that arise.
    • Manage issue escalations constructively, ensuring appropriate communication, resolution, and engagement with leadership.
  • Project Documentation and Reporting:
    • Responsible for managing all program documentation including: creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, risk registers, status reports, testing plans, release notifications and communications.
    • Prepare regular project updates, presenting findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
    • Document lessons learned from completed projects to improve future project outcomes.
 
QUALIFICATIONS
Required
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in project management, with at least 3 years of experience managing complex projects across multiple departments with competing stakeholder priorities.
  • Strong technical background with a deep understanding of the Microsoft technology stack, including .NET, Azure and SQL Server.
  • Must have a proven track record of successfully delivering projects within budget, schedule, and scope.
  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, enabling effective collaboration with diverse stakeholders, including the ability to explain a server migration to the CEO and a business requirement to a Lead Developer without losing anything in translation.
  • Experience in project management methodologies (Agile Development frameworks) and tools, particularly Azure DevOps, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • Strong understanding of risk management principles and techniques.
  • Familiarity with change management processes and tools.
  • Proficient in MS Office Suite, including Visio and MS Project.
  • Strong understanding of strategic alignment to ensure project goals align with company’s long-term roadmap.
Preferred
  1. PMP certification desirable
  2. 1-2 years of formal Agile/Scrum experience desirable
  3. Insurance or other compliance-heavy industry experience a plus, insurance experience a big plus
 
SKILLS
This section captures the job competencies and soft skills needed to perform the expected work and performance for the role.
  • Solid understanding of software development models and knowledge of both Agile and traditional project management principles and practices and the ability to blend them together in the right proportions to fit project needs.
  • Ability to understand and discuss technical concepts, architecture, and terminology, particularly within a Microsoft-centric environment.
  • Self-starter with ability to work independently and follow through to successful completion of each initiative.
  • Ability to think creatively, problem solve, and work with others to find the best solution. 
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Adaptability and resilience to handle unexpected changes and maintain project momentum.
  • Precision in work and attention to all details.
  • Excellent organizational, multitasking and time management skills
  • Excellent people skills

job.title: Flight Test Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Flight Test Engineer – ECS & Thermal Systems to join our Aerospace & Defense client in Newton, KS. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who can work onsite in a hands-on flight-test environment supporting the evaluation of environmental control and aircraft thermal management systems.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: Flight Test Engineer – ECS & Thermal Systems
Location: Newton, KS (Onsite)
Compensation: $65-80/hr DOE 
Type: 6-Month Contract, Full-Time
Eligibility: Must qualify as a U.S. Person under applicable U.S. export-control regulations due to the nature of the technical data and systems involved.

Responsibilities
  • Provide onsite engineering support for experimental aircraft flight-test activities involving Environmental Control Systems (ECS), cooling systems, and thermal performance.
  • Develop a detailed understanding of aircraft systems, equipment locations, instrumentation, and relevant test configurations.
  • Build, update, and review real-time test-data displays used to monitor aircraft performance during ground and flight operations.
  • Staff the flight-test console and monitor key system parameters, including temperatures, liquid-cooling performance, airflow/fan operation, and other identified areas of technical risk.
  • Coordinate with design engineers and flight-test personnel to evaluate system behavior and identify potential thermal or equipment concerns during testing.
  • Communicate real-time observations and technical information to Test Conductors, Test Directors, and other engineering personnel during flight operations.
  • Process, analyze, and review flight-test data to assess system performance and support engineering conclusions.
  • Prepare technical documentation, engineering summaries, and formal test reports based on collected data and test results.
  • Provide limited assistance with test preparation, procedures, and planning activities as needed.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 5+ years of relevant engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated experience working with engineering test data, including data reduction, analysis, technical review, and report preparation.
  • Proficiency with data-analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, Excel, or comparable engineering software.
  • Ability to interpret engineering schematics, test procedures, instrumentation outputs, and other technical documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, onsite testing environment.
  • Ability to work full-time onsite in Newton, KS and travel periodically to Frisco, TX as business needs require.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Previous experience supporting formal aircraft or aerospace flight-test programs.
  • Familiarity with IADS or comparable real-time test-data visualization and monitoring platforms.
  • Knowledge of aircraft Environmental Control Systems (ECS), liquid-cooling systems, forced-air cooling, fans, or other thermal-management technologies.
  • Experience communicating via radio in a flight-test control room or similar operational environment.
  • Hands-on familiarity with test instrumentation used to measure temperature, pressure, flow, or related engineering parameters.

job.title: Distinguished Engineer - Cloud Services
job.description:
Distinguished Software Engineer Distributed Systems | Platform Architecture | AI Infrastructure Overview Seeking a Distinguished Software Engineer to define and build the next generation of distributed infrastructure platforms supporting large-scale AI and enterprise deployments. This is a highly technical, hands-on leadership role responsible for driving architecture, developing production software, validating new technologies through prototypes, and partnering across engineering and product organizations to deliver scalable platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate is a proven distributed systems expert who remains actively involved in software development while influencing long-term technical direction.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop distributed platform services supporting cloud, edge, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
  • Build scalable control plane services, microservices, and APIs using Go, gRPC, Protocol Buffers, and Kubernetes-based architectures.
  • Design observability and telemetry platforms utilizing OpenTelemetry, Kafka, ClickHouse, VictoriaMetrics, Prometheus, Grafana, or similar technologies.
  • Develop platform automation, orchestration, and AI-assisted operational workflows to improve provisioning, deployment, lifecycle management, and infrastructure health.
  • Evaluate new technologies through hands-on prototyping, drive architectural decisions, perform code reviews, and collaborate across Product, Customer Engineering, and Software Engineering teams.
Required Qualifications
  • 18+ years designing and building large-scale distributed systems for enterprise, cloud, or infrastructure platforms.
  • Expert-level Go development (or comparable systems programming language such as Rust or C++) with deep knowledge of distributed systems architecture.
  • Strong experience building microservices, gRPC services, REST APIs, Kubernetes-based platforms, and hybrid cloud/on-prem infrastructure.
  • Experience with OpenTelemetry, telemetry pipelines, stream processing (Kafka), and large-scale observability platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, ArangoDB, graph databases, time-series databases, and distributed data architectures.
  • Experience designing secure multi-tenant platforms including RBAC, authentication, authorization, and enterprise identity integration.
  • Demonstrated ability to prototype complex technical solutions, evaluate architectural tradeoffs, and deliver production-quality software.
  • Excellent communication skills with experience presenting technical designs to engineering leadership, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with AI infrastructure, autonomous operations, LLM agents, LangGraph, AutoGen, MCP, or AI-driven workflow automation.
  • Background in network automation, infrastructure management, OpenConfig, gNMI, data center networking, or large-scale infrastructure orchestration.
  • Experience with zero-touch provisioning, device lifecycle management, edge computing, or control plane/data plane architectures.
  • Active open-source contributions or recognized technical leadership within distributed systems or cloud infrastructure communities.

job.title: Sr. Material Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Sr. Material Coordinator to support a medical device customer in San Diego, CA.   
 
The Senior Material Coordinator should have strong ERP, inventory management, and computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
 
This role is performing hands-on warehouse activities including receiving, stocking, kitting, and material movements, and working cross-functionally with Quality, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams.
 
 
Location: Kearny Mesa, CA 
Duration: 3 month contract to perm 
Pay Rate: $26-$28/hr
Shift: Mon - Friday day shift
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Inventory Management: Perform routine inventory counts, monitor stock levels, resolve discrepancies, and maintain accurate records in ERP and inventory systems.
  • Perform hands-on warehouse activities including receiving, stocking, kitting, and material movements.
  • Work cross-functionally with Quality, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Receiving & Inspection: Unload and receive incoming materials, operate warehouse equipment safely, validate stock locations, inspect for defects, and document results in ERP and QMS systems.
  • Kitting & Material Prep: Pick, stage, and validate components for production
 
Requirements
  • Experience in inventory control or warehouse operations; medical device manufacturing preferred.
  • Strong ERP, inventory management, and computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience performing inventory transactions, material control, cycle count support, and stockroom management.
  • Exceptional attention to detail with a commitment to inventory accuracy, traceability, and transaction integrity.
  • Highly organized and able to effectively manage changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate discrepancies, resolve issues, and maintain accurate records.
  • Adaptable, resourceful, and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to read and follow detailed instructions and SOPs.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines.
 
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with ISO 13485 and FDA regulatory requirements.
  • Experience with inbound inspection and document control activities.
  • Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing principles and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
 
Working Conditions
Ability to stand, walk, and move within the production area for long periods.
Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment, including exposure to machinery, noise, and varying temperatures.
May be required to lift items weighing up to 30 lbs.

job.title: 3D Printing & General Rework Lab Technician
job.description:
3D Printing & Electronics Lab Technician
We are seeking a hands-on 3D Printing & Electronics Lab Technician to support rapid prototype development in a fast-paced engineering lab. This role is primarily focused on additive manufacturing (approximately 80%) with secondary responsibilities supporting electronics assembly and prototype integration (approximately 20%). We are looking for someone with a strong maker mindset who enjoys building, fabricating, and working on DIY projects. Previous 3D printing experience is not required—we will provide training.

Scope:

Additive Manufacturing (80%)
• Operate, monitor, and maintain 3D printers supporting engineering prototype builds.
• Prepare, clean, and finish printed parts for engineering evaluation.
• Schedule print jobs and maintain printer materials and equipment.
• Support engineers with rapid prototype fabrication and general lab operations.
• Assist with organization and upkeep of the additive manufacturing workspace.

Electronics & Prototype Support (20%)
• Perform through-hole and standard SMT soldering for prototype assemblies.
• Flash firmware to Arduino and similar microcontroller development boards.
• Assemble wire harnesses, LED assemblies, and other prototype hardware.
• Perform continuity checks and basic electrical testing using digital multimeters.
• Support hardware modifications, prototype builds, and maintenance of lab tools and equipment.

Required:
• Experience with hand soldering and general electronics assembly.
• Experience flashing firmware to Arduino or similar microcontroller boards.
• Ability to read basic schematics, wiring diagrams, and assembly drawings.
• Basic FDM familiarity and basic CAD skills in Rhino or Fusion.
• Experience using digital multimeters and basic electronic test equipment.
• Strong mechanical aptitude, attention to detail, and a hands-on, maker mentality.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced engineering or prototype lab environment.

Pluses:
• Experience with 3D printing, additive manufacturing, or other fabrication equipment.
• Experience supporting engineering prototype builds or R&D lab environments.
• Personal experience with DIY projects, robotics, makerspaces, or hobby electronics.
• Familiarity with wire harness assembly, basic mechanical assembly, or prototype integration.
