job.title: Senior Refrigeration Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Refrigeration Engineer for our Research and Development Client in Marietta, Ohio. This is a great opportunity to join a growing team!

Job Functions:
  • Design and develop cascade vapor-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms.
  • Develop specifications for system-level, subsystem and component performance.
  • Execute test plans to validate the performance of newly developed refrigeration systems by utilizing design for reliability tools and performance sensitivity analysis.
  • Design refrigeration systems that meet customer requirements, time to market commitments and that are within the target cost of the projects.
  • Analyze the thermal behavior of the refrigeration system with thermo-physical tools for component selection and overall refrigeration system design.
  • Ensure refrigeration designs are Designed for Compliance to meet regulatory and certification requirements (e.g., UL, IEC, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star).
Education and Experience Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline
  • Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred
  • Master’s degree preferred
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience developing vapor-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred.
  • Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs.
  •  Thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing
  •  Analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions
  • Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation
  • Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems.
  • Knowledge of refrigeration system testing methods and equipment

job.title: Senior Research Scientist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Senior Research Scientist to join an innovative biotechnology company in Philadelphia, PA. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced research scientist with expertise in tissue engineering, primary human cell culture, 3D bioprinting, and assay development to help establish and advance cutting-edge precision medicine and preclinical research capabilities. This individual will provide scientific leadership across laboratory initiatives, drive assay and model development, and support the validation of research workflows for commercial client projects. The role offers the opportunity to help build and scale R&D capabilities within a rapidly growing biotechnology environment.

Location: Philadelphia, PA
Target Start Date: September 2026
Compensation: $100,000 – $115,000 annually

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the implementation, optimization, and validation of advanced 3D bioprinting protocols, bio-ink technologies, and complex cell culture methodologies.
  • Support the transfer of proprietary tissue engineering technologies and protocols into U.S.-based laboratory workflows.
  • Provide scientific leadership and mentorship to R&D and laboratory team members.
  • Lead the development and optimization of high-throughput screening campaigns and research assays.
  • Design and develop novel multicellular tissue models to improve the physiological relevance and reproducibility of 3D micro-tumor systems.
  • Integrate multiple cell populations, including fibroblasts, vascular cells, and immune cells, into advanced tissue models.
  • Develop and validate customized research workflows in support of commercial client projects.
  • Analyze and interpret complex experimental datasets to evaluate model performance, reproducibility, and biological relevance.
  • Oversee analysis of RNA sequencing and genomic fidelity data to assess correlations between engineered tissue models and original patient biopsy samples.
  • Troubleshoot experimental protocols and laboratory processes while identifying opportunities for improved efficiency and scientific performance.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional scientific and operational teams to advance platform development and client programs.
  • Maintain high standards for scientific documentation, data integrity, and laboratory quality.

Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Bioengineering, Tissue Engineering, Cell Biology, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline; alternatively, an M.S. with extensive relevant industry experience.
  • 5+ years of research experience with demonstrated scientific leadership within a biotechnology, CRO, pharmaceutical, cell therapy, or related environment.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with primary human cell isolation, culture, expansion, and characterization.
  • Demonstrated experience with 3D bioprinting, tissue engineering, or advanced multicellular model systems.
  • Experience designing, developing, and optimizing laboratory assays, including ADME-Tox and/or efficacy assays.
  • Strong understanding of experimental design, data analysis, and interpretation.
  • Experience with genomic analysis, RNA sequencing data, or related molecular biology applications.
  • Excellent scientific documentation and communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects, troubleshoot complex scientific challenges, and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Experience
  • Experience with automated 3D bioprinting systems and/or microfluidic platforms.
  • Experience developing patient-derived tumor models, organoids, or other huma-relevant tissue models.
  • Experience incorporating immune, vascular, and stromal cell populations into multicellular models.
  • Experience working in a commercial biotechnology, CRO, or preclinical drug development environment.
  • Experience supporting technology transfer from an international or external R&D organization into a U.S.-based laboratory.
  • Familiarity with GxP, GLP, or other regulated research environments.

job.title: Senior Quality Control Chemist Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Quality Control Technician for our medical device manufacturing client in St. Paul, MN. In this role, you will be responsible for performing quality control inspections, laboratory testing, and product acceptance activities for sterile and non-sterile medical devices. The Senior Quality Control Technician will ensure products meet approved specifications, procedures, customer requirements, and applicable regulatory standards while supporting manufacturing, laboratory, and quality operations.
Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: St. Paul, MN
Compensation: $28/hr
Type:Direct Hire 

Job Functions·
· Perform incoming, in-process, final, and finished product QC inspections to verify conformance to specifications, customer requirements, and quality system requirements.
· Perform accurate measurements and document inspection and testing results with a high level of attention to detail.
· Ensure inspections and testing activities are completed in accordance with production schedules and established priorities.
· Review manufacturing records, sterile processing documentation, test results, certifications, labeling, and related paperwork for compliance with specifications and quality system requirements.
· Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are properly handled and stored according to specifications and quality system requirements.
· Collect, prepare, and submit samples to internal and external laboratories.
· Prepare sterilization documentation and analyze sterilization and biological indicator results.
· Perform UV-Vis, FTIR, and basic wet chemistry testing and analyze results against established specifications.
· Prepare and mix chemical formulations for Production and Manufacturing use.
· Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and controlled environment testing.
· Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use.
· Assist with investigations involving products or processes suspected of being nonconforming.
· Coordinate Material Review Board activities and support timely disposition of nonconforming materials.
· Communicate with applicable stakeholders regarding materials awaiting MRB review, action, or disposition.
· Maintain controlled access to QA Hold and Quarantine areas.
· Inspect returned goods and ensure nonconforming materials are appropriately segregated.
· Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by required due dates.
· Verify equipment is appropriately identified with calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or out of specification.
· Verify preventive maintenance and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.
· Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations, standards, and quality system requirements.

Education,
· Licensure and/or Experience· Associate degree or higher in a STEM-related discipline required.
· 3+ years of experience in quality control and inspection within a medical device manufacturing environment.
· Experience preparing technical reports, analyses, and documentation using Microsoft Office.
· Ability to interpret blueprints, technical documentation, specifications, and procedures.
· Working knowledge of analytical chemistry.
· Applied knowledge of quality control, inspection methodologies, and test and measurement instrumentation.
· Experience using measurement and inspection instruments including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.
· Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce precise measurements, documentation, and quality records.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.
· Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

Preferred Qualifications·
·  Two-year technical degree.
· Training or certification related to ISO 13485 and FDA quality systems.
· Experience with sterilization, microbiology, and chemistry.
· Knowledge of Good Laboratory Practices.
· Strong manual dexterity.

Physical Job Requirements·
· Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or operate objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
· Frequently required to communicate verbally and hear.
· Occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
· Specific vision requirements include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
· Reasonable accommodations may be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

job.title: Building Mechanic / Facilities Support (ONSITE)
job.description:
Building Mechanic/Facilities Support (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $25-28/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Facilities support contractor will support the Facilities Services Department’s responsibility for the maintenance of critical infrastructure systems supporting PJM control rooms and computer rooms; as well as preventive/remedial maintenance and property management functions for other PJM campus buildings including the mechanical, electrical, structural, environmental, and fire protection systems.
  • Perform monitoring and recording of equipment performance by periodic reading of gauges and displayed information, and appropriately responding to visual and building automation system generated alarms.
  • Assist installing electrical construction such as installation, termination, and inspection of electrical systems ranging up to 480 volts A.C.  Basic understanding of electrical theory such as Ohm’s law and NEC code is required
  • Diagnosis of electrical problems, understanding of test instruments such as ohmmeters, ammeters, voltmeters, and temperature detectors.
  • Utilize Building Automation Systems (BAS.) to monitor infrastructure environmental systems and address system alarm conditions and problems.
  • Perform mechanical tasks such as replacing/installing systems components, as air conditioning piping, pumps fans and air handler filters. Ability to correctly read pressure and temperature gauges.
  • Familiarity with inspection and basic diagnosis of fire protection systems including ionization detectors, rate-compensated temperature detectors and double-interlocked (pre-action) sprinkler systems.
  • Responsible for performing basic facilities support tasks such as furniture set up/knockdown, painting, basic carpentry, cable pulls and occasional / limited custodial duties.
  • Support the shipping / receiving staff as needed.
Required:
  • Physically capable of lifting up to fifty pounds, able to bend, kneel, climb ladders
  • Experience with common hand and power tools (hammers, drills, wrenches, ratchet sets)
  • Excellent work ethic -- positive, forward-thinking, “can do” attitude.
  • Ability to address multiple tasks in concurrent manner from assignment to completion.
  • A self-directed and highly motivated worker with the ability to take a project from inception to completion.
  • Ability to assimilate information and follow instructions.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with management, supervision, peers and customers.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively work in a team-based environment
  • Valid driver’s license

job.title: Manufacturing Technician / Cyclotron Operator
job.description:
Yoh is hiring Manufacturing Technicians / Cyclotron Operators for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

This is an onsite, contract-to-hire opportunity with multiple openings. The team is moving quickly and is looking for candidates with hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, military electronics, industrial electronics, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, biomedical equipment, field service, controls, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience. Prior cyclotron or radiopharmaceutical experience is not required. Training is provided. Candidates must have strong hands-on technical aptitude, troubleshooting ability, reliability, and the ability to learn highly specialized equipment systems in a regulated manufacturing environment. Candidates with general electrical, mechanical, maintenance, manufacturing, or field service backgrounds may be considered if they also have direct experience troubleshooting electrical/electronic systems, automation, controls, circuit-level issues, diagnostic equipment, or complex electro-mechanical equipment.

Pay Rate: $25/hr

Schedule:
  • This is a 24/7/365 operation.
  • Current schedule is 12-hour shifts, 7 days on / 7 days off.
  • Current rotation starts Tuesday and runs through Monday.
  • Quarterly rotation between day shift and night shift required.
  • Overtime pay applies as part of this schedule.

Essential Job Functions:
  • Perform troubleshooting for cyclotron operations and support equipment.
  • Perform routine maintenance and repairs of cyclotrons and support equipment.
  • Support advanced maintenance and repair activities under general direction.
  • Perform scheduled start-ups and shutdowns of cyclotrons.
  • Perform target loading, installation, and transport activities.
  • Operate and monitor cyclotrons and support systems during target irradiation.
  • Monitor cyclotrons and support systems during standby conditions.
  • Document cyclotron performance, operations data, maintenance activities, and repair work.
  • Work closely with Cyclotron Chemistry and production teams to support daily production activities.
  • Maintain compliance with applicable regulatory and quality standards, including FDA, cGMP, NRC, ISO, USP, and related requirements.

Education / Experience:
  • Two-year degree in Electronics, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Technology, Biomedical Equipment Technology, or a related technical field preferred.
  • Equivalent electronics, automation, military electronics, field service, or hands-on technical training may be considered.
  • Hands-on electronics, mechatronics, automation, controls, industrial electronics, biomedical equipment, electro-mechanical troubleshooting, field service, or complex technical equipment troubleshooting experience required.
  • Experience using diagnostic tools, meters, schematics, service manuals, troubleshooting procedures, or test equipment preferred.
  • Experience with circuit boards, power supplies, sensors, relays, motors, control systems, automation systems, electrical cabinets, or complex equipment diagnostics preferred.
  • Experience with PLCs, logic circuits, VFDs, RF systems, high-voltage equipment, analog/digital circuits, vacuum systems, pneumatics, hydraulics, or manufacturing equipment is a plus.
  • Experience with component-level electronics troubleshooting, soldering, bench testing, or circuit board repair is strongly preferred but not required.
  • Experience working around ionizing radiation sources is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to troubleshoot technical systems across multiple equipment areas.
  • Ability to follow detailed procedures, document work accurately, and complete extensive on-the-job and compliance training.
  • Strong reliability, communication, safety awareness, and team orientation required.

Strong Fit Backgrounds May Include:
  • Electronics Technician
  • Mechatronics Technician
  • Automation Technician
  • Controls Technician
  • Electromechanical Technician
  • Avionics Technician
  • Military Electronics Technician
  • RF / Radar / Communications Technician
  • Biomedical Equipment Technician
  • Semiconductor Equipment Technician
  • Industrial Electronics Technician
  • Complex Field Service Technician
  • Technical Test Technician
  • CNC Equipment Repair Technician
  • EV / Automotive Electrical Diagnostic Technician

job.title: Capital Projects Manager - Chemical Manufacturing
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Capital Projects Manager-Chemical Manufacturing in Temple, TX. This role will be a responsible for execution of capital projects and developing and implementing preventive/predictive maintenance programs, coordinating corrective maintenance ensuring equipment reliability, managing and mentoring a team of maintenance and construction professionals, and supporting operational excellence in a regulated, safety-first environment.
 
Title: Capital Projects Manager
Duration: Direct Hire 
Pay: $120,000/yr
Location: Temple, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Responsibilities:
  • Maintenance and construction activities management: Develop, Plan, organize, lead and manage corrective/preventive/predictive maintenance programs and activities to ensure reliability and cost efficiency of the plant overall operations, within budget, and to standard
  • Lead Execution of capital projects and plant upgrades: Coordinate installation and commissioning following headquarters Engineering team plans, instructions, design and costs approved
  • Equipment working conditions: Collaborate with Operations teams to improve equipment uptime and reliability and ensure machinery and equipment are maintained in optimal working conditions
  • Supervise and coordinate daily activities of maintenance and technical staff
  • Plant Turnarounds and Emergency Repairs: Provide leadership in emergency repairs and plant shutdown/startup activities
  • CMMS: Ensure all maintenance work is documented and tracked via Computerized Maintenance Management System.
  • Cost Control: Monitor and manage Maintenance budgets, labor and contractor costs, spare parts inventory to grant budget goals
  • Performance and Reporting: Develop, implement and report maintenance performance reports, KPIs, and improvement initiatives, to senior management and organization. Reports, KPI’s and initiatives have to drive continuous improvement and positive change aligned with company strategical goals
  • Health, Safety & Environmental Compliance: Ensure compliance with OSHA, EPA, and other applicable safety and environmental regulations and policies, including chemical handling, waste disposal, and emergency procedures. Collaborate with Company organization to continuously improve safety
  • People management and development: Manage, train and mentor construction and maintenance staff, including contractors, ensuring compliance with internal procedures and industry standards. Foster a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement. Be the positive change agent. Comply with company people management processes (performance reviews, trainings etc.
  • Continuous improvement Culture: Analyze maintenance data to identify bad actors, and flaws, propose and implement improvements to maximize reliability, reduce downtime, minimize waste and costs
  • Cross functional initiatives: Lead or participate company x-functional initiatives.
Required:
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering – or equivalent experience.
  • Minimum of 3 years of maintenance experience in a chemical, petrochemical, or relevant industrial manufacturing environment
  • Minimum 2 years in a progressing management role.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical systems, electrical controls, pumps, compressors, and process equipment
  • Experience with CMMS platforms (Limble, SAP PM, Maximo, or similar
  • Fluent in English (read, write, and comprehend) is required
  • An active, valid driver’s license and a good driving record for past 5 years

#IND-SPG

job.title: Junior Endpoint Engineer - Java Remediation & Patching
job.description:
Junior Endpoint Engineer – Java Remediation & Patching
Location: Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
4+ month contract
 
Position Overview
We are seeking a Junior Endpoint Engineer to support a critical security and technology remediation initiative focused on identifying, troubleshooting, and remediating outdated Java applications across a large Windows device environment.
This role will support the remediation of approximately 1,600 devices that require updates to Java applications, including outdated Java Runtime Environments (JREs) and Java Development Kits (JDKs), with the goal of completing the initiative by the end of 2026.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, PowerShell, and Windows endpoint management. This is an engineering-focused position rather than a traditional Tier 1/Tier 2 desktop support role. Candidates should be comfortable troubleshooting endpoint policies, agents, scripts, and configurations to determine why devices are not receiving or successfully applying required patches.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Support a large-scale Java remediation and endpoint security initiative across approximately 1,600 Windows devices.
  • Identify and remediate outdated Java applications, including JREs and JDKs.
  • Troubleshoot endpoint issues preventing devices from receiving or successfully applying required patches.
  • Work within a co-managed endpoint environment utilizing both Microsoft Intune and SCCM/MECM.
  • Troubleshoot SCCM/MECM and Intune agents, policies, configurations, and deployment issues.
  • Validate that devices are properly receiving and applying required policies and software updates.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot PowerShell scripts used for remediation and endpoint management.
  • Analyze basic reports and endpoint data to identify devices requiring remediation.
  • Troubleshoot Windows endpoint configuration issues, including environment variables and application-related settings.
  • Work directly with end users when necessary to resolve issues resulting from Java updates or endpoint changes.
  • Assist with troubleshooting elevation and administrative access requirements, including familiarity with LAPS.
  • Document remediation activities, troubleshooting steps, and recurring issues.
  • Collaborate closely with endpoint engineering, infrastructure, security, and other technical teams.
  • Support additional endpoint remediation and security initiatives as business needs evolve.
 
Requirements
  • 2+ years of experience in endpoint management, systems administration, desktop engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with SCCM/MECM in an enterprise environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Intune or another cloud-based endpoint/mobile device management platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell scripting.
  • Strong understanding of Windows operating systems and endpoint configurations.
  • Experience troubleshooting software deployment, patching, policies, agents, or endpoint management issues.
  • Ability to analyze technical data and reports to identify and resolve endpoint issues.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a technical engineering team.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with end users when technical issues require assistance.
  • Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working in a co-managed SCCM/MECM and Intune environment.
  • Experience with Java remediation, JRE/JDK updates, or Java application troubleshooting.
  • Experience with ManageEngine Patch Manager Plus or similar enterprise patch-management tools.
  • Experience with Microsoft LAPS or other privileged-access/elevation technologies.
  • Experience with Windows endpoint security or remediation initiatives.
  • Experience with enterprise mobility/device management (MDM).
  • Experience with scripting or automation beyond basic PowerShell.
  • Prior experience supporting large-scale security or technology remediation projects.
  • Junior-level systems engineering or endpoint engineering experience.

job.title: VP - Letter of Credit / Client Processing Manager
job.description:
Position Summary:

The Vice President, Client Processing Manager will be responsible for handling Complex Letter of Credit structuring and manage the Letter of Credit life cycle for High-priority Trade clients by providing timely and quality support to the clients in facilitating their transactions and processes.  This role may also involve working with various stakeholders like Clients, FIs and NBFIs, simultaneously.
 
Responsibilities: 
  • As a documentary credit specialist, provide comprehensive training to the team in issuance, confirmation vetting, and document examination processes, while developing a skilled workforce to meet client requirements and support business objectives.
  • Ensure transactions and inquiries of High-priority clients are handled timely and accurately.
  • Applies in-depth knowledge and expertise on service offerings, proactive assessment and resolution of complex transaction issues. 
  • Assist Product and Relationship team with Operational/ transactional insights to manage client expectations. 
  • Participate in the risk and control committee and mitigate inherent and residual risk of the processes.
  • Act as an escalation point for complex problems and guide less experienced staff in resolving the same. Responsible for crafting solutions and methods to resolve issues at hand and similar issues in the future.
  • Responsible for structuring Letter of Credit & Guarantees vetting by collaborating with the Clients, Legal, Product, Risk & Compliance.
  • Prior experience working in a fast-paced, metric-driven environment, leading a team is required.
  • Leads workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.
  • Provides expert guidance on service offerings and resolves complex transaction issues.
 
Required Qualification:
  • 10+ years in Trade Finance domain (Letter of Credit, Document Examination, Guarantees/ Standby Letter of Credit) is required.  Well versed with UCP, URDG and ISP guidelines is preferred. Applicable local / regional licenses or certifications as required by the business.  Trade Certifications (example: CDCS, CSDG etc.) is added advantage.
  • A strong knowledge of Sanctions, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Boycott guidelines, as well as their relevance to Trade Finance, is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Advanced/Post graduation degree preferred.

job.title: Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst
job.description:
Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst

Join our client's dynamic team supporting the forefront of equity trading and regulatory compliance as a Trading Desk Associate Regulatory Analyst. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in ensuring our client's trading activities uphold the highest standards of market integrity and regulatory adherence. 

Job Details:

Duration: Permanent Full Time Employee
Pay Rate: $87,500- $125,000
Location:Hybrid 3-4x a week onsite NY

What You’ll Do:
  • Conduct thorough daily surveillance and data quality reviews of equity trading activity to ensure compliance with exchange and FINRA rules.
  • Oversee exception reports related to market manipulation risks, insider dealing, and abnormal trading patterns.
  • Manage daily CAT administration, data repairs, and internal reporting to maintain data integrity.
  • Analyze trading patterns for best execution, error rates, and overall trade surveillance effectiveness.
  • Perform comprehensive reviews covering various regulatory requirements including Reg NMS, Short Sales, and Trade Reporting.
  • Review electronic communications and contribute to regulatory inquiries and internal audits.
  • Collaborate with trading, compliance, and vendor teams to stay ahead of regulatory rule changes.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
  • Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of two (2) years in a Capital Markets supervision/compliance role within the financial services industry.
  • Knowledge of regulatory rules, including but not limited to CAT reporting, trade reporting, best execution, market manipulation, SEC order handling a plus.
  • Analytical skills to follow life cycle of orders, routes and executions.
  • Ability to interact directly with traders and sales personnel in order to understand particular circumstance of a transaction or instruct personnel on new procedures or requirements.
  • Strong verbal and written communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel.
  • Experience with Fidessa a plus.
Licenses/Certifications
  • FINRA Registrations Series 7, 55/57 (or ability to pass within 1 year)

job.title: Senior AWS Data Engineer
job.description:
Senior AWS Data Engineer
100% Remote (Must reside in lower 48)
Contract (through end of year) with potential conversion (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)


Overview
We’re seeking a Senior AWS Data Engineer to help build and support enterprise, cloud-native data solutions in a large Financial Services environment. This role is primarily focused on AWS engineering, cloud data integration, ETL development, and enterprise data platforms.
Experience with Markit EDM (Cadis) and/or Master Data Management (MDM) is a strong plus, but this is not a traditional “Markit EDM Developer” role. Strong AWS-focused data engineers with enterprise integration experience are encouraged to apply.

What You’ll Do
  • Design, develop, and support enterprise AWS data solutions
  • Build scalable ETL pipelines and cloud-native integrations
  • Develop and support REST APIs for enterprise data platforms
  • Create and maintain cloud-based data ingestion and transformation workflows
  • Partner with Architecture, Data Engineering, and Business teams to deliver scalable solutions
  • Troubleshoot production issues and optimize cloud performance
  • Support initiatives tied to data quality, governance, and enterprise integration
  • Deliver reusable, maintainable solutions using AWS best practices

Required Qualifications (Must Have)
  • Strong hands-on AWS engineering experience
  • Python
  • SQL
  • ETL development and data integration experience in enterprise environments
  • REST API development/integration experience
  • AWS services such as:
    • AWS Lambda
    • AWS Glue
    • EventBridge
  • Experience building cloud-native applications and supporting production systems

Preferred / Nice to Have
  • Markit EDM (Cadis) exposure
  • Master Data Management (MDM)
  • Security Master / Reference Data platforms or concepts
  • Snowflake
  • Kafka
  • C# / .NET
  • Financial Services background
  • Data governance / enterprise data management concepts

job.title: Nurse Practitioner or PA-C – Occupational Health
job.description:
Occupational Health Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant needed for a temp contract opportunity with Yoh’s manufacturing client located in Rothschild, WI. Flexible scheduling for 1 to 5 days a week!
The clinic offers occupational and preventative care for employees. You will be the only provider onsite, working alongside an Athletic Trainer. The position is focused on the protection of individuals from occupational and environmental hazards, illness and injury prevention, and health promotion. Job is anticipating to be temporary for about three months, with possibility for extension.
--> SHIFTS: Open availability for one to five days a week, between Monday and Friday. Preferred hours are 8:00am to 4:30pm, but can be flexible.

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Active/unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (ANP/FNP) or Physician Assistant (PA-C) license in state of Wisconsin
  • Minimum of (3) years' experience at a provider level
  • Previous experience in: Occupational/Employee Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Corrections, Primary Care, Internal Medicine, Orthopedics, Family Practice, or Critical Care type setting
  • Must be confident with drawing blood

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Medical surveillance: hearing conservation (audiometry exams), spirometry, drug testing, phlebotomy, etc.
  • Perform onsite physical assessments (pre-placement, return-to-work, fitness-for-duty) and coordinate treatment planning
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Provide onsite testing for strep pharyngitis, UTI, influenza, hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia
  • Work collaboratively to recognize environmental hazards and/or stresses in or from the workplace that may cause sickness, impaired health, or discomfort among the workers; create preventative measures that ensure the health and safety of employees
  • Provide support and case management for both work-related and non-work-related conditions for the purposes of reducing illness and absenteeism
  • Provide proactive and mobile engagement with the workforce from a prevention standpoint; seek out interactions with employees and build relationships
  • Respond to medical emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed

What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Nationally Certified (ANCC or AANP) or NCCP
  • Current BLS
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing certified (CAOHC/COHC)
  • Certified Drug Test Collector/Certified DOT Specimen Collector
  • Computer skills with previous experience using EMR and MS Office products
  • Interpersonal skills necessary to interview, teach and counsel patients and interact with multidisciplinary team members (EHS, HR, Medical Director)
  • Must be able to meet the physical demands of onsite work needs; ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 pounds, frequent standing, walking, sitting, squatting

What’s In It For You?
  • Grow your expertise in occupational medicine, injury prevention, ergonomics, and workplace wellness
  • Quality-focused clinical environment with dedicated time to educate, coach, and support patients
  • Great work-life balance with no nights, holidays, or weekends
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!


KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Healthcare specializes in occupational/employee health and we place healthcare professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Nurse Practitioner, and Physician Assistant openings!

job.title: UX/Market Researcher, Retail Assisted Experience
job.description:
UX/Market Researcher, Retail Assisted Experience

Join our team as a UX/Market Researcher, where you'll play a critical role in transforming the retail assisted tax preparation process. This exciting project offers a unique opportunity to lead observational research, user interviews, and time studies across diverse locations, directly influencing how clients work with advisors and experience our brand in innovative ways. Your expertise will help optimize office layouts, messaging, and service delivery, ensuring every touchpoint delivers maximum value and satisfaction.

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years of experience in consumer insights, market research, or user experience research
  • Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional research initiatives
  • Expertise in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including in-market testing
  • Strong storytelling and communication skills to simplify complex data
  • Experience in designing research plans, discussion guides, and analysis frameworks
  • Ability to conduct field research, time studies, and observational research in retail environments
  • Proficiency with tools such as Miro, Figma, and PowerPoint
  • Demonstrated collaboration with diverse teams and stakeholders
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience scaling or shaping research functions, frameworks, or operations
  • Success in driving insight-led transformations within matrixed organizations
  • Familiarity with customer journey tools like Qualtrics, UserTesting, or TheyDo
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to travel periodically to offices in Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Kansas City, Dallas, and other locations (up to 75%)
  • Comfortable working both on-site at our Austin offices and remotely, with 25-50% of work from home
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel purposes
This is an incredible chance to impact a flagship program and enhance client experiences across multiple markets. If you're a strategic thinker with a passion for research and innovation, we want to hear from you—apply today and help shape the future of retail assisted tax services!

job.description:
Institutional Equity Sales Team Coordinator / Sales Assistant

Join a leading team in the dynamic world of institutional equity sales! We are seeking an energetic, highly organized individual to support our client's busy Sales team, ensuring smooth daily operations and outstanding client service. This role offers a unique opportunity to be at the heart of capital markets activity, contributing directly to client engagement and operational excellence.

Job Details: 

Duration: Permanent FTE
Pay Rate: $75,000 W2
Location: Hybrid 3-4x a week onsite in NY

Key Responsibilities
  • Assist in preparing, formatting, and distributing daily market and sales notes to institutional clients.
  • Schedule and coordinate client meetings, conference calls, and Zoom meetings.
  • Log and maintain records of client interactions, meetings, and outreach activities.
  • Manage meeting requests and send calendar invitations for sales professionals and clients.
  • Support conference planning, client meeting allocations, and corporate access events.
  • Produce and distribute daily and weekly calendars detailing upcoming corporate access events and meetings.
  • Generate and maintain client model requests and related tracking reports.
  • Prepare daily corporate access reports for trading and sales teams.

  • Maintain and update client databases, contact information, and CRM records.
  • Process expense reports and assist with administrative documentation.
  • Coordinate special projects and provide general administrative support to the Institutional Equity Sales team.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required.
  • Prior experience in financial services, sales support, executive administration, or a related field is preferred.
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Zoom and Word.
  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a high-volume environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion and maintain confidentiality.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to supporting colleagues and clients.
Desired Attributes
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure without sacrificing accuracy.
  • Positive, team-oriented attitude.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Enjoys helping others and providing outstanding internal and external client service.
  • Flexible and adaptable in a constantly changing environment.
  • Professional demeanor with strong interpersonal skills.
  • M records.
  • Process expense reports and assist with administrative documentation.
  • Coordinate special projects and provide general administrative support to the Institutional Equity Sales team.

job.title: Mechanical/Systems Engineer (ONSITE)
job.description:
Mechanical/Systems Engineer (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Austin, TX.
  • Pay Rate: $50-59/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:

· Lead system-level design, analysis, and troubleshooting of etching, and chemical/gas delivery systems (gas panels, MFCs, FRCs, valves, and subsystems) across multiple business units
· Identify root causes of complex field issues (e.g., flow instability, contamination, pressure transients) and drive system-level corrective actions
· Develop and validate system-level models (analytical / CFD / digital twin) to predict flow, thermal, and contamination behavior
· Define system architecture requirements and drive alignment across component suppliers and internal teams
· Define, coordinate, and execute system-level and component-level test plans on COE lab test stands
· Analyze test data and generate detailed engineering reports to support qualification, reliability, and supplier 8D closure
· Drive correlation between lab testing, simulation models, and field performance
· Design and modify mechanical layouts, gas panel schematics, and subsystem architectures for new and existing platforms
· Develop specifications for critical flow control components (MFCs, FRCs, MFVs, valves, regulators)
· Support design for reliability (DfR), manufacturability (DfM), and serviceability (DfS) for chemical delivery subsystems
· Drive development and deployment of AI-based tools for troubleshooting, knowledge management, and component selection
· Partner with software/data teams to structure engineering knowledge for AI applications (e.g., knowledge agents, workflow automation)
· Identify opportunities to leverage AI/digital twin to reduce field escalations and accelerate root-cause analysis

Required:

· Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field
· 5–7 years of experience in mechanical/system engineering development
· Strong fundamentals in fluid dynamics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, and gas flow systems
· Experience with system-level problem solving (beyond component-level design)
· Hands-on experience with lab testing, data analysis, and engineering report generation
· Proficiency in CAD tools and engineering documentation (GD&T, drawings, specifications)

Preferred Qualifications
· Experience in semiconductor equipment, chemical delivery systems, or gas handling systems
· Knowledge of flow control devices (MFCs, FRCs, valves, regulators) and pressure/flow interactions
· Experience with system modeling tools (CFD, MATLAB, Python, or equivalent)
· Familiarity with AI/ML applications in engineering (data analysis, automation, knowledge systems)

What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest semiconductor manufacturing companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Manager
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a EHS Manager in Temple, TX. This role will be a responsible for responsible for leading and implementing environmental, health and safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies and procedures. The ideal candidate will have a strong experience in preparing and filing of Tier II reporting, Steers, Form R, Storm Water Annual Reporting.
 
Title: EHS Manager
Duration: DH
Pay: $120,000/yr
Location: Temple, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm(varies)


Position Summary:

The EHS Manager is responsible for leading and implementing environmental, health and safety programs to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and company policies and procedures. This role will drive a culture of safety, sustainability, and operational excellence within Palladio Industries chemical plant.

 

Key Responsibilities (Not inclusive):

· Site Compliance: Assure site compliance for all EHS regulations including preparing site permitting documents as needed in due time.

· Reporting: Prepare and submit correct reporting needed for the site to be compliant. Examples are wastewater quarterly and annual reporting and inspections, Tier II reporting, Steers reporting, Form R, Storm Water Annual Report, Industrial hazardous waste report, P2P (pollution prevention plan), TCEQ operating status report, among others.

· Policies, procedures and site communication material: Develop, implement and maintain EHS policies, procedures and site communication material in compliance with OSHA, EPA, PSM, and other applicable regulations.

· Risk assessment & Incident Investigation: Conduct risk assessments and drive implementation of corrective actions to mitigate hazards in the workplace. Lead incident investigations and root cause analysis to identify effective corrective and preventive actions. Follow up on implementation.

· Performance: drive EHS cultural positive change and site improvement. In accordance with Site Manager/Industrial Director, develop and maintain an effective EHS KPI grid to track improvement.

· Documentation Management: Keep all EHS records up to date and organized.

· People management and development: Develop and oversee EHS training programs for employees and contractors. Train and mentor site employees and contractors ensuring compliance with regulation, internal procedures and industry standards. Train employees and contractors for PIT (powered Industrial trucks) including forklift, boom lift, scissor lift etc. Foster a culture of safety, accountability, and continuous improvement. Be the positive change agent.

· Audits and inspections: Conduct internal audits and coordinate/lead external regulatory inspections making sure site is ready and prepared at its best.

· Communication: Make sure all stakeholders are informed as needed. Prepare periodic and on request communication material and sessions to maintain positive traction and site visibility.

· Cross functional initiatives: Lead or participate in company cross functional initiatives.

· Designated personal certifications and/or licenses must be retained as hired or designated.

· Follow and utilize standard operating procedures.

· Comply with company policies, required regulatory and legal guidelines.

· Participate in all site safety training, activities, and drills. Safety is crucial to position.

 

Position Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Occupational Health & Safety, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field.

5+ years of EHS experience in a chemical manufacturing industrial environment.

Experience preparing site permitting documents

Experience preparing and filing site EHS reporting (e.g. Tier II, Steers, Form R, Storm water, etc.)- Required

Strong knowledge of OSHA, PHA, EPA, PHA,PSM, DOT and Environmental regulations.

Experience with risk assessment, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.

Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to manage multiple priorities and drive organizational change.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

Professional certifications such as CSP (Certified Safety Professional), CIH (Certified Industrial Hygienist), Six Sigma or equivalent experience.

Experience with Process Safety Management (PSM), PHA and hazardous chemical handling.

 

Skills/Experience:

· +5 years’ proven work experience as a EHS Manager or similar role in a chemical industrial setting.

· Experience with hazardous and Flammable chemicals, PSM (Process Safety Management), PHA, Waste management, and chemical industry site permitting. Familiarity with industry standard equipment.

· Proven managerial experience and good leadership skills.

· Adequate knowledge of business and management principles (budgeting, strategic planning, resource allocation and human resources).

· Computer literate, proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (specifically Word, Excel, Outlook and Power Point).

· Ability to lead/drive change, and influence/mentor others.

· Able to develop networks and build relationships.

· Ability to be trained in standard operating procedures.

· Excellent oral and written communication skills.

· Ability to read write and comprehend English and follow verbal instructions.

· Good trouble-shooting and problem-solving skills

· Basic math skills

 

Work Environment:

The activities of this position will include outdoor activities. This position will have periods of exposure to the elements. While performing the duties of this job, the employee will be trained to safely and effectively work around energy of various types, including moving mechanical parts and vibration. The position includes designated areas where Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) must be worn. The typical PPE includes: Ear Protection, Respiratory Protection, Eye Protection, Hard Hats, Safety Glasses, Steel-Toed shoes or boots, Gloves, Chemical Protective Suits.

 

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk and hear. This position is very active and requires standing, walking, bending, kneeling, twisting, stooping, sitting, crouching, crawling, and climbing ladders. The employee may frequently lift and/or move items of 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. Position may require entering confined spaces from time to time (under permit control).

job.title: Senior TPRM - GRC Consultant
job.description:
Senior TPRM and GRC Consultant
                                 Third-Party Risk Management Specialist

Work Arrangement: Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite 
Location: Plano Texas or McKinney Texas
Start Date: Immediate

POSITION SUMMARY
IT Third-Party Risk Management professional to lead and strengthen the TPRM program within the Governance, Risk, and Compliance function.
  • This position manages the complete third-party risk lifecycle, including vendor onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, periodic reviews, remediation tracking, ongoing monitoring, and offboarding.
  • The ideal candidate has extensive experience evaluating technology vendors, identifying security and compliance risks, improving TPRM processes, and working independently with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Hands-on AuditBoard experience is strongly preferred, although candidates with strong RSA Archer experience will also be considered.
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Lead the end-to-end third-party risk management lifecycle for new and existing vendors.
  • Conduct vendor due diligence, security risk assessments, control reviews, and periodic reassessments.
  • Evaluate vendor compliance with organizational security requirements and regulatory and industry standards.
  • Identify control gaps, document risk findings, recommend corrective actions, and track remediation through completion.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve TPRM policies, procedures, assessment methodologies, workflows, and supporting documentation.
  • Partner with Procurement, Legal, Information Security, Compliance, and business teams to incorporate security requirements into vendor selection and contracting.
  • Maintain and optimize AuditBoard or RSA Archer for vendor assessments, workflow management, documentation, issue tracking, and reporting.
  • Monitor third-party risk metrics, emerging trends, remediation progress, and overall compliance posture.
  • Prepare risk reports, dashboards, and program updates for senior leadership.
  • Support internal and external audits involving third-party risk, cybersecurity governance, and regulatory compliance.
  • Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, regulatory changes, and third-party risk management best practices.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Minimum of five years of direct Third-Party Risk Management experience within an IT Security, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, or GRC function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendor onboarding, due diligence, risk assessments, control-gap identification, remediation tracking, periodic reviews, and offboarding.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, control standards, and regulatory requirements, including NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and CCPA.
  • Hands-on experience with AuditBoard, RSA Archer, or a comparable GRC platform.
  • Experience partnering with Procurement, Legal, Compliance, Information Security, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, reporting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work onsite Wednesday through Friday.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Hands-on experience configuring or optimizing AuditBoard TPRM workflows.
  • Experience developing, implementing, or maturing an enterprise Third-Party Risk Management program.
  • Experience creating executive-level risk reports, dashboards, and metrics.
  • CTPRP, CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or another relevant risk or cybersecurity certification.

job.description:
Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) needed for a temporary contract opportunity with Yoh's medical center client located in Rothschild, Wisconsin.

This position supports the onsite clinic for a well-known manufacturing facility. The assignment is anticipated to start the week of September 7 and is expected to run for approximately three months, with the potential for extension. This role will provide onsite occupational health and preventive care services to help reduce and treat workplace injuries and illnesses.

Schedule (flexible):
40 hours per week available, Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. (flexible - part time or full time)

Top Skills You Should Possess:
  • Experience as a Licensed Physician Assistant (PA) or Licensed Nurse Practitioner (NP) is highly preferred.
  • Positive attitude, excellent customer service skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Responsible, friendly, and helpful with strong multitasking abilities.

job.title: Battery Cell Process Engineer - (Entry Level)
job.description:
Battery Cell Process Engineer - (Entry Level)
The Battery Cell Process Engineer will provide hands-on support for laboratory-scale battery cell development and prototyping activities. Services will focus on assisting senior process and cell design engineers with pilot-line operations, pouch cell assembly, process improvement, equipment upkeep, and quality control for experimental battery builds.

Services:
• Support laboratory-scale pouch cell production, including slurry preparation, electrode coating, calendaring, slitting or die cutting, stacking, tab attachment, pouch sealing, electrolyte introduction, and cell formation.
• Operate, inspect, calibrate, and maintain pilot-line equipment, tooling, dry-room environments, glove boxes, and related fabrication systems.
• Assist with Design of Experiments (DOEs) to evaluate process variables and improve cell consistency, yield, uniformity, and performance.
• Conduct in-process quality checks, including electrode thickness, coating or loading consistency, component alignment, and pouch seal integrity, and record results in applicable tracking systems.
• Investigate common fabrication issues, such as coating defects, delamination, misalignment, incomplete wetting, and sealing problems, and support corrective actions under senior engineering guidance.
• Maintain accurate assembly travelers, process records, equipment logs, SOPs, safety documentation, and other technical documentation for new materials, chemistries, and cell formats.

Required:
• Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
• At least one year of hands-on experience with laboratory battery manufacturing, pilot-line equipment, or pouch cell assembly.
• Experience working in laboratory, cleanroom, dry-room, or glove-box environments while handling chemicals, battery materials, and mechanical assembly tools.
• Familiarity with lithium-ion cell manufacturing processes, such as slurry preparation, electrode coating, calendaring, stacking, electrolyte filling, and sealing.
• Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and adherence to laboratory, hazardous-material, and safety procedures.

Pluses:
• Experience with pouch cell assembly equipment, including tab welding, electrolyte filling, and pouch sealing systems.
• Familiarity with SPC, yield tracking, process data analysis, and tools such as Python, MATLAB, JMP, or Excel.
• Understanding of how variation in upstream manufacturing steps can affect cell quality and electrochemical performance.

job.title: Principal Enterprise Architect
job.description:
Job Title:Principal Enterprise Architect
Location:Bethlehem, PA OR Holmdel, NJ OR NYC
Job Type- Full Time
Industry- Insurance

Our client which is is one of the largest and oldest mutual life insurance companies is seeking a Principal Enterprise Architect

Principal Enterprise Architect
Join a complex, highly regulated enterprise and help shape the technology strategy, architecture standards, and modernization roadmap across the organization.

This senior leadership role connects enterprise strategy with practical execution across business capabilities, applications, data, integration, cloud, platforms, security, and emerging technologies. You will influence major technology decisions, guide enterprise transformation, and partner with business and technology leaders across a federated environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Define enterprise architecture principles, standards, target-state designs, and transition roadmaps.
  • Lead architecture for strategic initiatives, modernization programs, and enterprise-wide technology decisions.
  • Evaluate solutions based on business value, cost, risk, resilience, scalability, and long-term sustainability.
  • Drive simplification, platform reuse, legacy modernization, and improved enterprise integration.
  • Support architecture governance, review boards, standards councils, and exception management.
  • Partner with engineering, cloud, data, AI, security, infrastructure, and business technology leaders.
  • Incorporate cybersecurity, privacy, resilience, regulatory, and operational requirements into architecture decisions.
  • Mentor architects and senior technology professionals while advancing architecture practices across the enterprise.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, domain architecture, or senior technology strategy.
  • Broad expertise across applications, integration, data, AI, cloud, security, and platforms.
  • Experience leading architecture for large-scale transformation in a complex enterprise.
  • Strong background in architecture governance, standards, target-state planning, and strategic decision-making.
  • Ability to influence across organizational boundaries without direct authority.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
Preferred
  • Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience in a federated technology organization.
  • Knowledge of cloud modernization, APIs, platform engineering, data ecosystems, and enterprise integration.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • TOGAF, SAFe, AWS, Azure, GCP, or comparable certifications.
If you are a strategic, business-minded architect who can connect enterprise vision to scalable technology solutions, we would like to hear from you.

job.title: Electrical Design Engineer - Analog/mixed
job.description:
Join Our Team as an Electrical Design Engineer – Analog/Mixed Signal!

Are you passionate about advancing cutting-edge avionics and power electronics systems? We’re seeking a talented Electrical Design Engineer to lead the design and development of high-performance analog and mixed-signal circuits that drive innovation across the aerospace industry. At the forefront of technology, you’ll play a vital role in creating avionics, power management, lithium battery systems, and sensor interfacing solutions that meet the highest standards for safety and reliability.

This exciting opportunity offers a chance to work across the entire product lifecycle—from concept to certification—on projects that impact commercial, business, defense, and advanced air mobility markets. Bring your expertise to a collaborative environment committed to excellence, integrity, and professional growth.

Required Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • Minimum of 5 years in analog and mixed-signal circuit design, especially for precision instrumentation, signal conditioning, and IC applications
  • Proficiency with schematic capture and simulation tools such as PADS, LTSpice, or similar
  • Strong understanding of mixed-signal simulation, PCB layout, and signal integrity
  • Knowledge of impedance matching, EMI/EMC standards (RTCA DO-160, MIL-STD-810/461)
  • Experience with power electronics, including AC/DC, DC/DC, and DC/AC conversion
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and results-oriented mindset
  • Superior verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
Nice to Have Skills:

  • Experience with Design for Manufacturing (DFM) and Design for Test (DFT)
  • Previous work within the aviation industry
Preferred Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
  • At least 5 years of relevant experience in analog/mixed-signal design
  • Experience designing avionics or aerospace systems is a plus
Other Requirements:

  • Ability to perform hardware testing, troubleshooting, and soldering in both office and lab environments
  • Familiarity with test equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and logic analyzers
  • Willingness to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including layout, mechanical, software, and certification engineers
  • Occasional travel may be required for certifications or project coordination
This is your chance to make a meaningful impact in a dynamic, innovative environment. If you’re ready to contribute to high-stakes aerospace designs and grow your career, apply now and elevate your engineering journey with us!

job.title: HR Coordinator
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Human Resources Coordinator in Temple, TX. This role will be a responsible for administrative support role within the HR function, providing comprehensive assistance to the HR Manager across key HR disciplines. This role is heavily focused on HR operations and administration, including recruiting and hiring support, onboarding and training coordination, payroll tasks and benefits administration using ADP Workforce Now, employee recordkeeping, and HR compliance reporting.

The Human Resources Coordinator plays a critical administrative support role within the HR function, providing comprehensive assistance to the HR Manager across key HR disciplines. This role is heavily focused on HR operations and administration, including recruiting and hiring support, onboarding and training coordination, payroll tasks and benefits administration using ADP Workforce Now, employee recordkeeping, and HR compliance reporting. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to handle sensitive information with the highest level of confidentiality and professionalism. This position deals with a diverse group of internal contacts at all levels of the organization and company vendors. Independent judgment is required to plan, prioritize and organize diversified workload. This position reports to the HR Manager.

Title: HR Coordinator
Location: Temple, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm (varies)

Responsibilities:

Recruiting & Hiring
  • Candidate Sourcing: Assist in Posting and Managing open job requisitions on career sites.
  • Screening: Assist in reviewing resumes and scheduling interviews with hiring managers.
  • Pre-employment: Facilitate background checks, employment verifications, and schedule preemployment screenings
  • Other: In conjunction with HR Manager, participates in recruiting operations such as job fairs, meetings, community events, local colleges, etc.
Onboarding & Training
  • New Hire Administration: Process new hire paperwork, and manage Form I-9 compliance.
  • Orientation Onboarding: Conduct new employee orientations, provide company handbooks, and arrange for building access or equipment and uniforms.
  • Training Coordination: Organize the logistics for new hire onboarding training, company-wide training and development programs. Ownership of training tracking for the entire company (creating matrix’s and tracking in Excel & ADP Workforce Now).
Timecard & Benefits Administration
  • Benefits Management: Assist with new hire benefits administration, annual open enrollment and internal communications of health, dental, and retirement plans
  • Payroll Support: Track employee hours, process timesheets, and audit payroll entries to ensure accuracy.
  • Leave Tracking: Monitor vacation, sick time, and leave of absence requests.
Employee Records & Retention
  • Record Keeping: Maintain accurate, confidential, and compliant hard-copy and digital employee files using an HRIS (ADP Workforce Now).
  • Compliance: Keep all employee records in compliance with recordkeeping and regulatory laws.
  • Ensure proper documentation for all employee lifecycle events (hire, transfer, disciplinary action, termination)
  • Audit HR records regularly for compliance and accuracy
  • Safeguard confidential employee information at all times with discretion and integrity
Employee Relations
  • HR/Company /Departmental Events Planning & Coordination
  • Rewards and Recognition Administration
Administration & Reporting
  • Support: HR Manager in the day-to-day HR activities
  • Compliance: Ensure company policies align with local, state, and federal labor laws.
  • Reporting: Compile data on HR metrics (e.g., turnover, time-to-hire) to assist with department audits and strategic planning
  • Organization: Daily HR Administrative duties such as data entry, filing and organizing of HR departmental files.
  • OSHA 300 Logs: Assist in maintenance of these logs
  • Departmental internal SOPs: Coordination and Creation
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date employee records in HRIS and personnel files

job.description:
Licensed Psychologist needed for a full-time, DIRECT HIRE opportunity with Yoh’s non-profit client located in San Jose, CA. We have multiple openings available with a choice of part-time or full-time hours!! Additional openings available in Salinas, CA.

Work at a company that is committed to specializing in supporting individuals with developmental disabilities (and their families). Provide psychological assessments, behavioral consultations, and clinical support as part of a collaborative, interdisciplinary team.
 

Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active Psychologist license in state of California
  • At least two years of experience with developmental disabilities or behavioral health
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and clinical documentation skills
  • Knowledge of the principles, methods, techniques, and materials of psychology in serving the developmentally disabled

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Evaluate cognitive and adaptive functioning, develop behavior support plans, and offer guidance to clients, families, and staff to promote independence and quality of life
  • Assist in matters related to psychology, specifically to the provision of comprehensive services to people with developmental disabilities
  • Participate as teacher/consultant to personnel involved in the development and delivery of services to people with developmental disabilities
  • Assist in the development of new programs where need arises and in the ongoing evaluation of programs for the developmentally disabled within the region
  • Perform other related duties as assigned (ie conservatorship petitions and competency to stand trial evaluations, and diverse plans)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • Ability to work 8am to 5pm shifts between Monday and Friday
  • Doctorate in Clinical or Educational Psychology
  • Use of an automobile, possession of a valid driver's license, and automobile liability insurance for the minimum amount prescribed by law or the ability to provide independent transportation

What’s In It For You?

  • Great work-life balance with flexible schedule options (Monday through Friday highly desired!)
  • Telecommute opportunity available within first 6 months!
  • Work with a well-established, mission-driven non-profit known for quality focused care
  • Meaningful work and great for someone passionate about person-centered care, advocacy, and community impact
  • Excellent benefit packages including FREE medical coverage along with free dental and vision insurance for dependents, longevity Bonus incentive, CalPERS pension plan plus 403(b) retirement plan, 5 days of paid education leave per fiscal year, generous amount of PTO, and more!

job.title: Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Systems Integration Engineer
Seeking a hands-on Systems Integration Engineer to support the integration, bring-up, troubleshooting, and validation of complex electromechanical systems. This role is responsible for combining hardware, software, and mechanical components into fully functioning platforms, supporting prototype builds, system validation, and manufacturing readiness. This is a primarily onsite position with approximately 30% travel to engineering labs, supplier locations, and manufacturing facilities to support builds, integration activities, and issue resolution.

Scope:
• Integrate hardware, electrical, and software components into complete system builds.
• Perform system bring-up, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis on prototype and production platforms.
• Debug complex issues spanning mechanical, electrical, networking, and software domains.
• Execute system validation testing, collect data, and verify subsystem performance and interface requirements.
• Partner with engineering, manufacturing, and external suppliers to support system builds, production readiness, and resolve integration challenges.
• Document findings, communicate technical issues, and work closely with design teams to implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

Required:
• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
• Hands-on experience integrating and troubleshooting complex hardware/software systems in a laboratory, manufacturing, or production environment.
• Strong understanding of electrical, mechanical, and embedded system fundamentals.
• Experience performing structured root cause analysis and debugging multidisciplinary system issues.
• Working knowledge of Python, C++, or another object-oriented programming language.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, manufacturing, supplier, and operations teams.

Pluses:
• Experience with complex electromechanical systems, robotics, autonomous systems, industrial automation, automotive platforms, or similar technologies.
• Familiarity with sensors, embedded computing, wiring harnesses, power distribution, networking, and actuator systems.
• Hands-on experience using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, and other electronic diagnostic equipment.
• Experience supporting prototype builds, manufacturing integration, new product introduction (NPI), or production launches in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Estimated Min Rate: $35.00
Estimated Max Rate: $50.00/hr +. Depends on work experience.

job.title: Production Technician
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Production Technician in Rockville, MD.  The Production Technician will support the veterinary diagnostic manufacturing processes. General responsibilities include assembling, filling, labeling, and kitting small light-weight products in a manufacturing laboratory environment. The position will also assist with order picking, packing and warehousing.

Duties and Responsibilities:
  • Performing Manual tasks such as bottle filling and device assembly, pouching, labeling, and kitting.
  • Adhere to and accurately complete production documentation.
  • Perform set-ups, changeovers, and cleanups of work areas.
  • Maintain a safe and clean working environment.
  • Assistance with warehouse order picking, packing, and general warehousing.
Targeted Skills:
  • Comprehensive understanding of basic scientific principles and biotech manufacturing processes.
  • Comprehensive understanding of and experience with GMP and ISO regulations.
  • Able to communicate technical matters clearly and professionally while guiding teams to compliant, creative.
  • solutions, Able to communicate clearly and firmly when noncompliant or potentially non-compliant situations are identified.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced environment handling multiple priorities with attention to meeting deadlines while working effectively and efficiently.
  • A willingness to think outside of the box and adapt industry best practices and trends to our small but growing business.
  • Highly organized with exceptional written and verbal communication skills. Must be fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to problem solve with several variables in a methodical and careful manner.
  • Strong functional proficiency using Windows, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint as well as the ability to quickly learn various job-specific computer applications.
  • Ability to work with colleagues, supervisors, vendors, and customers as needed.
  • Ability to be flexible and adaptable, willingness to help when needed.
  • Reliable attendance mandatory.
  • Able to walk and stand for extended periods of time on a variety of hard surfaces.
  • Ability to work in a warm, cold, or dry environment in a manufacturing production setting with exposure to working near moving mechanical parts.

job.description:
Job title:Trade Finance Operations Specialist – Letters of Credit
Location: Pittsburg, PA- Hybrid
Type: Full Time
Industry: Finance

Our client is world largest largest custody bank.

Position Summary:
Trade Finance Operations Specialist – Letters of Credit will be responsible for handling Complex LC structuring and manage the LC life cycle for High-priority Trade clients by providing timely and quality support to the clients in facilitating their transactions and processes.  This role may also involve working with various stakeholders like Clients, FIs and NBFIs, simultaneously.

Responsibilities: 

  • Ensure transactions and inquiries of High-priority clients are handled timely and accurately.
  • Applies in-depth knowledge and expertise on service offerings, proactive assessment and resolution of complex transaction issues. 
  • Assist Product and Relationship team with Operational/ transactional insights to manage client expectations. 
  • Participate in the risk review sessions conducted by the Team to identify mitigate inherent and residual risk of the processes.
  • As a documentary credit specialist, support the Team in crafting solutions and methods to resolve issues at hand and similar issues in the future.
  • Responsible for structuring LC & Guarantees vetting by collaborating with the Clients, Legal, Product, Risk & Compliance.
  • Contribute to workflow optimization and process improvement using best practices and technology.
  • Provides expert guidance on service offerings and resolves complex transaction issues.
 
Required Qualification:

  • 5-7 years of total work experience with at least 5+ years in Trade Finance domain (LC, Document Examination, Guarantees/ Standby LC) is required.  Well versed with UCP, URDG and ISP guidelines are preferred. Applicable local / regional licenses or certifications as required by the business.  Trade Certifications (example: CDCS, CSDG etc.) is added advantage.
  • A strong knowledge of Sanctions, Anti-Money Laundering (AML), and Boycott guidelines, as well as their relevance to Trade Finance, is highly desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent combination of education and experience is required. Advanced/Post graduation degree preferred.
