job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
Business Analyst

Join a team where strong documentation and sharp analysis directly shape how work gets done. As a Business Analyst, you’ll partner with business users and project teams to capture current-state processes, document requirements and application dependencies, and help drive initiatives forward with clear, accurate, and usable process artifacts. 

Job Details: 

Duration: 12 months contract with potential extension
Pay Rate: $34.24-$52.82
Hybrid- only as needed onsite- Audubon PA

Responsibilities

Develop a deep understanding of the business functions and processes
  • Document, review and update business process requirements based on team members’ and client’s feedback
  • Serve as a business liaison between clients and project teams to help understand user interaction
  • Establish, monitor and maintain high client satisfaction levels
  • Document and track problems in client business systems or processes to provide recommendations for future efficiencies
  • Assist project manager maintaining project schedule and coordination of team work towards project milestones
  • Strong communication skills in working with a team and providing in time updates to project manager
  • Assist team in getting the current deliverable in a timely manner; Jump in and assist where needed to accomplish tasks such as testing and deployments
  • Ability to develop/update/deliver training materials for endusers

Required Skills and Experience

 
  • B.S. degree in computer science, management information systems, Business Administration, or equivalent experience
  • 1-5 years of relevant experience
  • Someone who is energetic and passionate about their work, extremely positive and solution driven
  • Detail oriented
  • Ability to lead assigned tasks to completion
  • Excellent requirements gathering skills and experience
  • Listening to customers and understanding their current processes and needs
  • Ability to work independently, with minimum supervision
  • Experience working on crossfunctional teams, on projects in a matrixed environment
  • Experience working with business and technical staff to define, document, and track software requirements and design
  • Most recent roles should show increasing responsibility as BA in agile environment
  • Familiarity with Agile methodology
  • Skilled at documentation best practices such as using revision history/version control
  • Experience using JIRA and Confluence

job.title: Occupational Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed for a full-time, 9/80 contract opportunity with Yoh’s well-known client located in Redondo Beach, CA.
 

This onsite clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative health services to support a large corporation. Interesting job getting to be a key part in keeping employees healthy, safe, and able to perform at their best through injury triage, wellness initiatives, and ongoing workplace health support.
-->SHIFTS: 9/80 schedule: Monday-Friday 6:30am to 4:00pm (30 minute lunch)
- One week Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm and Friday 6:30am to 3:00pm and next week, Monday-Thursday 6:30am to 4:00pm.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of California
  • Previous experience highly preferred: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Strong presentation skills

What You’ll Be Doing:

job.title: Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist for our healthcare client. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving complex billing and reimbursement issues while maximizing revenue recovery through expert claims analysis, denial management, and payment resolution. The Senior Revenue Cycle Specialist will collaborate with insurance carriers, patients, leadership, and cross-functional teams to ensure timely reimbursement, identify process improvements, and support overall revenue cycle performanc. Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.

Industry:Diagnostics
Location: Onsite / Hybrid (Based on Client Need)

Job Functions
  • Investigate, resolve, and collect payment on complex healthcare billing and reimbursement transactions.
  • Research and resolve unpaid claims, billing discrepancies, denials, and customer complaints to ensure timely and accurate reimbursement.
  • Contact insurance carriers, patients, and other stakeholders to resolve account issues and maximize payment.
  • Review insurance and patient account correspondence to identify outstanding issues and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Analyze billing trends and identify recurring reimbursement issues, recommending process improvements to reduce denials and improve collections.
  • Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams to develop solutions that improve revenue cycle performance and operational efficiency.
  • Review billing documentation to ensure compliance with payer requirements and regulatory guidelines.
  • Communicate effectively with insurance companies, patients, and internal leadership regarding account status, payment issues, and resolution strategies.
  • Develop and maintain expertise in payer fee schedules, reimbursement methodologies, and denial management.
  • Apply advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer policies to maximize reimbursement opportunities.
  • Monitor and work aging reports to resolve outstanding accounts receivable and reduce claim aging.
  • Support complex revenue cycle projects and initiatives requiring advanced reimbursement knowledge.
  • Assist with special projects and perform additional duties as assigned.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of four (4) years of experience in a complex healthcare billing and reimbursement environment.
  • Advanced knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance reimbursement processes.
  • Experience with insurance accounts receivable, denial management, and claims resolution.
  • Experience in Anatomic Pathology or Diagnostic Laboratory billing is required.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare billing regulations, payer policies, and reimbursement methodologies.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex billing issues independently.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to work effectively with patients, insurance carriers, clients, leadership, and internal stakeholders.
  • Ability to identify trends, recommend process improvements, and contribute to operational efficiencies.
  • Self-motivated with strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, accountability, and commitment to delivering exceptional customer service.

job.title: Quantitative Data Analyst – Survey Analytics
job.description:
Quantitative Data Analyst – Survey Analytics
We are seeking a part-time Quantitative Data Analyst to support analysis of a large annual developer experience survey. This role will focus on cleaning survey data, automating chart generation, and producing standardized reference tables that can be used by a separate resource for manual deck creation and formatting.

Scope:
• Ingest, clean, and process raw survey data, including becoming familiar with required data columns, cuts, and reference structures.
• Develop efficient R scripts to automate approximately 4–7 chart types across roughly 150 data cuts.
• Standardize chart outputs, including labeling and formatting, for easy use in downstream presentation development.
• Generate reference tables covering directional changes, longitudinal comparisons, and benchmark comparisons.
• Support ad-hoc analysis, extrapolations, and revisions based on stakeholder feedback.

Required:
• Strong proficiency in data analysis and statistical programming using R.
• Experience automating iterative data visualization and chart generation.
• Ability to clean, structure, and analyze large survey datasets.
• Experience producing standardized analytical outputs and reference tables.
• Familiarity with using AI tools to support or automate chart creation.
• Ability to complete the primary analysis and deliverables within approximately 5–10 working days on a part-time basis.

Pluses:
• Experience with benchmarking, satisfaction, or developer experience surveys.
• Background supporting survey analysis for large enterprise organizations.
• Python experience for supplemental scripting or automation.

Deliverables:
• Standardized R/Python scripts for iterative chart generation.
• Repository of correctly labeled chart images, such as PNGs.
• Master reference table for benchmark and longitudinal comparisons.

Timeline:
• September 28: Survey data provided for analysis.
• October 8: Initial scripts, charts, and reference tables delivered.
• October 12–23: Ad-hoc analysis, revisions, and follow-up work based on stakeholder feedback.
• Dates may shift by approximately one week depending on survey fielding.

job.title: Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer
job.description:
Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer?

About the Role: We are seeking a highly capable and self-directed Senior Vehicle Software Test & Development Operations Engineer to lead vehicle-level software validation and development operations across embedded domains—chassis, body, thermal, and more. This role is critical in ensuring high software quality through robust in-vehicle testing and operational readiness of the development fleet.
You’ll collaborate closely with software, calibration, integration, and test engineering teams to plan, execute, and debug vehicle-level test campaigns, while driving day-to-day development activities with a high degree of autonomy. This role will also require travel to winter test proving grounds and other company test sites to support seasonal validation efforts and major release milestones.

Key Responsibilities:
 
  • Own and lead vehicle-level test planning and execution for pre-merge and post-merge software builds across multiple domains (chassis controls, body systems, thermal, etc.)
  • Drive end-to-end development fleet readiness including software flashing, configuration, instrumentation setup, and release coordination
  • Operate and evaluate vehicles in structured and exploratory test routes, validating embedded feature behavior and performance
  • Partner with technicians and garage teams to manage vehicle setup, diagnostics, and resolution of hardware/software issues
  • Lead issue triage and debugging efforts using CAN tools (e.g., CANalyzer, Canape, Vehicle Spy), log analysis, and collaboration with engineering owners
  • Document, track, and escalate software issues with clear context, reproduction steps, and logs in tools like Jira
  • Contribute to the creation and improvement of vehicle-level test processes, test plans, and validation workflows
  • Travel as needed to proving grounds (e.g., winter testing), test tracks, and company engineering sites to support vehicle testing and fleet operations
  • Afternoon, weekend, or nighttime testing may be required depending on development needs and test schedules
  • Provide mentorship to junior engineers and operators on validation best practices and vehicle test procedures



Basic Qualifications:
 
  • 5+ years of experience in vehicle-level software validation, systems integration, or embedded development
  • Strong proficiency with CAN tools, diagnostic interfaces, and log analysis for embedded systems
  • Demonstrated ability to operate development vehicles safely and confidently in a test environment
  • Hands-on experience working with cross-functional teams including SW engineers, technicians, and test operators
  • Solid understanding of automotive embedded systems, including body modules, thermal management, and chassis control ECUs
  • Proven track record of debugging complex vehicle-level issues

Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field
  • Accredited proving ground driver training
  • Experience with electric vehicle platforms and modern vehicle software architecture
  • Familiarity with software release tools and test case management systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel to remote test sites (including cold weather and high-altitude locations)
  • Experience supporting vehicle bring-up, calibration loops, or multi-domain integration testing
  • Knowledge of functional safety principles (ISO 26262) or automotive process frameworks (ASPICE)

job.title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development for a direct-hire opportunity with a pharmaceutical manufacturing organization in Rosenberg, TX (Greater Houston).

This is a senior-level, hands-on individual contributor position focused on pharmaceutical formulation and process development, experimental execution, scale-up, troubleshooting, and technology transfer. The ideal candidate will bring significant pharmaceutical-industry experience and the ability to personally translate product-development objectives into scientifically sound experiments, robust manufacturing processes, and successful scale-up and technology-transfer activities.

Title: Senior Scientist – Pharmaceutical Formulation & Process Development
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Salary: $105,000–$120,000/year
Location: Rosenberg, TX – Greater Houston
Schedule: Monday–Friday, approximately 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.
Work Arrangement: Fully onsite

Limited relocation assistance may be available in the form of a sign-on bonus for qualified candidates.

Position Summary
Working under the direction of the Director of Research and Development, the Senior Scientist will personally design and execute formulation and process-development studies from laboratory scale through pilot, engineering, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.

The position requires a strong and consistent presence in the laboratory and pilot-plant environment. This is not a people-management or primarily administrative role. The Senior Scientist is expected to remain technically hands-on while serving as a senior scientific resource to other members of the R&D organization.

The role may support pharmaceutical finished-dosage-form programs including oral products, liquids, semi-solids, and suppository/pessary products, as applicable, across cosmetic, 510(k), ANDA, NDA, and other development programs.

Responsibilities
  • Design and personally execute pharmaceutical formulation and process-development experiments.
  • Develop and optimize finished drug-product formulations and manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate API and excipient properties, compatibility, formulation robustness, and product performance.
  • Design scientifically sound experimental plans based on product objectives and development risks.
  • Generate, analyze, and interpret experimental data and recommend scientifically justified next steps.
  • Apply Quality by Design (QbD) and Design of Experiments (DOE) principles to formulation and process development.
  • Identify and evaluate Critical Quality Attributes (CQAs), Critical Material Attributes (CMAs), and Critical Process Parameters (CPPs).
  • Perform process optimization, characterization, scale-up, and technology-transfer activities.
  • Translate laboratory processes into robust pilot-scale and commercial manufacturing processes.
  • Evaluate manufacturing variables including mixing, shear, homogenization, temperature, order of addition, processing time, hold time, transfer, and filling parameters.
  • Troubleshoot formulation, process, scale-up, and manufacturing issues through experimentation and root-cause analysis.
  • Provide hands-on technical support during pilot, engineering, scale-up, registration, validation, technology-transfer, and manufacturing activities.
  • Support investigations involving process deviations, product-performance issues, and manufacturing challenges.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Engineering, Analytical Development, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and Project Management.
  • Prepare and maintain laboratory notebooks, protocols, batch documentation, experimental records, technical reports, and development summaries.
  • Operate appropriate laboratory and pilot-scale pharmaceutical processing equipment.
  • Support technical-transfer documentation and manufacturing implementation.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor scientists and laboratory technicians without formal personnel-management responsibility.
  • Manage multiple technical assignments while maintaining ownership of quality, documentation, and timelines.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • PhD required in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • Minimum of seven years of relevant pharmaceutical-industry development experience required.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience in pharmaceutical formulation development and process development required.
  • Demonstrated experience taking pharmaceutical products or processes from laboratory development through scale-up, pilot, engineering, GMP manufacturing, and/or commercialization.
  • Strong experience with pharmaceutical process optimization, process characterization, troubleshooting, and technology transfer.
  • Advanced knowledge of QbD, DOE, CQAs, CMAs, CPPs, process robustness, and pharmaceutical manufacturing principles.
  • Experience with oral dosage forms, oral liquids, liquid formulations, semi-solids, and/or suppository/pessary products preferred.
  • Experience supporting ANDA, NDA, 505(b)(2), 510(k), cosmetic, or other regulated product-development programs preferred.
  • Experience with engineering batches, registration batches, validation/PPQ activities, or commercial manufacturing support preferred.
  • CDMO or other fast-paced, multi-project pharmaceutical-development experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong experimental-design, data-analysis, troubleshooting, and root-cause-analysis capabilities.
  • Ability to independently execute complex technical assignments and translate laboratory findings into practical manufacturing recommendations.
  • Strong scientific judgment, technical writing, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple development programs and collaborate across technical and business functions.

job.title: UX Designer – Enterprise Design Systems
job.description:
UX Designer – Enterprise Design Systems
We are seeking a UX Designer to help build, maintain, and scale an enterprise design system for complex, data-heavy internal tools. This role will bridge design and front-end engineering by ensuring UI components and patterns are consistent, accessible, scalable, and aligned with production implementation.

Scope:
• Build, maintain, and expand Figma component libraries.
• Audit and document UI patterns to improve consistency and component adoption.
• Develop accessible design patterns aligned with WCAG standards.
• Define design tokens and theming structures.
• Create usage guidelines, interaction specifications, and contribution standards.
• Support product teams adopting the design system through collaboration and office hours.
• Partner with designers, product managers, and engineers to align designs with production implementation.
• Evaluate AI-assisted tools for documentation, linting, and design-to-code workflows.

Required:
• 3+ years of experience building, scaling, or maintaining enterprise design systems.
• Advanced proficiency with Figma, including variables, component variants, auto-layout, and token workflows.
• Strong understanding of WCAG and accessible design practices.
• Experience designing complex, data-heavy, or high-density interfaces.
• Strong visual and interaction design skills with a detail-oriented approach.
• Experience documenting UI patterns, design standards, and interaction specifications.
• Ability to collaborate effectively with product designers, product managers, and software engineers.
• Strong communication and organizational skills.

Pluses:
• Experience with Angular Material or Google Material Design.
• Understanding of Angular component structures, theming, and front-end implementation constraints.
• Experience with design tokens, design system tooling, or token automation.
• Experience designing for robotics, simulation, mapping, autonomous vehicles, developer tools, or other complex technical environments.
• Familiarity with AI-assisted design workflows, automated linting, documentation generation, or design-to-code tools.

job.title: Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer
job.description:
Brakes Motion Controls Systems Engineer

The Motion Controls Systems Engineer will participate in the system level design activities for the propulsion and braking system, with a special focus on the electrical and controls integration to the rest of the vehicle system. You will Conceptualize, Design, Engineer, Develop and support the launch of next generation vehicle platform architectures for electric vehicles.

Responsabilities:
  • Participate in vehicle systems and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.
  • Distill product-level requirements and decompose them from vehicle-level motion features down to ECU/software-component functional requirements.
  • Define braking and propulsion functions and work with the hardware, software, architecture, safety and other cross-functional teams to deliver said functionality.
  • Participate in functional safety and failure avoidance analysis of complex electrical and software vehicle subsystems (HARA, FMEAs, etc.).
  • Develop and own motion related vehicle features (drive modes, terrain modes, vehicle hold, speedometer, odometer, cruise control, brake assistance, etc.).
  • Define diagnostic interfaces (DTCs, health monitoring, driver notifications, etc.) relating to the propulsion and braking systems.
  • Build the feature implementation strategy and develop functional boundary diagrams, sequence diagrams, define feature attributes, assess homologation requirements, and other deliverables.
  • Define system level test plans for hardware and software features (virtualized testing environments, Software-in-the-Loop (SIL), and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL), etc.).
  • Use field data to improve design and performance of the system.
  • Report features development progress and maturity at various program milestones.
  • Participate in architectural and software technical discussions and develop technical solutions while representing the propulsion system.

The minimum requirements we seek:
  • BS in Engineering degree in an equivalent field, or equivalent experience.
  • 0-5+ years of experience in systems design, systems architecture, propulsion or brakes systems, integration, and test validation.
  • Strong electrical and systems engineering fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of vehicle dynamics.
  • Working knowledge of systems development, vehicle architecture, propulsion technologies, brake system technologies, software/hardware tool development.
  • A systems approach to design and development with the desire and curiosity to strive for exceptional delivery execution and continuous improvement.

Should have experience with some of the following:
  • Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)
  • Traction Control
  • Stability Control
  • Friction & Regen Brake Blending
  • Trailer Brake Controls
  • Hydraulic brake boost assist
  • One-Pedal Driving
  • Hill-start assist
  • Brake torque vectoring
  • Brake Pedal Override
  • Automatic Emergency Braking / Pre-Collision Assistance
  • Dynamic Braking  / Dynamic Deceleration
  • Electronic Park Brake Control features
  • Hydraulic brake boost Control features
  • ESC control features

Preferred Requirements:
  • M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, Mechanical engineering.
  • Proven technical expertise in Propulsion and/or Brakes Systems Design and understanding of the intricacies of the subsystem.
  • Experience in the test, validation, and calibration of vehicle motion control features (e.g., longitudinal/lateral dynamics, regenerative braking, traction control) using HIL/SIL or in-vehicle testing.
  • Experience with electric machine design and DC/AC inverter design.
  • Experience with smart actuators, brake-by-wire systems, and integrated motion controllers.
  • Experience with Vehicle Network Protocols such as CAN, LIN & Automotive Ethernet.
  • Experience in leading product development from concept to deployment.
  • Experience in MATLAB, Python, or equivalent tools for modeling and analysis.
  • Experience operating within an Agile software development framework utilizing modern CI/CD pipelines for automated testing and software deployment.
  • Proficiency in fundamentals of vehicle architecture, embedded systems design, RTOS’s and real-time networking.
  • Strong working knowledge of ISO 26262 functional safety standards (industry certification is highly preferred).

job.title: Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
job.description:
Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer
12 month contract/contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Job Overview
The Exchange & SaaS Support Engineer will participate in the overall management and end-user support of the organization’s Messaging and SaaS offerings.
This position will primarily provide support to the end-user population for Exchange Online, Outlook, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive, and Box, including Microsoft 365 account and license administration. Experience with additional Microsoft 365 components is a plus.
 
The ideal candidate is a customer-focused support professional with strong troubleshooting skills, hands-on Microsoft 365 experience, and the ability to work effectively across teams in a complex enterprise environment.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide Tier 2 end-user support for Messaging and SaaS-based tools, including:
    • Exchange Online
    • Microsoft Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
    • Microsoft OneDrive
    • Box
  • Support Microsoft 365 account and license administration
  • Apply and troubleshoot Microsoft Teams policies
  • Perform mailbox maintenance and access management
  • Support message archiving, retrieval, and deletion
  • Troubleshoot end-user collaboration and messaging issues
  • Create and maintain process and environment documentation
  • Support and develop ServiceNow ticket automation
  • Create and modify PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Partner with other technical teams to resolve complex infrastructure and application issues
  • Participate in on-call support rotations
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of experience providing end-user support for Microsoft applications, specifically:
    • Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
  • 2+ years of experience with basic Box administration and end-user troubleshooting
  • 1–2 years of experience working with ServiceNow
  • 1–2 years of experience administering and supporting OneDrive
  • 1+ year of experience creating and modifying PowerShell scripts to automate recurring tasks
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Experience supporting Exchange Online
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 account and licensing administration
  • Experience with mailbox and access management
  • Exposure to additional Microsoft 365 technologies
  • Relevant and current technical certifications
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues involving multiple technical teams
  • Desire to learn and support emerging cloud technologies
  • Hands-on experience working within complex enterprise infrastructure environments
  • Experience within a highly regulated industry
  • Previous participation in an on-call support rotation

job.title: Material Handler - Newburyport, MA
job.description:
NOW HIRING: MATERIAL HANDLERS Applied Materials | Varian Semiconductor Equipment Newburyport, Massachusetts Join the Global Leader in Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology Applied Materials is the world's leading provider of materials engineering solutions used to produce virtually every advanced semiconductor chip and display in the world. Through its Varian Semiconductor Equipment division, Applied Materials is the number one producer of ion implantation equipment worldwide, providing the technology that enables the production of the microchips used in smartphones, computers, artificial intelligence, automotive electronics, medical devices, and countless other technologies.

We are actively seeking Material Handlers to support manufacturing operations at our Newburyport, Massachusetts facility.

Location Applied Materials / Varian Semiconductor Equipment
4 Stanley Tucker Drive
Newburyport, MA 01950

Additional Coverage Required:
Employees will also provide support as needed at:

428 Newburyport Turnpike
Rowley, MA

Candidates must be comfortable working at both the Newburyport and Rowley locations when business needs require.

Shift 1st Shift
Monday – Friday
7:00 AM – 3:30 PM
$19 to $21 dollars per hour

Opportunity Type ? 18-Month Contract Opportunities

Excellent Opportunity to Gain Experience with an Industry Leader

Position Summary The Material Handler is responsible for controlling and maintaining the accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of the stockroom. This role supports manufacturing operations by ensuring inventory accuracy, maintaining stock levels, expediting materials, and coordinating shortages to keep production moving efficiently.

Key Responsibilities • Receive, store, move, and control materials throughout company facilities.

• Ensure accurate transfer of parts and materials in and out of stockrooms.

• Verify inventory levels and maintain stock balances.

• Monitor and communicate material shortages.

• Locate, expedite, and deliver critical materials to support manufacturing operations.

• Load and unload materials, equipment, and supplies.

• Utilize material handling equipment including pallet handlers, skids, and hand trucks.

• Work closely with manufacturing, planning, logistics, and warehouse teams regarding material availability and status.

• Maintain a safe and organized work environment.


Qualifications • Experience loading and unloading materials, supplies, or equipment.

• Warehouse, stockroom, inventory, shipping, receiving, or logistics experience preferred.

• Experience operating pallet jacks, hand trucks, skids, or similar material handling equipment.

• Forklift/Fork Truck experience is a plus.

• Basic computer and inventory tracking skills.

• Ability to follow work instructions and safety procedures.

• Strong attention to detail and inventory accuracy.

• Experience communicating material status and coordinating shortages with multiple departments.


 Physical Requirements • Approximately 80% standing and walking throughout the shift

• Regular lifting, carrying, pushing, and pulling of materials

• Must be able to lift and move up to 35 pounds

• Ability to work in warehouse and manufacturing environments

Why Work for Applied Materials? Applied Materials is at the forefront of semiconductor innovation. Every day, our technology helps manufacture the chips that power the world's most advanced technologies. Joining Applied Materials means becoming part of a global organization known for innovation, quality, and career growth opportunities.

Contact Patty Vogel
Principal Recruiter | Yoh
pvogel@yoh.com

Apply Today and Join the Team Helping Build the Future of Technology!

job.description:
Lead Service Line Investigator – Inspect pipes in private homes in person
Location:  Clinton, Iowa
PAY RATE: $22/hour
Monday through Friday – 8 am to 5 pm, overtime limited
LENGTH OF ASSIGNMENT:  6 months possible extension

POSITION SUMMARY
Lead Service Line Inspectors help support company compliance with the EPA’s Lead and Copper Rule Improvements (LCRI) by conducting door-to-door outreach and completing brief in-home inspections of customer water service lines. This is a primarily field-based role focused on customer communication, simple pipe identification, and accurate documentation. You’ll work in two-person teams for all field activities. A portion of each day includes entering your inspection results into internal tracking systems.

WHAT TO EXPECT
·        Always work in 2-person teams in the field for safety, support, and customer comfort.
·        No sales, quotas, or commissions. You’re never held accountable for whether someone answers the door.
·        Company vehicle provided for all field work — no personal mileage required.
·        Company branded coats, hats, and seasonal gear provided for identification and weather protection.
·        Company-directed schedules with flexibility: later start times and evening hours are common, and Saturday work may be required based on project needs (overtime or flex time available).

RESPONSIBILITIES
·        Visit residential properties with your team partner to explain the Lead Service Line Identification program and request access for a quick interior inspection.
·        Locate the water meter, identify the service line material, perform a simple diagnostic test, and take photos.
·        Leave door hangers and self-report instructions when customers are unavailable.
·        Accurately record inspection results, photos, and daily activities in digital tools.
·        Navigate basements, stairs, and uneven surfaces safely while representing the company professionally.
·        Work safely and comply with all safety policies, prioritizing safety over results.


REQUIRED SKILLS & ABILITIES
·        Strong communication and customer-interaction skills.
·        Ability to record and enter data accurately.
·        Comfort working outdoors and in residential environments with a team partner.
·        Ability to climb stairs and walk on uneven terrain.

REQUIREMENTS
·        High school diploma or GED
·        Valid driver’s license

job.title: Human Resources Operations Partner
job.description:
Human Resources Operations Partner
Position Overview We are seeking an organized and motivated People Business Partner to provide hands-on support across People Operations, annual talent programs, reporting, and HR process improvement initiatives. This position is execution-focused and ideal for an early-to-mid-career HR professional who enjoys managing data, coordinating multiple projects, and supporting performance and compensation processes.

The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable working in Workday, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement: Remote or hybrid based on proximity to an office
Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours per week
Contract Duration: 6–12 months with potential for extension or conversion

Key Responsibilities Support annual HR processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.

  • Enter and complete HR transactions in Workday.
  • Pull, review, and analyze Workday reports and employee data.
  • Conduct data audits and maintain accuracy during performance, compensation, and talent cycles.
  • Coordinate project timelines, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items.
  • Prepare status reports, executive summaries, presentations, briefing materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage logistics, reporting, communications, and issue resolution throughout annual HR programs.
  • Develop process documentation, standard operating procedures, playbooks, and job aids.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across People Operations.
  • Coordinate with leaders, employees, and HR stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects.
Required Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of HR, People Operations, HR Business Partner, or related experience.
  • Hands-on experience using Workday to enter transactions, pull reports, and review data.
  • Experience supporting performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, or other annual HR programs.
  • Strong reporting, tracking, data-management, and process-coordination skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to perform administrative and execution-focused responsibilities.

  • Max Hourly Rate $24/hr on a W2

job.title: Research Engineer – Transportation
job.description:
Research Engineer – Transportation (Thermoplastics & Product Commercialization) Join a collaborative, highly technical team focused on bringing next-generation polymer-based materials to market across North American transportation segments. In this role, you’ll lead development programs that take thermoplastic compounds and masterbatches from concept through scale-up and commercialization—partnering closely with customers and cross-functional teams to solve real performance challenges and deliver differentiated, production-ready solutions. This is a fully onsite position, with the opportunity to make a direct impact on strategic growth priorities in transportation markets.

Required Skills
  • Proven experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer-based compounds and/or masterbatches (aerospace high-performance polymer development experience is also relevant)
  • Ability to support R&D from concept development through commercialization, including scale-up and manufacturing support
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of polymer processing, compounding, and formulation development
  • Understanding of thermoplastics manufacturing processes and automation
  • Working knowledge of DOE (Design of Experiments), statistical analysis, and data-driven product development
  • Strong communication, presentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills (internal teams and customers)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead projects and drive timelines, deliverables, and quality expectations
Nice to Have Skills
  • Experience with engineering thermoplastics, polyolefins, and twin-screw extrusion
  • Background in transportation material qualification
  • Familiarity with automotive and/or aerospace OEM specifications
  • Experience with weatherable materials, flame-retardant systems, and/or color-critical applications
  • Exposure to stage-gate or structured innovation/product development systems
  • Interest or experience integrating sustainability targets (e.g., recyclability, bio-based content, durability)
Preferred Education and Experience
  • M.S. preferred in Polymer Science, Materials Science, Chemistry, or a related field (Ph.D. or advanced degree also valued)
  • Bachelor’s degree considered with strong, hands-on industry experience
  • 5+ years of experience developing and commercializing thermoplastic polymer compounds/masterbatches for transportation markets (e.g., automotive, aerospace, defense, recreational, utility vehicles)
Bring your formulation expertise and commercialization mindset to a role built for real ownership—apply today to help deliver the next wave of transportation materials from lab to market.

  • Treatment of on-site injuries and referral to outside medical care as needed
  • Case management for injured workers and facilitate return to work
  • Provide medical surveillance for all employees including but not limited to annual audiograms, spirometry, vision screening and lead testing

job.title: QC Laboratory Specialist
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a QC Laboratory Specialist on a 12-month contract with our client in the pharmaceutical industry. The QC Laboratory Specialist will perform routine quality control laboratory testing in Microbiology, Wet Chemistry, or Chromatography to support the manufacture and release of products and incoming materials.

Position Type: Contract
Duration: 12 months
Estimated Start Date: ASAP
Location: On-site - Hamilton, Montana
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM MST
Pay Rate: $25 - 30.00/hr DOE

Responsibilities
  • Perform sampling and testing according to written methodologies.
  • Report accurate, clear, and defensible results.
  • Perform testing in accordance with applicable GMP requirements and quality systems.
  • Understand the scientific principles and method validation associated with assigned assays.
  • Review GMP assay data and communicate findings to manufacturing teams.
  • Participate in laboratory investigations, troubleshooting, and problem-solving.
  • Support non-routine testing, studies, and projects.
  • Support qualification, operation, and scheduled maintenance of laboratory equipment, including automated and computerized systems.
  • Ensure laboratory equipment and systems remain functional and validated.
  • Escalate equipment, assay, safety, and quality issues as appropriate.
  • Maintain the assigned laboratory area in a state of inspection readiness.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably a Bachelor of Science.
  • Scientific education with an understanding of laboratory testing concepts, principles, and mathematical calculations.
  • Previous laboratory experience preferred.
  • Previous GMP experience preferred.
  • Microbiology experience preferred for one opening.
  • Chromatography or Wet Chemistry laboratory experience preferred for one opening.
  • Basic proficiency with Microsoft Office.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong time-management and organizational skills.
  • Detail-oriented and able to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Must be able to work fully on-site.
  • Position may require flexibility to work shifts, holidays, and/or weekends based on business needs.
Work Environment
  • Fully on-site.
  • Work may take place in laboratory, manufacturing, and open-office environments.
  • No travel required.
  • Interacts primarily with internal stakeholders.

Gloucester, MA

Schedule:

  • First shift for 5:00 am to 3:30 pm or 5:30 am to 4:00 pm Monday through Thursday 
  • Second shift from 3:45 pm to 2:15 am Monday through Thursday 10% differential per hour
  • Third shift  from 7 pm to 6 am Sunday through Wednesday 13% differential per hour
Pay Rate:  $23.00 to $27.00 per hour all depends on experience.
Rate does not include shift hourly differentials

Are you a hands-on Manufacturing Technician who enjoys building, troubleshooting, and working with cutting edge technology? Join a team where your skills directly support advanced semiconductor manufacturing—an industry driving innovation in everything from AI to electric vehicles.
This is an excellent opportunity for technicians who thrive in electro-mechanical environments, enjoy problem-solving, and want long-term career growth in a high-tech manufacturing setting.

What You’ll Be Doing
In this role, you will support the production, testing, and repair of complex semiconductor equipment by:
Building, repairing, and testing electrical, electro-mechanical, pneumatic, and vacuum assemblies and subassemblies

Performing electro-mechanical assembly, troubleshooting, and repair, while identifying and correcting errors

Documenting completed work clearly and accurately

Ability to distinguish between colors

job.title: Optical Mech Technician
job.description:
Optical Technician 

Planet is seeking a highly skilled Contract Optical Technician to support the integration and testing of optical payloads for the Pelican satellite program. This role is focused on the tactical execution of telescope and camera assembly, alignment, and characterization. We are looking for a precision-oriented technician who excels in a cleanroom environment and has a proven track record of handling delicate flight optics and complex opto-mechanical assemblies. 

Impact You’ll Own 

  • Payload Integration and Assembly: Execute the high-precision assembly of telescopes and focal plane arrays, including the delicate bonding of optics using RTV and aerospace-grade epoxies. 

  • Optical Characterization: Perform ground-based testing of cameras and telescopes for image quality, MTF, and radiometric performance following established test procedures. 

  • Precision Metrology: Utilize and maintain optical test stations, including the use of interferometers, wavefront sensors, collimators, and integrating spheres to ensure payload performance. 

  • Fixture Assembly: Build and maintain opto-mechanical and electrical test fixtures to support the high-volume production and verification of Pelican payloads. 

  • Data Recording: Meticulously record test results and prepare data summaries for engineering review, ensuring all anomalies are captured and reported via Jira or in-house software. 

  • Component Handling: Proficiently handle, measure, and clean sensitive optical components according to strict cleanroom and laboratory safety protocols. 

  • Collaborative Debugging: Work closely with Manufacturing and Test Engineers to troubleshoot opto-mechanical or electrical failures identified during the build or test cycle. 

What You Bring 

  • Experience: Proven background in optics and optical assemblies, specifically within a high-precision manufacturing or aerospace environment. 

  • High-Reliability Bonding: Professional experience with the precision application of RTV and epoxies for mounting and securing optical elements. 

  • Alignment Expertise: Solid understanding of optical alignment techniques and the use of metrology equipment to verify image quality metrics. 

  • Laboratory Discipline: A methodical approach to following complex, detailed test procedures exactly as written, with no unauthorized deviations. 

  • Mechanical Aptitude: Proficiency with mechanical tools, fixtures, and the ability to read and interpret both mechanical and electrical drawings/schematics. 

  • Documentation Accuracy: Impeccable organizational skills with a focus on recording accurate, detailed test descriptions and data manipulation. 

  • Hardware Sensitivity: Extreme care when handling flight-critical optics and a deep understanding of ESD-safe and cleanroom best practices. 

What Makes You Stand Out 

  • Educational Background: Degree in Optical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 

  • Spacecraft Payload Experience: Previous experience working on satellite telescopes, focal planes, or mission-critical camera systems. 

  • Advanced Debugging: Ability to perform root-cause analysis on complex opto-mechanical systems and electrical cable/harness assemblies. 

  • Software Familiarity: Basic experience with Python or lab automation tools to assist in data collection and test station operation. 

  • Soldering Proficiency: Experience with PCB soldering and the assembly of delicate electronics associated with optical sensors.

job.title: Supplier Quality Engineer
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, contract opportunity for a Supplier Quality Engineer to join our aerospace and defense technology client. This opportunity is ideal for candidates who are within a commutable distance to Irvine, CA and are open to an onsite work environment with significant travel requirements.
See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other engineering opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP. Title: Supplier Quality Engineer
Compensation: $100k - $128k base + bonus (base salary depends on experience)
Type: Direct Hire
Industry: Aerospace / Defense Technology
Eligibility: Must be a US Person (ITAR environment) Responsibilities
  • Partner with internal teams and external suppliers to evaluate, monitor, and improve supplier quality performance.
  • Lead resolution of supplier-related nonconformances to prevent production disruptions and customer impact.
  • Drive root cause investigations and corrective action processes, ensuring timely and effective closure.
  • Review and approve supplier corrective action responses, prioritizing based on business and operational impact.
  • Identify supplier risks related to product quality or safety and escalate appropriately.
  • Support supplier development initiatives, including training and continuous improvement efforts.
  • Act as a technical expert for supplier-related quality concerns and provide guidance on complex issues.
  • Analyze supplier performance data and recommend process or product improvements.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams on quality initiatives.
  • Participate in audits and ensure supplier compliance with applicable industry standards.
  • Perform additional duties as needed to support quality and operational goals.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field).
  • 10+ years of experience in supplier quality, manufacturing, or related engineering discipline.
  • Strong background in root cause analysis and corrective action methodologies (e.g., 8D, A3).
  • Experience with quality systems and tools such as PFMEA, control plans, DOE, Lean, and Six Sigma.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and engineering documentation (including GD&T).
  • Familiarity with aerospace quality standards (e.g., AS9100, AS9110, AS9120) and inspection practices.
  • Proficiency with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Excel, Minitab, or similar).
  • Experience working with ERP systems such as SAP is a plus.
  • Knowledge of APQP or advanced product quality planning processes is preferred.
  • Prior auditing experience and/or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA) are a plus.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing processes and supplier development practices.
Additional Requirements
  • Valid driver’s license with ability to travel frequently (up to 50%, domestic and international).
  • Passport required; must be comfortable with short-notice travel.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience leading cross-functional or remote teams on complex initiatives.
Soft Skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across all organizational levels.
  • Effective problem-solving, analytical thinking, and decision-making abilities.
  • Ability to influence without authority and drive continuous improvement.
  • Conflict resolution skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality excellence.
Work Environment / Physical Requirements
  • Primarily office-based with occasional interaction in lab or production settings.
  • Regular computer use and standard office equipment operation.
  • Ability to occasionally lift light items (up to 10 lbs).

job.title: Scientist - Process Sciences
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring a Scientist I, Process Sciences to support the development and optimization of solid-phase reactor processes. This role is focused on applying chemical and process engineering principles to solid-phase reaction systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of fluid flow, mass transfer, pressure drop, mixing, resin/solid-support behavior, reaction kinetics, and process scale-up.

This is an onsite position based in Cambridge, MA.

Position: Scientist, Process Sciences
Rate: $40–$55/hr DOE
Location: Cambridge, MA
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

Key Responsibilities
  • Design and execute laboratory experiments supporting solid-phase reactor development and optimization.
  • Evaluate reactor performance, including fluid flow, pressure drop, mass transfer, mixing, residence time, and solid loading.
  • Investigate the impact of resin/solid-support properties such as swelling, packing, permeability, and particle behavior on process performance.
  • Apply reaction engineering and chemical engineering principles to troubleshoot reactor and process limitations.
  • Analyze experimental data and identify relationships between hydrodynamics, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, and process performance.
  • Support process development and scale-up of solid-phase reactor systems.
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, analytical teams, and equipment partners.
  • Document experimental results and contribute to technical reports, protocols, and presentations.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, Polymer Science, or a related discipline or M.S. with 3+ years of relevant industry or research experience.
  • Hands-on experience with chemical process development, reactor systems, reaction engineering, or solid-liquid processing.
  • Strong understanding of fluid flow, mass transfer, reaction kinetics, and process engineering fundamentals.
  • Experience designing experiments, analyzing quantitative data, and troubleshooting experimental systems.
  • Strong communication and technical documentation skills.
Preferred Experience:
  • Packed-bed or fluidized-bed reactors
  • Solid-phase or heterogeneous reaction systems
  • Reactor hydrodynamics and pressure-drop analysis
  • Mass-transfer studies
  • Resin, polymer, or solid-support systems
  • Chromatography or packed-column operations
  • Catalysis
  • Peptide or solid-phase synthesis
  • Oligonucleotide synthesis
  • Process scale-up and technology transfer
  • Design of Experiments (DoE)
We're looking for a hands-on scientist or engineer who understands how a solid-phase reactor actually works and can connect fundamental engineering principles to real-world process performance. Strong candidates from adjacent chemical and process engineering environments are encouraged to apply.



 #IND-SPG

job.title: HR People Operations Partner
job.description:
HR People Operations Partner

Position Overview We are seeking an organized and motivated People Business Partner to provide hands-on support across People Operations, annual talent programs, reporting, and HR process improvement initiatives. This position is execution-focused and ideal for an early-to-mid-career HR professional who enjoys managing data, coordinating multiple projects, and supporting performance and compensation processes.

The successful candidate will be detail-oriented, comfortable working in Workday, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Work Arrangement: Remote or hybrid based on proximity to an office
Employment Type: Full-time contract, 40 hours per week
Contract Duration: 6–12 months with potential for extension or conversion

Key Responsibilities Support annual HR processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, compensation planning, talent reviews, succession planning, and employee engagement activities.

  • Enter and complete HR transactions in Workday.
  • Pull, review, and analyze Workday reports and employee data.
  • Conduct data audits and maintain accuracy during performance, compensation, and talent cycles.
  • Coordinate project timelines, milestones, deliverables, risks, dependencies, and action items.
  • Prepare status reports, executive summaries, presentations, briefing materials, and stakeholder communications.
  • Manage logistics, reporting, communications, and issue resolution throughout annual HR programs.
  • Develop process documentation, standard operating procedures, playbooks, and job aids.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives across People Operations.
  • Coordinate with leaders, employees, and HR stakeholders across multiple concurrent projects.
Required Qualifications
  • 3–5 years of HR, People Operations, HR Business Partner, or related experience.
  • Hands-on experience using Workday to enter transactions, pull reports, and review data.
  • Experience supporting performance reviews, compensation cycles, talent reviews, or other annual HR programs.
  • Strong reporting, tracking, data-management, and process-coordination skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, projects, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Willingness to perform administrative and execution-focused responsibilities.

job.title: Data Center BA
job.description:
Data Center Business Analyst
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Onsite) – onsite interview required
 
Position Summary
The Data Center Business Analyst will support Data Center Projects and Operations by gathering and documenting business and technical requirements, managing project documentation, tracking financials and KPIs, creating JIRA stories, and supporting operational analysis. This role will work closely with Project Managers, Operations, Facilities, Engineering Teams, and functional stakeholders to improve processes, drive project execution, and support operational resilience initiatives, including disaster recovery and Black Start planning.
 
Responsibilities
  • Gather, analyze, and document business, technical, and non-functional requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions.
  • Create and maintain project documentation, process flows, MOPs, and release plans.
  • Support project planning, scope management, scheduling, and status reporting.
  • Create and manage JIRA stories, tasks, and action items.
  • Maintain documentation within Confluence and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Develop dashboards, reports, and KPI metrics to support operational and project decision-making.
  • Analyze current processes and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
  • Support Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools and reporting.
  • Assist with project financial tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Support Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, and Black Start readiness activities, including recovery documentation, dependency mapping, and tabletop exercises.
  • Prepare meeting minutes, track follow-up actions, and coordinate with stakeholders across multiple teams.
  • Travel to data center facilities as required.
 
Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of Business Analyst experience supporting Data Center, Infrastructure, or Technology projects.
  • Experience working with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools.
  • Strong knowledge of JIRA, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Visio, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Experience gathering requirements and translating them into technical deliverables.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Experience supporting disaster recovery, operational resiliency, or Black Start initiatives is preferred.
  • Understanding of critical data center infrastructure, including power, cooling, and capacity management, is a plus.

job.title: Migration Engineer
job.description:
Migration Engineer
12 month contract to hire
Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Job Overview
The Migration Engineer will support a high volume of acquisition-related integration work, with a primary focus on planning, designing, and executing large-scale email and data migrations while minimizing disruption to users and business operations.
This role will support the migration of email into Exchange Online and assist with data migrations from external sources into a centralized Box environment. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise across enterprise messaging platforms, internet email systems, DNS, email security, migration tooling, and troubleshooting.
 
David is looking for someone who has demonstrated success delivering complex migrations and who can partner effectively with both technical and business stakeholders throughout the migration lifecycle.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Assist with the migration of mailboxes from multiple external sources into one or more managed Exchange Online tenants
  • Support the planning and execution of migration activities while minimizing disruption to users and business operations
  • Collaborate with senior engineers, internal teams, and external partners to assess current mailbox configurations and migration requirements
  • Provide escalation support to end users during migrations and address issues promptly
  • Document migration procedures, configurations, troubleshooting steps, and lessons learned
  • Assist the Data Migration team with moving data from external sources into a centralized, managed Box environment
  • Support troubleshooting across migration tools, email platforms, end-user clients, and related infrastructure
  • Communicate technical migration steps and issues in clear business terms to non-technical stakeholders
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent IT work experience
  • 3+ years of relevant IT experience
  • 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Exchange Online, including migrations
  • 3+ years of experience with Proofpoint Email Protection
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DKIM
    • SPF
    • DMARC
    • Internet email systems
    • DNS
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting
  • Experience using BitTitan MigrationWiz for mailbox migrations to Exchange Online
  • Extensive experience configuring and troubleshooting:
    • Microsoft Outlook
    • Microsoft Teams
  • Experience supporting end-user clients across:
    • Windows
    • macOS
    • iOS
    • Android
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Ability to explain technical procedures in business terms to non-technical stakeholders
  • Hands-on software and hardware troubleshooting experience
  • Experience with Box migration tools
  • Strong analytical and methodical troubleshooting skills

job.title: Business System Analyst
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting opportunity for an IT System Analyst – Veeva PromoMats & MedComms .This role will support Veeva Vault applications used by Medical and Commercial teams, with a focus on content management, approval workflows, digital asset management, platform administration, and continuous process improvement. The ideal candidate brings hands-on Veeva PromoMats and MedComms experience along with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions within a regulated environment.

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other IT opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

Title: IT System Analyst– Veeva PromoMats & MedComms
Location: Princeton, NJ (Hybrid)
Compensation: $145,000–$155,000 annually, depending on experience and qualifications
Type: Full-Time / Direct Hire
 
**This role is not able to provide sponsorship. Candidates must be able to work on our clients W2 without sponsorship now or in the future**

Responsibilities
  • Support the administration, maintenance, configuration, and ongoing enhancement of Veeva PromoMats and MedComms applications.
  • Partner with Medical, Commercial, IT, and other business stakeholders to gather requirements and improve content review and approval processes.
  • Configure and optimize workflows supporting medical, legal, and regulatory review activities across multiple business groups and markets.
  • Participate in application governance by coordinating proposed changes, approvals, priorities, and platform enhancements with appropriate stakeholders.
  • Support and expand Digital Asset Management capabilities, including asset organization, metadata, localization, content reuse, and distribution.
  • Monitor application performance and content workflows to identify bottlenecks, user experience issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Evaluate new Veeva capabilities and coordinate prototypes, testing, releases, and implementation activities with business partners.
  • Support platform upgrades and configuration changes while following established SDLC, validation, testing, and documentation requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements, functional specifications, process maps, test cases, user documentation, and system administration materials.
  • Work with stakeholders to prioritize competing requests and recommend practical solutions based on business impact, compliance considerations, and platform best practices.
  • Ensure application processes and changes align with applicable security, privacy, quality, and regulatory requirements.
Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 6+ years of relevant experience supporting digital platforms, marketing technology, content management, or related business applications.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Veeva PromoMats and/or Veeva MedComms, including workflow configuration, administration, implementation, or optimization.
  • Strong understanding of content review and approval processes within a regulated life sciences environment.
  • Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM), including metadata, source-file management, content reuse, localization, and asset distribution.
  • Experience administering or supporting Veeva Vault applications and managing platform enhancements.
  • Ability to gather business requirements and translate stakeholder needs into functional and technical solutions.
  • Experience supporting application testing, releases, documentation, and SDLC processes.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with both business and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and operate independently in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong attention to compliance, data privacy, security, and documentation requirements

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

job.title: Soldering Technician
job.description:
About the Role: Solder Technician 

You will be joining a world-class Satellite Manufacturing team. Currently, our production demands require a highly skilled Contract Solder Technician to take ownership of specialized, high-complexity assembly tasks. 

This role is designed for a technical expert who can hit the ground running, relieving pressure on our core team by independently managing high-volume production of intricate components. You will work with in-house custom jigs and specialized flight hardware where precision is the only acceptable standard. 

Impact You’ll Own: 

  • Specialized Flight Assembly: Take full ownership of complex soldering tasks, including torque rod assemblies and delicate battery tab interconnects. 

  • High-Volume Execution: Independently perform precision rework and assembly on a high volume of PCBAs daily. 

  • Jig-Based Precision: Use and maintain in-house custom fixtures/jigs to ensure repeatable, high-reliability solder joints on non-standard components. 

  • Precision Rework: Expertly add/remove components, install switches, and attach shields to boards using a microscope. 

  • Workflow Management: Use in-house software to track work progress and maintain digital records of throughput. 

  • Operational Excellence: Organize physical hardware on trays systematically and manage a shifting queue of priorities without constant supervision. 

What You Bring: 

  • Specific Mastery: Proven experience soldering torque rods, magnetics, or high-current battery tabs (highly preferred). 

  • Daily Precision Experience: A career background where high-reliability soldering under a microscope was the primary daily function, not a secondary task. 

  • Adaptability: Ability to quickly learn and utilize proprietary in-house jigs and tooling for complex mechanical-to-electrical interfaces. 

  • Independent Drive: Ability to work with minimal supervision and maintain high productivity in a fast-paced environment. 

  • Technical Literacy: Familiarity with electronic part numbering systems and the ability to read complex drawings/schematics. 

  • Certification: IPC-A-610 or J-STD-001 (Active or recently expired). 

What Makes You Stand Out: 

  • NASA 8739.3/.2 or J-STD-001 Space Addendum certification. 

  • Experience with BGA rework stations and X-ray inspection. 

  • Previous experience in Aerospace or Medical Device manufacturing. 

  • Experience with wire-to-tab bonding or high-vibration environment assembly.

job.title: Verification Engineer- LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY - THIS IS A HYBRID ROLE
job.description:
LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY - THIS IS A HYBRID ROLE
PLEASE NO THIRD PARTY CANDIDATES

Position Summary
The Verification Engineer owns the independent gates that catch what the building agent cannot see. Because a coding agent cannot be relied upon to grade its own work objectively, this role operates a separate, adversarial layer — distinct agents, distinct tests, and distinct judgment — whose sole purpose is to determine whether a build is actually correct, secure, and safe to ship.

This absorbs the majority of manual QA test authoring and routine human code review, replacing them with a structured, largely automated but independently-owned verification discipline.

Key Responsibilities
  • Operate the adversarial verification layer: separate QA and security agents, LLM-judge review, and held-out or composition tests that the building agent never sees during development.
  • Enforce deterministic gates — coverage floors (80% general / 90% security-critical, with a ratchet rule preventing regression), SAST/DAST/secret/dependency scans, test-edit detection, and dependency allowlists.
  • Run the tiered review model, routing irreversible or high-blast-radius changes to mandatory human architecture and security review rather than allowing them through automated gates alone.
  • Own and report escaped-defect and first-pass-accuracy metrics for the overall validation workstream.
  • Design and maintain held-out test suites and composition tests specifically so they remain unseen by the builder, preserving their diagnostic value.
  • Investigate gate failures to distinguish genuine defects from false positives, and feed systemic failure patterns back into the standards library.
Required Qualifications
  • 5+ years in QA engineering, test automation, or security engineering, including designing test strategy rather than only executing test cases.
  • Hands-on experience with SAST/DAST tooling, secret scanning, and dependency vulnerability scanning in a CI/CD context.
  • Understanding of code coverage tooling and how to set and enforce meaningful coverage thresholds.
  • Ability to design adversarial or held-out test scenarios that a builder (human or agent) would not have visibility into during development.
  • Working scripting ability to build and maintain automated gate checks.
  • Hands on experience with common RDBMS platforms and SQL queries
  • Familiarity AWS and container based architectures
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience designing or operating LLM-judge or AI-assisted review pipelines.
  • Background in secure SDLC practices or participation in an architecture/security review board.
  • Familiarity with test-edit detection techniques (identifying when a builder has modified a test to pass rather than fixing the underlying code).
Success Metrics
  • Escaped-defect rate (defects found post-gate vs. pre-gate).
  • First-pass accuracy of builds arriving at verification.
  • Coverage floor compliance and ratchet adherence over time.
  • Percentage of high-blast-radius changes correctly routed to mandatory human review.

job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Process Engineer – Critical Minerals in Houston, TX. This role will be a responsible for improving process recovery, product purity, throughput, and reagent efficiency. Support successful pilot testing and technology deployment across variable brine chemistries. The Process Engineer should have iodine recovery and brine processing experience. 
 
Title: Process Engineer- Critical Minerals
Duration: Contract/DH
Pay: $70/hr
Location: Houston, TX
Shift: M-F 8-5pm

Position Summary The Process Engineer will support the development, optimization, scale-up, and deployment of brine-processing systems. This individual will work across engineering, chemistry, operations, vendors, and customer sites to convert emerging separation technologies into repeatable pilot and commercial processes.

The successful candidate will be comfortable moving between engineering calculations, pilot equipment, process documentation, field troubleshooting, and hands-on problem solving.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and optimize process flowsheets for brine, produced-water, iodine, and lithium recovery systems.
  • Translate laboratory and bench-scale results into pilot, demonstration, and commercial process designs.
  • Prepare and maintain process flow diagrams, P&IDs, equipment specifications, operating procedures, and process documentation.
  • Perform mass and energy balances, process calculations, equipment sizing, and operating-envelope development.
  • Support the design, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and operation of pilot and demonstration systems.
  • Evaluate unit operations such as adsorption, ion exchange, membranes, solvent extraction, filtration, precipitation, concentration, and purification.
  • Troubleshoot process, mechanical, instrumentation, and equipment issues during pilot and field operations.
  • Track recovery, purity, throughput, reagent consumption, water quality, waste generation, and other key performance indicators.
  • Develop sampling plans and collaborate with analytical teams to interpret brine and product-quality data.
  • Support design reviews, HAZID/HAZOP activities, process safety assessments, and management-of-change processes.
  • Work with equipment suppliers, contract engineering firms, EPC partners, and customer-site stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities to improve recovery, selectivity, reliability, operating cost, and system scalability.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, recommendations, and project status to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Travel periodically to pilot facilities, customer sites, vendors, and project locations.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Minerals Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 5+ years of experience in process engineering, process development, pilot operations, hydrometallurgy, water treatment, chemical processing, or a related industrial environment.
  • Experience developing, operating, troubleshooting, or scaling chemical or separation processes.
  • Working knowledge of mass balances, process calculations, equipment sizing, and process optimization.
  • Ability to read and develop PFDs and P&IDs.
  • Experience working with pumps, tanks, piping, valves, filtration, membranes, chemical dosing, or related process equipment.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work hands-on in a fast-moving startup environment with changing priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with lithium extraction, iodine recovery, critical minerals, hydrometallurgy, or produced-water treatment.
  • Experience with solvent extraction, liquid-liquid extraction, adsorption, ion exchange, membrane separation, or selective recovery.
  • Experience with high-salinity or chemically complex aqueous systems.
  • Pilot-plant, demonstration-scale, commissioning, or field-deployment experience.
  • Familiarity with process simulation, techno-economic analysis, CAPEX/OPEX evaluation, or process modeling.
  • Experience with HAZOP, HAZID, PSM, MOC, or other process-safety practices.
  • Experience working with EPC firms, equipment vendors, contract laboratories, or oil-and-gas operators.
  • Master’s degree or Ph.D. in a relevant engineering or technical discipline.
