Are you a hands-on Engineering Technician who thrives in a fast-paced semiconductor production environment? Do you enjoy building, testing, and troubleshooting complex electro-mechanical systems? If so, this could be a great next step in your career.
We are seeking an experienced Engineering Technician to support advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working directly on tools, systems, and prototypes while collaborating closely with Engineering and Manufacturing teams.
What You’ll Do
As an Engineering Technician, you will play a critical role in supporting production, engineering, and new product introductions by performing a wide range of electro-mechanical tasks, including:
  • Perform routine to moderately complex electro-mechanical functions such as design support, testing, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting, and assembly
  • Build and work with electronics, electro-mechanical systems, prototype models, and specialized test equipment
  • Troubleshoot and test both component-level and system-level electrical and mechanical issues
  • Support new system installs, NPI activities, and field upgrades
  • Work from schematics, diagrams, layouts, written instructions, and verbal direction
  • Compile and maintain logbooks, test procedures, and technical documentation with strong attention to detail
  • Perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum, and process testing on AMAT/VSE platforms per Engineering and Manufacturing specifications
  • Perform rework based on test results and generate Quality Notifications when required
  • Stay current on manufacturing and engineering processes and assist in continuous improvement efforts

Safety & Work Environment
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and secure work environment
  • Follow all safety, security, and operating procedures
  • Use appropriate protective equipment and proper tool handling
  • Actively participate in required safety training and proactively report hazards, incidents, or injuries

Required Technical Skills
  • Proven experience working hands-on in a production or manufacturing environment
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, vacuum, and process systems
  • Experience using hand and power tools
  • Ability to build equipment using unreleased schematics, assembly drawings, and images
  • Familiarity with electrical test equipment, meters, and diagnostic tools
  • Experience with or knowledge of fiber-optic communications
  • Ability to write clear, detailed technical reports and test procedures
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and engineering processes in a semiconductor environment

Mechanical Skills Required
  • Strong build, assembly, and fabrication skills
  • Experience using precision measuring devices

Nice to Have
  • Experience with motion control systems, specifically PMAC

Why You’ll Want This Role
  • Hands-on work with advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment
  • Exposure to cutting-edge technology and complex systems
  • Opportunity to support engineering innovation and NPI efforts
  • Stable 2nd schedule for those who prefer off-hour work
  • A role where your technical skills truly make an impact

Yoh Contractor Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan
  • Life and Disability Insurance
  • Weekly Direct Deposit and ePayroll
  • Employee Discount Programs

Apply today and bring your skills to the next level.

job.title: Manufacturing Operator
job.description:
Manufacturing Operator - rotating day/night shift schedule 

Location: Marlborough, MA (Onsite)
Pay Rate: $22.00 - $24.50/hour (W-2)
Contract Length: 12 Months
Schedule: Rotating Day & Night Shifts (4 Days On / 4 Days Off)

Yoh Staffing is seeking a Manufacturing Operator for our client in the semiconductor manufacturing industry in Marlborough, MA. This position supports chemical manufacturing operations through batch processing, material handling, packaging, and equipment operation in a plant environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.
Schedule This position follows a rotating schedule of 4 days on, 4 days off, alternating between day and night shifts:
  • Day Shift: 6:45 AM - 7:15 PM
  • Night Shift: 6:45 PM - 7:15 AM
Training Schedule During the first 4 weeks, all new hires will complete training on the day shift:
  • Monday - Thursday
  • 6:45 AM - 5:15 PM
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain a safe work environment and actively participate in safety programs and training.
  • Follow established operating procedures and manufacturing protocols.
  • Perform manufacturing batch processing according to written procedures.
  • Operate, monitor, and inspect process equipment and systems.
  • Receive and execute work assignments from supervisors and team leads.
  • Complete routine production activities, including:
    • Labeling materials
    • Forming and filling boxes
    • Material handling and movement
    • Packaging operations
  • Ensure accurate documentation and attention to quality standards.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors to support production goals.
Qualifications Required
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and safety protocols.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic.
Preferred
  • Experience in a manufacturing, production, or cleanroom environment.
  • Forklift/Fork Truck operating experience.
Physical Requirements
  • Stand and walk for the majority of a 12-hour shift.
  • Occasionally lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Perform bending, pushing, pulling, and reaching activities regularly.
  • Work at table level and overhead level as needed.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise, odors, dust, heat, cold, and chemicals.
  • Required use of designated PPE, which may include:
    • Safety glasses/goggles
    • Gloves
    • Hard hat
    • Respirator
    • Cleanroom garments
  • Work in an electrically classified area where flammable and combustible materials may be present.

job.title: Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician-Gloucester,MA
job.description:
Semiconductor Manufacturing Technician needed for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Gloucester, Massachusetts.



Pay Rate: $22 to $25 per hour




Shifts Available:  1st Shift Monday-Thursday 5:30AM-4PM
                              2nd Shift-Monday-Thursday 3:45PM-2:15AM
                              3rd Shift-Sunday-Wednesday 7:30PM-6:15AM
                              4th Shift- Friday-Sunday 5:45AM-6:15PM
          

The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:
 

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change

What You Will Be Doing:
 
  • Utilizes routine work orders, schematics, wiring diagrams, parts and wire lists, written and/or verbal instructions to build, repair and/or test electrical, electro-mechanical, vacuum, pneumatic assemblies, subassemblies and components.
  • Observes all safety standards.
  • Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment.
  • Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices.
  • With guidance, promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept.
  • Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly.
  • Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.
  • Under supervision, utilizes test fixtures, electronic measurement equipment, leak detectors, and/or vacuum pumps to test assemblies, subassemblies and components.
  • Enters data on computer terminal, such as progress, work expense and labor details.
  • May perform computer programming, repair or software installs.
  • Details finished work.
  • Receives parts and performs audits to ensure all necessary parts are available to perform built, test and repair. Inspects parts for defects.
  • Troubleshoots and improves processes.


What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • With assistance, performs electro-mechanical assembly operations, troubleshooting and repair. Identifies and corrects errors.
  • Broad understanding of the tools and methods used in manufacturing mechanical parts


Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Understanding of electro-mechanical procedures and testing on various platforms
  • Auto mechanic experience a plus
  • Two or more years of related experience
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • An associate’s degree or technical education, certifications or training

job.title: Warehouse Associate – Pharmaceutical Distribution
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Warehouse Associate for a direct-hire opportunity with our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana.

This position is ideal for someone with warehouse, distribution, shipping/receiving, inventory, or manufacturing experience who is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a highly regulated environment where accuracy and meeting strict shipping deadlines are critical.

The products handled in this facility are time-sensitive radiopharmaceutical products that are ultimately shipped for patient use. Extensive training is provided, including cGMP, safety, SOP, and radiation-safety training.

Location: Noblesville, IN
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Base Salary: $50,000 annually plus shift differential

Schedule

Initial Training – Approximately 2 Months:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM

Permanent Schedule Following Training:
Saturday–Wednesday, 6:00 AM–2:30 PM
Thursday and Friday off

Candidates must be able to complete the Monday–Friday training period and permanently work the Saturday–Wednesday schedule.

Responsibilities
  • Perform warehouse and distribution activities including receiving, order fulfillment, inventory handling, and cycle counting.
  • Accurately process, fill, package, and prepare customer orders according to established procedures.
  • Prepare products and shipping documentation to meet strict, time-sensitive shipment deadlines.
  • Complete product consolidations based on established flight and shipping schedules.
  • Maintain accurate finished-goods inventory using electronic and paper-based systems.
  • Perform inventory transactions and maintain complete and accurate warehouse records.
  • Handle radiopharmaceutical products in accordance with established safety procedures and training.
  • Follow cGMP requirements, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Complete required documentation and paperwork accurately and on time.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, organized, and compliant warehouse environment.
  • Support additional warehouse and distribution activities as assigned.


Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED required.
  • 1+ year of warehouse, distribution, manufacturing, shipping/receiving, inventory, fulfillment, or related experience required.
  • Experience with shipping/receiving, cycle counting, inventory control, order fulfillment, packaging, or finished-goods handling preferred.
  • Previous pharmaceutical, medical device, healthcare distribution, food manufacturing, chemical, or other regulated-industry experience is a plus, but not required.
  • Experience using computerized warehouse, inventory, or distribution-management systems preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow written procedures accurately.
  • Comfortable completing detailed documentation and working within a highly structured environment.
  • Strong reliability, punctuality, and ability to meet strict deadlines.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced distribution environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Must be comfortable working around radiopharmaceutical products after completing required safety and radiation-safety training.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The successful candidate will be highly dependable, flexible, safety-conscious, and comfortable following detailed procedures. Because these products have limited shelf lives and must ship according to strict schedules for patient use, punctuality, accuracy, and documentation are critical.

job.description:
Weekend Semiconductor Engineering Technicians Intermediate are needed for an 18 month contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Austin, Texas. Candidates must take direction from management staff (Physicists and Engineers) and be able to independently provide expertise to accomplish assigned tasks.  The successful candidate(s) must have the ability to communicate effectively and interact with a diverse project team to collect, compile, maintain and interpret data and test results accurately.


Experience Required: Minimum of 2 years experience testing on electro-mechanical equipment




Pay Rate: $23 to $26 per hour  


Days/Hours needed: Friday- Monday 5PM-4AM 18% shift differential


Bonus payout structure:

  • $500 after successful completion of 90 days
  • $1,000 after successful completion of 180 days




What You Will Be Doing

  • Performs moderately complex electro-mechanical technical functions and activities such as design, test, checkout, fabrication, modification, troubleshooting and assembly of electronics and electro-mechanical systems, experimental design circuitry, prototype models, specialized test equipment, tools and test fixtures.
  • Tests and troubleshoots system level and component level problems in electrical and mechanical systems and sub-systems. May perform new system and NPI installations and field upgrades.
  • Works from schematics, diagrams, written and verbal descriptions, layouts or plans to perform moderate testing and troubleshooting.
  • Compiles logbooks and test procedures documentation utilizing good writing skills. Assists in revising, developing and implementing department procedures.
  • May perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic & vacuum and process testing on platforms to Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.
  • Observes all safety standards. Maintains a secure, safe, clean and healthy work environment. Attends required health and safety training and follows safety and security policies, procedures and practices. Promptly reports accidents, injuries, safety hazards, or emergencies to supervisor or Safety dept. Follows operating instructions, uses protective equipment when required, and uses equipment and materials properly. Actively strives to prevent accidents and injuries.
  • Becomes familiar with current manufacturing and/or engineering processes and stays informed of any changes in procedures. Assists in the correction of problems.
  • Performs necessary rework and assists in determining remedies for malfunctions and generates Quality Notifications.
 

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

 

  • Positive Attitude
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Good Communication Skills
  • Problem-Solving Skills
  • Team Player
  • Ability to Accept and Learn from Criticism
  • Flexibility/Adaptability
  • Works Well Under Pressure

Various shifts

Overtime required

Open to working weekend hours

job.title: Lead Endpoint Support Engineer
job.description:
Lead Endpoint Support Engineer
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Own the strategy, engineering, and lifecycle management of desktops, laptops, and mobile endpoints for corporate and branch users.
  • Lead configuration, deployment, and management of endpoints using Microsoft Intune, including device enrollment, compliance policies, and application deployment.
  • Manage endpoint security posture using Microsoft Defender, including threat detection, response, and remediation across the device fleet.
  • Evaluate, implement, and manage Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) and virtual desktop solutions to support flexible and remote work needs.
  • Drive standardization of device imaging, patching, and configuration management to improve consistency and reduce support overhead.
  • Lead the endpoint support function, ensuring timely and effective resolution of desktop, laptop, and peripheral issues for corporate headquarters and branch locations.
  • Establish and monitor support SLAs, ticket queues, and escalation paths to drive consistent service delivery across the organization.
  • Drive root cause analysis and continuous improvement for recurring endpoint issues to reduce downtime and support volume.
  • Partner with security and infrastructure teams to ensure endpoints are compliant, patched, and aligned with security policy.
  • Manage relationships, contracts, and performance of hardware, software, and DaaS vendors supporting the endpoint environment.
  • Own the endpoint procurement, refresh, and asset lifecycle management process, including budgeting and forecasting for hardware needs.
  • Negotiate vendor agreements and service levels to optimize cost, quality, and support responsiveness.
  • Evaluate new endpoint tools, hardware, and services, and lead vendor selection and onboarding processes.
  • Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement
  • Build, mentor, and lead a team of endpoint engineers and support technicians across corporate and branch locations.
  • Partner with IT leadership, security, and business stakeholders to align endpoint strategy with business priorities and user needs.
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders on endpoint health, security posture, project status, and support performance.
  • Develop and maintain documentation, standards, and training materials for endpoint support processes.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred, or equivalent work experience.
  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Modern Desktop Administrator, Endpoint Administrator Associate) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., Security+) a plus.
  • 6+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, desktop support, or end user computing, including 2+ years in a lead or supervisory role.
  • Hands-on experience managing endpoints with Microsoft Intune, including device compliance, configuration profiles, and application deployment.
  • Experience with Microsoft Defender for endpoint security, threat detection, and response.
  • Experience evaluating and supporting Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) or virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) solutions.
  • Proven experience supporting a distributed environment with corporate offices and multiple branch or retail locations.
  • Demonstrated experience managing vendors, contracts, and hardware/software procurement.
  • Experience with Windows OS deployment, imaging, and patch management tools.
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and team management skills.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, software, and network-related endpoint issues.
  • Strong vendor management and negotiation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to support both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities across corporate and branch locations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-service oriented mindset with a focus on end user experience.

job.description:
Yoh Life Sciences is seeking an Organic Chemist / Platform Chemistry Scientist to support a leading pharmaceutical company’s Encoded Technologies team in Cambridge, MA.

This is a hands-on laboratory role for a PhD-level scientist with a strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and reaction development. The scientist will support on-DNA compound synthesis, binder confirmation, and the development and optimization of DNA-compatible reactions used in DNA-encoded library (DEL) technologies.

Location: Cambridge, MA
Work Arrangement: Fully Onsite
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM EST
Pay Rate: $45.00–$49.50/hr
Job Type: Contract
Minimum Education: PhD

About the Role
The Platform Chemistry Scientist will join an Encoded Technologies chemistry team supporting drug discovery through DNA-encoded library technologies. This position will focus on hands-on organic synthesis, reaction development and optimization, and on-DNA chemistry.

The ideal candidate is a strong experimental chemist who can independently plan and execute synthetic chemistry experiments, troubleshoot challenging reactions, interpret experimental results, and collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary scientific team.

Key Responsibilities
  • Synthesize on-DNA compounds to support binder confirmation and drug discovery projects within established timelines.
  • Develop, evaluate, and optimize DNA-compatible organic reactions for use in DNA-encoded library production.
  • Design and execute synthetic chemistry experiments, including reaction screening and optimization.
  • Troubleshoot reaction performance and use experimental data to guide subsequent chemistry.
  • Analyze, interpret, document, and clearly communicate experimental results.
  • Maintain high standards of laboratory safety, data quality, scientific rigor, and experimental documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with scientists across chemistry and other drug discovery functions.
  • Effectively manage multiple experiments and priorities while consistently delivering high-quality results.
Required Qualifications
  • PhD in Organic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, Chemical Biology, or a closely related discipline with substantial synthetic organic chemistry research experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in synthetic organic chemistry and small-molecule synthesis.
  • Demonstrated experience with reaction development, reaction optimization, and troubleshooting.
  • Ability to independently plan, execute, analyze, and document laboratory experiments.
  • Strong understanding of organic reaction mechanisms and synthetic strategy.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced laboratory environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality scientific work.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with on-DNA synthesis or DNA-compatible chemistry.
  • Experience with DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) or related chemistry platforms.
  • Experience developing or adapting synthetic reactions for DNA-compatible or aqueous conditions.
  • Familiarity with analytical techniques used to evaluate synthetic chemistry experiments, such as LC-MS, HPLC, and/or NMR.
  • Experience in medicinal chemistry, chemical biology, or small-molecule drug discovery.
  • Strong scientific problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent organizational, interpersonal, and written/verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
Why This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to contribute directly to an innovative chemistry platform supporting early-stage drug discovery. You’ll work hands-on with DNA-encoded library technologies while collaborating with experienced scientists to develop new chemistry, optimize reactions, and advance binder-confirmation efforts.

Interested? Apply today to learn more about the opportunity.

Yoh is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

#IND-SPG

job.title: Chemical Operator III
job.description:
Chemical Operator - rotating day/night shift schedule 

Location: Marlborough, MA (Onsite)
Pay Rate: $22.00 - $24.50/hour (W-2)
Contract Length: 12 Months
Schedule: Rotating Day & Night Shifts (4 Days On / 4 Days Off)

Yoh Staffing is seeking a Chemical Operator for our client in the semiconductor manufacturing industry in Marlborough, MA. This position supports chemical manufacturing operations through batch processing, material handling, packaging, and equipment operation in a plant environment. The ideal candidate is safety-focused, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.
Schedule This position follows a rotating schedule of 4 days on, 4 days off, alternating between day and night shifts:
  • Day Shift: 6:45 AM - 7:15 PM
  • Night Shift: 6:45 PM - 7:15 AM
Training Schedule During the first 4 weeks, all new hires will complete training on the day shift:
  • Monday - Thursday
  • 6:45 AM - 5:15 PM
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain a safe work environment and actively participate in safety programs and training.
  • Follow established operating procedures and manufacturing protocols.
  • Perform manufacturing batch processing according to written procedures.
  • Operate, monitor, and inspect process equipment and systems.
  • Receive and execute work assignments from supervisors and team leads.
  • Complete routine production activities, including:
    • Labeling materials
    • Forming and filling boxes
    • Material handling and movement
    • Packaging operations
  • Ensure accurate documentation and attention to quality standards.
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors to support production goals.
Qualifications Required
  • High School Diploma or GED.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and safety protocols.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.
  • Self-motivated with a strong work ethic.
Preferred
  • Experience in a manufacturing, production, or cleanroom environment.
  • Forklift/Fork Truck operating experience.
Physical Requirements
  • Stand and walk for the majority of a 12-hour shift.
  • Occasionally lift up to 40 pounds.
  • Perform bending, pushing, pulling, and reaching activities regularly.
  • Work at table level and overhead level as needed.
  • Wear required personal protective equipment (PPE).
Work Environment
  • Manufacturing plant environment.
  • Exposure to noise, odors, dust, heat, cold, and chemicals.
  • Required use of designated PPE, which may include:
    • Safety glasses/goggles
    • Gloves
    • Hard hat
    • Respirator
    • Cleanroom garments
  • Work in an electrically classified area where flammable and combustible materials may be present.

job.title: Senior Solution Architect, Cloud, DevSecOps & Platform Engineering
job.description:
Solution Architect (AWS & Azure)
Direct Hire
Irving, TX (Hybrid)
 
Key Responsibilities
Architecture & Technical Strategy
  • Define and own the target-state architecture for cloud, infrastructure, and platform engineering environments across AWS and Azure.
  • Design scalable, resilient, and secure reference architectures for networking, storage, identity, and container/orchestration platforms.
  • Establish architecture standards, patterns, and guardrails for infrastructure-as-code, cloud landing zones, and platform services.
  • Evaluate emerging cloud, infrastructure, and platform technologies and provide recommendations to modernize the technology stack.
  • Lead architecture reviews and governance forums to ensure solutions align with enterprise standards and long-term strategy.
  • Architect and guide the evolution of CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices across the organization, leveraging tools such as Azure DevOps, Harness, and GitLab.
  • Define the architecture for embedding security into the software development lifecycle, including SAST, DAST, and vulnerability management tooling.
  • Partner with platform engineering teams to design self-service infrastructure, automation, and developer enablement capabilities.
  • Champion policy-as-code, secure configuration management, and compliance automation across cloud and platform environments.
  • Define architecture and standards for observability and monitoring using tools such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and Datadog.
  • Guide the design of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to improve reliability and reduce time to detect and resolve issues.
  • Champion site reliability engineering (SRE) principles, including SLIs/SLOs and proactive capacity and performance planning, across architecture decisions.
  • Build, lead, mentor, and develop a team of architects and engineers, fostering technical growth and career development.
  • Set team goals, manage performance, and create a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with infrastructure, security, application development, and business stakeholders to align architecture decisions with business priorities.
  • Communicate architecture strategy, trade-offs, and risk clearly to both technical teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate third-party tools and platforms that support the architecture roadmap.

Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field required.
  • AWS and/or Azure architecture certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert) strongly preferred.
  • Security certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+) and/or Kubernetes certifications a plus.
  • 8+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including 3+ years in a people leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on expertise designing and implementing solutions on AWS and Azure, including compute, networking, storage, and identity services.
  • Proven experience architecting DevSecOps pipelines using Azure DevOps, Harness, and/or GitLab, including embedded SAST and DAST security scanning.
  • Strong experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Dynatrace, and/or Datadog.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform, ARM/Bicep, CloudFormation) and container/orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker).
  • Demonstrated experience leading, mentoring, and managing technical teams, including hiring, performance management, and career development.
  • Proven track record influencing enterprise architecture decisions and driving alignment across cross-functional and executive stakeholders.  
  • Strong leadership, coaching, and people management skills.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills.
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps principles, secure SDLC, and cloud security best practices.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture vision with hands-on technical depth.
  • Ability to influence and drive alignment across engineering, security, and business stakeholders.
  • Business acumen in technology transformation and cloud cost management

job.description:
Weekend Shift Engineering Technician Role needed for an 18 month contract to hire opportunity in Gloucester, MA. In this role you will assist engineers and scientists as they create, modify, and test products and processes.


Shift available: Friday, Saturday, Sunday 5:45am – 6:15pm

  • Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical/scientific processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks and complex work
  • Will perform mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, vacuum and process testing on equipment per Engineering and Manufacturing documentation and specifications.
  • Experience in assembly, integration and calibrations of semiconductor capital equipment, plasma etch platforms, Implanters (high current, Medium Current, PLAD) or equivalent equipment in a clean room environment.

Minimum of 2-3 year’s semiconductor experience, VCS training on other VIISta tools a plus. Understanding of electrical circuitry is required. Some travel may be required.

job.title: Corporate Paralegal (Regulatory Experience)-HYBRID
job.description:
Corporate Paralegal (Regulatory Experience) needed for a HYBRID contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Audubon, PA.
  • Pay Rate: $31-45/hr
  • HYBRID-onsite occasionally/as-needed
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • The Paralegal will support  legal & compliance efforts by preparing documents and filings, provide support for activities related to drafting, processing, updating and filing tariff and tariff related agreements; provide support for all activities surrounding or relative to the drafting and processing of agreements and other legal documents as well as the coordination of assignments and workflow for attorneys. Additionally, the Paralegal will conduct legal and factual research; execute filings; facilitate legal and compliance matters; and act as a liaison among various internal departments as well as outside agencies.
  • Provide legal support for counsel in the stakeholder process, and in litigation and regulatory proceedings both at the state and federal levels.
  • Assist in FERC filings by organizing relevant governing agreement and tariff controlling document sections, assisting counsel in drafting filing letters.
  • Service Agreement Duties: Able to have overall responsibility for the administration, processing and maintenance of Service Agreements including the tracking of effective and expiration dates, and coordinate with both internal and external clients to maintain overall regulatory compliance. able to review pro forma documents and agreements for conformity. If non-conforming, prepare draft FERC filing for PJM counsel indicating reason for non-conformity to PJM standard agreement.  Able to prepare final document, file with Commission filing and oversee any service requirements for filing.
  • Tariff Duties: Ability to oversee the tariff maintenance process and administer the eTariff database to grant levels of access to company personnel as needed. Administer and maintain the eTariff software system while working closely with designated back-up to provide daily coverage.

Required:
  • 2+ years relevant paralegal experience in corporate legal department, governmental agency, or public utility company in an energy/electricity/FERC-related role or similar experience in another regulatory/compliance driven environment.
  • Paralegal certificate or 4+ years of demonstrated relevant experience
  • Possess in depth knowledge of the FERC and the manner in which regulated entities prepare and make filings to update or revise their tariff documents.
What’s In It For You?
  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the region’s largest utility companies. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Disability Specialist
job.description:
Disability Specialist needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Newark, NJ. This Disability Specialist will work to ensure students with disabilities have the opportunity to fully experience what it means to be part of the University community. They will look to reduce barriers for students in-and-out of the classroom, help students achieve their goals, and be a resource for the campus community.
 
Schedule: Monday-Friday 8am-4:30pm
Duration: 3 months with possible extension
Pay: $30-45/hr DOE
 
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Plans, organizes and provides reasonable accommodations that include academic adjustments, auxiliary aids, and services to students with disabilities – physical, psychological, learning, health-related, and neurological disabilities (e.g., mobility impairments, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, learning disorders, hearing impairments, visual impairments, traumatic brain injuries, and epilepsy)
  • Conducts initial interviews with students; keeping accurate, comprehensive and up-to-date notes/records related to students; reviews documentation and evaluative reports; prepares letters of accommodation; evaluating eligibility for services; conducts follow-up meetings with students; organizing reasonable accommodations, services and auxiliary aids for students; and makes referrals to appropriate services or agencies
  • Consults with faculty and staff regarding the implementation of reasonable accommodations and services; develops and presents disability awareness programs for the community
  • Collaborates with other offices and outside agencies, as needed and appropriate
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in one of the related fields: Counselor Education, Special Education, Counseling Psychology, Education, or a related field
  • A minimum of four years’ experience in a disability services office in higher education in one of the related fields: Counselor Education, Special Education, Counseling Psychology, Education, or a related field
  • Certification in Rehabilitation Counseling Education would be beneficial in working with various students served by the office as well as experience in learning disabilities consultation
  • Requires strong computer skills and effective use of various software and hardware programs used in a multi-function disability office including but not limited to:
    • Database systems
    • MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
    • Email and social media tools
    • Accessible technologies and Web 2.0 tools

job.title: Health Coaches
job.description:
Health Coach needed for a REMOTE contract opportunity with Yoh’s insurance client located in Philadelphia, PA. The Health Coach serves as the primary nurse providing health coaching and case management, helping members manage their health, set goals, overcome barriers, coordinate care, and navigate the healthcare system. They collaborate with providers and members to support positive health outcomes and deliver quality, cost-effective care.

Schedule: Monday-Friday 8a-5p
Duration: 9/14-12/14 with possible extension or direct placement
Pay: $32-46/hr, DOE

What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Functions as a primary nurse for members across the continuum of health and health-related services including information and support for lifestyle improvement, acute symptoms, treatment decisions, targeted health conditions, chronic conditions and complex conditions. 
  • Engages with the members ranging from coaching to intensive case management with the goal to develop and support the member’s ability to self-manage.
  • Provides appropriate clinical coaching support to members placing in-bound calls   seeking assistance with acute symptoms, chronic conditions and/or health information regarding, specific topics.
  • Conducts appropriate surveys/assessments to proactively identify needs. Develops appropriate care plans and establishes goals.  Assessment includes working with member/family/significant other to identify barriers of adherence to the physician’s plan of care as well as achieving lifestyle improving goals. Continues to work with member via on-going telephonic communication to achieve the agreed upon goals.
  • Proactively incorporates lifestyle improvement and prevention opportunities into member interactions and coaching.
  • Contacts member’s physician when needed especially in more complex medical situations requiring case management intervention to facilitate care coordination.  
  • Monitors the quality of service, seeking member/family input.  Communicates safety issues to manager and utilizes the occurrence screening   for quality-of-care tracking.
  • Identifies on-line, telephonic and community-based resources that can assist the member in achieving and maintaining their personal health goals. Assist the member in accessing those services.  In addition, assist in maximizing the use of member’s benefits and ensuring coordination of services and outcomes.
  • Provides exceptional customer service.  
  • Maintains and communicates accurate information in associate self-serve program.
  • Attends educational programs/training to maintain state license, CCMC licensure and updated knowledge of Health Coach process.
  • Ensures all activities are documented and conducted in compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and accreditation standards.
What You Need to Bring to the Table:
  • Current, active, and unrestricted Pennsylvania Registered Nurse licensure.
  • Three years any of combination of clinical, case management and/or disease/condition management experience.
  • Exceptional communication and problem-solving ability.
  • Basic computer skills.
  • Strong clinical knowledge
  • Access to laptop (client does not provide one)

job.title: Material Handler
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Material Handler for our manufacturing client. In this role, you will be responsible for pulling, kitting, and restocking raw materials and finished products to support production operations. The Material Handler will operate applicable industrial equipment, maintain clean work areas, comply with written manufacturing procedures, and support production teams in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom environments. This position also supports inventory accuracy, material flow, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Industry: Medical Device
Location: Santa Fe Springs
Compensation: $19 - $21/hr 
Shift: 2:40pm–11:10pm. Mon - Fri
Type: contract-to-hire
 

Job Functions
  • Pull, pick, kit, and restock raw materials and products to support production operations.
  • Work in both cleanroom and non-cleanroom manufacturing environments.
  • Support production teams by ensuring timely and accurate material availability.
  • Work closely with customer service and sales teams in a supporting role, as needed.
  • Understand and follow manufacturing paperwork and instructions.
  • Perform physical counting, reconciliation, and reorganization of materials.
  • Retrieve, replenish, and verify materials, including material notification when required.
  • Perform required system transactions related to inventory and material movement.
  • Operate and monitor select automated production equipment; reset or service equipment as needed.
  • Drive company vehicles between facilities, as required.
  • Perform additional tasks as assigned by the General Manager, Operations Manager, Production Manager/Supervisor, Manufacturing Lead, or Line Trainer.
  • Learn, follow, and adhere to Manufacturing Procedures (MPs) and company quality policies.
  • Complete manufacturing paperwork accurately and verify documentation.
  • Complete required training objectives and demonstrate training effectiveness as outlined in the training plan.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience Education

  • High School Diploma or GED equivalent required.

Skills and Experience
  • Previous experience and/or training as a Material Handler preferred.
  • Basic mathematical skills to use assembly and inspection tools (e.g., rulers, gauges, reticles).
  • Introductory-level computer proficiency.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English regarding manufacturing procedures, workflows, equipment setup, and work instructions.
  • Ability to lift up to 25 pounds and stand and/or sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Ability to distinguish between colors, as required for product identification and signaling systems.
  • Strong manual dexterity to handle, count, and manipulate materials.
  • Ability to perform repetitive tasks throughout an entire shift.
  • Ability to learn and work in a cleanroom environment.
  • Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods, with occasional movement to transport materials or communicate with manufacturing leadership.
  • Ability to operate equipment to assemble or prepare parts manually and inspect work accuracy per manufacturing processes.


Physical Job Requirements
  • Manufacturing and cleanroom work environment.
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to manipulate, handle, or feel objects, tools, controls, and office equipment.
  • The employee frequently is required to talk and hear.
  • The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise levels in the work environment are typically very quiet.

6 month contract to hire
Irving, TX (Onsite)

Seeking a highly motivated, self-directed, Implementation Specialist for their IT Implementation and Adoption Group, located in Irving, Texas. This position works closely with the IT development, training, and support groups to develop rollout plans, schedules, training events, and project communications. This position will coordinate resources and administer events. This position will assist with IT system training and application support for new location or acquisition setups; and for administering and supporting pilot programs for new software initiatives.

REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelors’ degree with major work in business administration, education, computer sciences, or a similar business-related field.
  • At least three years full-time employment working in a related area.

job.title: Engineer Vehicle Tools – Datalogging, Fleet Analytics & Tools Management
job.description:
Engineer Vehicle Tools – Datalogging, Fleet Analytics & Tools Management
 
This role sits at the intersection of vehicle engineering, data analytics, and fleet operations. You will own the health and performance of our Intrepid CS-based datalogging systems across the engineering vehicle fleet, build tools and dashboards that turn raw fleet data into actionable insight, and manage the shared engineering tools (Vector licenses, portable hardware) that keep test programs running smoothly. This is a hands-on role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a CAN network, writing a Python script to mine a data pool for anomalies, and coordinating logistics across multiple test sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES
Data Analysis & Reporting
  • Partner with cloud and data platform teams to build dashboards and metrics covering both fleet logging health and the logged vehicle data itself.
  • Develop diagnostics and trend analyses that characterize software and system behavior in the field to inform program development and control system tuning.
  • Build internal tools/scripts to mine fleet data pools for issues or trends that may not be readily apparent to end users.
Fleet Logging Operations
  • Perform regular checks of fleet logging status; proactively identify and report issues to minimize data downtime.
  • Manage fleet-wide logger logistics, including unit delivery, rework, part swaps, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Conduct initial triage on non-functioning loggers and escalate to the appropriate point of contact for resolution.
  • Support additional/bespoke instrumentation requests driven by evolving vehicle testing needs.
Logging Solution Development
  • Support development of external logging solutions for upcoming build phases, coordinating compatibility, integration, and prove-out as vehicle builds mature and harness designs evolve.
  • Create setup and troubleshooting guides/documentation for external datalogging systems.
Tools & Asset Management
  • Maintain and track shared engineering tool licenses (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANape/vSpy) to ensure availability across teams.
  • Track portable equipment locations, usage, and lifecycle across the fleet.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field; or equivalent hands-on technical experience.
  • 2+ years of relevant hands-on experience with vehicle data acquisition/CAN-based systems.
  • Strong proficiency with CAN diagnostic and log analysis tools for embedded systems, such as CANalyzer, CANape, CANoe, and MATLAB.
  • Experience with vehicle datalogging tools such as Intrepid CS, Vehicle Spy, and associated cloud/server connectivity options.
  • Working knowledge of automotive embedded systems, including chassis control ECUs, body modules, thermal management, braking, steering, and powertrain.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work both independently and cross-functionally.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
  • Experience with EV platforms and modern vehicle software architecture.
  • Scripting/programming experience (e.g., Python, SQL) for data analysis and tool development.
  • Familiarity with cloud/data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks) used for large-scale fleet data.
  • Experience managing shared software licenses or engineering equipment pools.
  • Experience creating technical documentation or training materials for cross-functional teams.

job.title: Laboratory Animal Technician
job.description:
Yoh is hiring an Laboratory Animal Technician for our San Francisco Bay Area client. In the Animal tech role, you will support the research programs of the faculty by providing all services associated with the care and use of laboratory animals including the purchasing/receiving, daily care and monitoring of the health of all species. 

Industry: Clinical Research
Location: San Francisco, Ca
Shift: M-F  7:00 am - 3:30 pm

Responsibilities 
  • Animal care, room sanitation, record keeping and minor equipment maintenance 
  • Daily maintenance of vivarium facilities, under general supervision.

  • Assist in the training of new employees and act as area leader of Assistant Animal Technicians.
Qualifications
  • 1 year of animal handling or lab animal sanitation equipment operations experience 
  • Ability to communicate animal health information to appropriate personnel, maintain legible records for permanent status
  • Some computer skills (email, scan barcodes, timesheets and online training)
  • Capacity to learn and assume responsibility for the routine animal caretaking functions 
  • Able to effectively and efficiently work well with other team-members in a high-throughput, dynamic, and physically demanding environment
  • Ability to effectively follow Standard Operating Procedures as it relates to Environmental Health and Safety procedures (i.e. proper use of Personal Protective Equipment)

job.title: Full Stack Engineer
job.description:
Full Stack Engineer

Scope:
• Lead the Front-End Architecture for our Chemistry Insights Platform:
• Architect the AI Interface: Build a high-performance, responsive user interface that connects our scientists with a powerful, LLM-driven backend.
• Enable Agentic Workflows: Design and implement intuitive UIs for complex, multi-step AI interactions, making advanced information retrieval and data synthesis feel seamless to the end user.
• Manage Real-Time State: Utilize technologies like WebSockets or Server-Sent Events (SSE) to handle asynchronous LLM streaming, maintaining a smooth UX while agents process data in the background.
• Domain-Specific Visualization: Optimize the rendering of heavy scientific payloads, chemical structures, and large document datasets without compromising browser performance.

Required:
• Application Framework: React.js and Next.js, built strictly with TypeScript to ensure type safety across complex LLM data structures.
• Real-Time Data Streaming: Utilizing Server-Sent Events (SSE) to handle asynchronous, token-by-token LLM responses, ensuring our agentic workflows feel instant and highly responsive.
• State Architecture: Deep expertise in managing complex, real-time client and server state using Zustand, Redux Toolkit, or the Context API.
• Styling & Build Tooling: Tailwind CSS for rapid, scalable UI development, bundled and optimized for performance via Vite or Webpack.

Pluses:
• Experience in these areas is a massive plus, particularly for rendering complex chemical structures and handling heavy in-browser computation:
• Advanced 3D & Graphics: WebGL, WebGPU, and Three.js / React Three Fiber.
• High-Performance Compute: WebAssembly (Wasm).

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, excel in detail-oriented tasks, and have a passion for energy infrastructure, this is your chance to grow your career while making a tangible impact.

Job Details: 

Duration: 12 month contract W2
Pay Rate:  $24.65-$35.21 hourly
Hybrid 2x a week onsite - Audubon PA

Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Over 5 years of experience in a similar role
  • Exceptional attention to detail and high-quality work standards
  • Effective communicator, both verbally and in writing
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Strong analytical skills, both quantitative and qualitative
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
Nice to Have Skills:
  • Experience with SAP
  • Deep knowledge of Excel and data reporting
  • Familiarity with Client operations, markets, and planning functions
  • Background in the energy industry or supporting Client committees
Preferred Education and Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related discipline
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in energy or interconnection projects

  • Maintains, cultivates and coordinates internal and external relationships with Interconnection Stakeholders.
  • Completes general administrative tasks utilizing the MSOffice suite (Work, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook).
  • Coordinate with PJM Finance and Credit departments to ensure adequate project financing requirements are met with respect to tariff requirements.

  • Provides support, including the development of agreements and data requests from the database in support of the engineers and manager of the Interconnection Projects Department.

job.title: Production Planner
job.description:
Production Planner, Manufacturing Yoh is looking for a Production Planner, Manufacturing to support our client in the biotechnology manufacturing industry. This position will own production planning and scheduling for complex electromechanical instruments, translating demand into executable work orders while driving material readiness across Procurement, Warehouse, Quality, and Manufacturing.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on production planning experience, proficiency with Oracle ERP and MRP, and experience supporting complex electromechanical instrument builds with multi-level BOMs.

Industry: Biotechnology / Manufacturing
Location: Pleasanton, CA
Schedule: Full-time, onsite
Compensation: $48.00–$55.00 per hour, DOE
Type: Contract (6 month initial with ability to extend /perm)

Responsibilities · Own the master production schedule and release work orders for instrument builds, subassemblies, service, and spare demand.

· Run and action MRP in Oracle, converting planned orders into requisitions and work orders with accurate dates, quantities, and priorities.

· Balance production schedules against labor capacity, test and burn-in availability, material lead times, and other manufacturing constraints.

· Maintain planning parameters including lead times, safety stock, reorder points, lot sizing, and sourcing rules.

· Publish clear-to-build and shortage reports and drive material shortages to resolution through daily cross-functional follow-up.

· Partner with Procurement to expedite, pull in, or push out purchase orders based on actual production requirements.

· Work directly with Warehouse teams on kit staging, pick accuracy, cycle counts, and inventory accuracy.

· Coordinate with Quality on incoming inspection priorities, non-conforming materials, and MRB dispositions impacting production.

· Work alongside Manufacturing and Test to sequence builds, resolve line-side shortages, and adjust schedules for rework or troubleshooting.

· Maintain BOM accuracy and manage material impacts associated with engineering changes, cut-in points, rework requirements, and obsolete inventory.

· Reconcile work order material issues, backflush errors, inventory transactions, and variances within Oracle.

· Track and report schedule attainment, on-time delivery, inventory levels, and shortage recovery.

· Identify recurring causes of production delays and drive improvements to prevent repeat shortages.

Minimum Requirements · 3–5+ years of production planning, master scheduling, or materials planning experience within a manufacturing environment.

· Strong proficiency with Oracle ERP, including MRP, work orders, inventory data, planned orders, and inventory transactions.

· Experience planning complex electromechanical instrument builds involving mechanical, electrical, and optical, fluidic, or pneumatic subassemblies.

· Experience working with deep, multi-level BOMs and long-lead components.

· Hands-on working style with the ability to work directly on the manufacturing floor and in the stockroom with Procurement, Warehouse, Quality, and Manufacturing teams.

· Strong Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, and analysis of large data sets.

· Ability to manage competing production priorities, maintain realistic schedules, and clearly communicate risks and trade-offs.

Preferred Qualifications · Experience within an ISO 9001, ISO 13485, or similar regulated or quality-controlled manufacturing environment.

· APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.

· Familiarity with engineering change control and PLM systems.

· Experience supporting NPI and transitioning products from pilot builds into sustained production.

· Bachelor's degree in supply chain, operations, engineering, business, or equivalent hands-on experience.

What’s Offered This is an opportunity to work in a hands-on manufacturing environment supporting complex instrument production while partnering closely with Procurement, Warehouse, Quality, Manufacturing, and Test teams.

Estimated Min Rate: $48.00/hour
Estimated Max Rate: $55.00/hour

This position is recruited for by Yoh on behalf of our client. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, and other job-related factors permitted by law.

  • $35-40/hr. hourly rate

job.title: Quality Assurance Technician II
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Quality Assurance Technician for our medical device manufacturing client. In this role, you will perform Quality Control (QC) inspections and testing of sterile and non-sterile medical products to ensure compliance with specifications, procedures, and Quality System requirements. The Quality Assurance Technician will support incoming, in-process, and finished product inspections, review manufacturing and sterilization records, manage nonconforming materials, maintain calibration activities, and support environmental monitoring. This position requires strong attention to detail and hands-on experience with inspection and measurement equipment within a regulated medical device manufacturing environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite
Compensation: $25/hr
Type: Direct Hire 

Job Functions
  • Perform Quality Control inspections to verify materials, products, processes, and controlled environments meet specifications, customer requirements, and Quality System requirements.

  • Perform accurate QC measurements and ensure inspection and testing results are thoroughly documented.

  • Complete inspections according to established priorities and production schedules.

  • Review manufacturing records, including sterile processing data, test results, certifications, labeling, and related documentation for compliance with specifications and Quality System requirements.

  • Support Warehouse associates to ensure materials are handled and stored according to applicable specifications and Quality System requirements.

  • Maintain accurate, organized, and readily retrievable Quality records to support audits and inspections.

  • Verify QC inspection files, documentation, and manufacturing associate training records are current and accurate.

  • Identify, document, segregate, and quarantine nonconforming materials to prevent unintended use or mix-ups with acceptable product.

  • Assist with investigations of products and processes suspected of being nonconforming.

  • Coordinate Material Review Board (MRB) activities to ensure timely disposition of nonconforming materials.

  • Communicate with appropriate stakeholders regarding nonconforming materials awaiting MRB review and disposition.

  • Maintain controlled access to Quality Assurance Hold and Quarantine areas.

  • Inspect returned products and ensure appropriate segregation of nonconforming materials.

  • Maintain the equipment calibration program to ensure production, inspection, test, and measurement equipment is calibrated by established due dates.

  • Verify equipment is properly identified with current calibration status and remove equipment from service when calibration is expired or equipment is out of calibration.

  • Verify preventive maintenance (PM) and equipment qualification activities are completed as required.

  • Perform environmental monitoring activities, including temperature and humidity monitoring and Controlled Environment Area (CEA) monitoring/testing according to the Quality System.

  • Verify manufacturing and warehouse areas are appropriately cleaned, pest control measures are maintained, and required records are completed.

  • Maintain clean and organized work areas.

  • Assist with maintaining Quality Assurance work instructions in accordance with current regulations and standards.

Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • High School Diploma or GED required.

  • Minimum of three (3) years of Quality Control and inspection experience within a medical device manufacturing environment.

  • Experience preparing technical reports, analysis, and documentation using Microsoft Office.

  • Demonstrated ability to read and interpret blueprints, technical documentation, procedures, and product specifications.

  • Applied knowledge of Quality Control inspection, testing, and measurement instrumentation.

  • Hands-on experience with advanced inspection and measurement equipment, including gauges, micrometers, calipers, indicators, comparators, and microscopes.

  • Excellent hand-eye coordination and visual acuity, including color vision, close vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to perform precise measurements and maintain accurate Quality records.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with auditors, suppliers, management, and cross-functional teams.

  • Strong understanding of nonconforming material control, inspection documentation, and regulated manufacturing practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Two-year technical degree preferred.

  • Training or certification in ISO 13485 and FDA Quality Systems preferred.

  • Experience with sterilization, microbiology, and biocompatibility preferred.

  • Strong manual dexterity for detailed inspection and measurement activities.

Physical Job Requirements
  • Medical device manufacturing, warehouse, and controlled environment/cleanroom setting.

  • Regularly required to stand, walk, sit, and use hands to operate inspection tools, measurement equipment, and other manufacturing equipment.

  • Requires excellent hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity to perform detailed inspection activities.

  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision, color vision, and the ability to identify fine details under magnification.

  • Must be able to perform repetitive inspection and measurement activities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

job.title: Client Service Representative - Financial Services
job.description:
Job Title: Client Service Representative - Financial Services 
Location: Tempe, AZ (REMOTE, MUST BE LOCAL)
Pay: $18.00 - $23.00/hr (W2)
Type: 12 month contract with strong potential or conversion
Schedule: Onsite training day one, then fully remote

About the Role
We are hiring Client Service Representatives to support one of the nation's largest independent financial services firms during a major period of growth. In this role, you will be the trusted point of contact for financial advisors and their clients, handling account questions, transactions, and service requests with professionalism, accuracy, and care. This is a fast-paced, people-first environment and a genuine foot in the door with a thriving, growing organization.
This position is available in Tempe, AZ.

What You Will Do
  • Serve as a first point of contact for advisors and clients via phone, email, and chat
  • Assist with account inquiries, transactions, money movement, account transfers, and new account questions
  • Research and resolve issues accurately, using multiple systems and tools
  • Document interactions and maintain accuracy across every request
  • Deliver a consistently professional, empathetic, and solution-focused experience
What We Are Looking For
  • Strong customer service and communication skills, with patience and professionalism on every interaction
  • Comfort in a high-volume, fast-paced service environment
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Comfort learning new systems and technology
  • Reliability and a genuine interest in growing with the firm
  • Experience in financial services, banking, call center, client service, or operations is a plus
Hiring Process
We keep our process straightforward and move quickly:
  1. Initial phone screen with our recruiting team to review your background and the role
  2. Recorded video interview (SparkHire) where you will answer a short set of questions on your own time, treat it like a real interview
  3. Video interview with the client team
  4. Offer and onboarding, including mandatory onsite training before the role transitions to hybrid/remote eligibility
Why Apply
  • Work with a leading, growing financial services firm
  • Long-term contract with real potential to convert based on performance
  • Clear path to build a lasting career 
  • Supportive training to set you up for success
  • FULL BENEFITS including medical, prescription, dental, and vision coverage, an HSA, a 401(k) with immediate eligibility, life and disability insurance, and added perks like an EAP, commuter accounts, gym discounts, and more.
Additional Details
This is a W2 contract opportunity. We are unable to provide C2C arrangements or visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US.
We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Senior Integration & Test Engineer - Vision Pipelines
job.description:
Senior Integration & Test Engineer - Vision Pipelines

The Sensor Firmware team is responsible for developing the sensor drivers, safety monitoring, and developing the vision pipeline to feed perception. As an embedded software engineer on the sensor firmware team, you will be responsible for the integration and test of the embedded software for the camera sensing system. We’re looking for someone who has a passion and expertise in developing safe, efficient software for vision systems.
 
What you’ll do:
? Develop V&V plans for the vision/camera subsystem that spans unit tests, software integration and hardware integration tests.
? Develop simulation infrastructure and mock layers for unit and integration testing of software that controls the hardware accelerators.
? Design Integration Test plan and test cases for requirements based and fault injection testing.
? Develop test automation scripts in python/C++and maintain the tests to stay healthy in CI.
? Triage and Troubleshoot bench failures and recommend/provide fixes.

What you'll need to succeed:
? Degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and 4 years of Robotics, or experience in a related field.
? 5 Years of strong experience in integration testing and developing embedded vision systems using C++ and python.
? Strong software design, algorithm, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
? Experience with multi-processor SoCs or similar embedded processors used in camera and vision processing.
? Prefer candidates with experience developing software for highly complex, safety-critical sensing systems.

Nice to have (optional):
? Strong knowledge and experience working on Camera drivers and camera pipelines using hardware accelerators such as ISP and encoders.
? Track record of technical leadership in automotive or related fields taking products to production.

job.title: Embedded Software Engineer – RTOS, Automotive
job.description:
Embedded Software Engineer – RTOS, Automotive, Wireless

We need Embedded Software Engineers (varied seniority levels) and be part of the microcontroller which is designing the software stack from ground up to enable a best in class vehicle infotainment platform using the latest technologies. You will be contributing to key features like vehicle access, networking and power management for highly complex systems across various domains to improve performance as well as the user experience for customers.

Job Responsibilities
What you'll do…
  • Define, design and develop complex embedded software features with multiple stakeholders for the next generation of Electric Vehicles.
  • Collaborate with the Software, Hardware, Systems and Integration teams to develop requirements, design system architecture, develop software and functional test cases for features and including CI/CD tests wherever applicable.
  • Lead the effort to diagnose and improve existing features to enhance the customer experience.
  • Collaborate with teams across software, hardware, integration, UI/UX and others to drive innovation and tackle any issues that arise throughout the product development cycle.
  • Develop tooling as well as diagnostic and other interfaces between various vehicle access components.
  • Integrate the software and feature into the controller’s codebase.
  • Use data driven analysis tools to verify and diagnose vehicle software in the field.
     
Basic qualifications we are looking for:
  • 5-8+ years proven working experience in software engineering.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded systems.
  • Experience in automotive systems and applications.
  • Strong programming skills & experience in C, C++ and Python.
  • Experience with Real Time Operating Systems (RTOS), Linux and building concurrent systems.
  • Experience with automotive networks like CAN, LIN, automotive Ethernet
  • Experience with wireless networks like BLE, UWB, NFC and WiFi.
  • Strong documentation, writing, and communications skills.

Even better, you may have…
  • Familiarity with Vector and Intrepid tools
  • Familiarity with MISRA, AutoSAR and functional safety (ISO 26262)
  • Experience negotiating with hardware and or software vendors

Need individuals who have experience working with some of the following:
  • Digital  Key  / Phone as a Key (PaaK) - The main item that needs immediate help
    • Wireless tech stack - NFC, BLE, UWB and their nitty gritty. 
    • Experience with and understanding of the CCC 3.x specifications.
    • Ability to comprehend the CCC specs and translate them into Software Systems Engineering and Architecture.
    • Data exchange and handshake between various ECUs and Cloud.
    • Phone localization using UWB anchors/sensors data.
    • Ability to write embedded software applicable to the E2E development of the PaaK Feature.
  • Core Embedded Platform Software development experience.
    • OTA E2E development and validation.
    • Hands on working, development and debugging knowledge of SPI, CAN, Ethernet communication protocols.
    • NXP Development Environment - NXP Design Studio, RTD Drivers (currently on 4.0 and need to migrate to 5.0), NXP FS26 PMIC and other FuSA drivers, other NXP items (evolving scope based on Platform team's findings and direction).
    • GHS Development Stack - Compiler, uVelocity RTOS, GHNET,

job.title: Warehouse Technician, M-F, 3PM-12PM.
job.description:
Warehouse Technician
We are seeking a hands-on Warehouse Technician to support receiving, inventory control, material organization, shipping, and internal fulfillment across warehouse and engineering lab environments. This role will ensure engineers have timely access to the parts, tools, equipment, and supplies needed to support hardware development, testing, and builds. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and comfortable working in a fast-paced technical environment. This role may require transporting materials between nearby facilities.

Scope:

Receiving and Material Handling:
• Pick up incoming packages and deliveries from loading docks and transport them to designated receiving areas.
• Receive, inspect, and log incoming components, assemblies, tools, equipment, and supplies.
• Record item details in internal systems and check materials into inventory tracking systems.
• Verify quantities, part numbers, and documentation against purchase orders and packing lists.
• Coordinate with Supply Chain, Logistics, and Engineering teams to resolve discrepancies or missing information.
• Label and route materials to laboratories, storage locations, or build areas.
• Package items and prepare materials for outbound shipment.
• Coordinate package and material movement between facilities.

Inventory and Organization:
• Maintain accurate inventory records using ERP systems, spreadsheets, and inventory tracking tools.
• Maintain real-time visibility into material status, location, and availability.
• Organize storage areas to support efficient retrieval and clear part identification.
• Conduct cycle counts and support inventory reconciliation and audit activities.
• Identify opportunities to improve labeling, storage systems, and material flow efficiency.

Warehouse Operations:
• Maintain clean, safe, and organized warehouse and laboratory spaces.
• Operate basic material-handling equipment, including pallet jacks and carts.
• Follow safety and handling requirements for sensitive, fragile, ESD-sensitive, and high-value components.
• Support the development and maintenance of warehouse procedures and material-handling processes.
Engineering and Lab Support:
• Serve as a point of contact for engineers requesting parts, tools, equipment, and supplies.
• Pick, stage, and distribute inventory for engineering builds, testing activities, and daily operations.
• Support efficient material movement to help engineering teams remain productive and on schedule.
 

Estimated Min Rate: $15.00
Estimated Max Rate: $20.00

job.title: Corporate Marketing Manager
job.description:
Corporate Marketing Manager Networking / Ethernet Switching / AI Infrastructure Overview Seeking a hands-on Corporate Marketing Manager to develop and execute marketing programs for advanced networking and AI infrastructure technologies. This role is ideal for an experienced individual contributor who can independently translate complex technical concepts into compelling content for technical, business, and industry audiences.

The ideal candidate brings corporate marketing experience from a networking, switching, semiconductor, cloud infrastructure, or AI technology company and is comfortable owning initiatives from concept through execution.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute corporate marketing initiatives supporting product launches, company announcements, and go-to-market programs.
  • Independently create high-quality technical and thought-leadership content including blogs, social media, podcasts, executive communications, and product messaging.
  • Translate technologies such as Ethernet switching, routing, data center networking, network operating systems, and AI infrastructure into clear, engaging market-facing content.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Engineering, Sales, PR, and executive leadership to develop messaging and drive initiatives from concept through completion.
  • Manage multiple content and communications programs while maintaining technical accuracy, consistency, and strong market positioning.
Required Qualifications
  • 5-7 years of Corporate Marketing, Content Marketing, Communications, or related B2B technology marketing experience.
  • Strong technical fluency, ideally within networking, Ethernet switching, data center infrastructure, AI infrastructure, cloud networking, or semiconductor markets.
  • Proven hands-on experience personally developing technical content, thought leadership, blogs, social media, podcasts, product launches, and related communications.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills with the ability to understand technical information and communicate it effectively to multiple audiences.
  • Self-directed individual contributor with demonstrated success working across Product, Engineering, Sales, and other functions to execute initiatives end to end.
Preferred Background Experience within networking or infrastructure organizations such as Cisco, Juniper Networks, Arista Networks, NVIDIA Networking/Mellanox, Broadcom, Marvell, HPE/Aruba, Extreme Networks, Ciena, Nokia, Dell Networking, or similar technology companies.

This role will support a technical program owner while partnering closely with technical leads responsible for facility developments within large?scale data centers.
