job.title: Help Desk Analyst I
job.description:
Service Desk Analyst 1— Hybrid | Topeka, KS

Be the first friendly, knowledgeable point of contact for IT support—helping internal employees, contractors, and interns get back to work quickly when technology issues arise. As a Service Desk Analyst I, you’ll troubleshoot and resolve incidents and service requests across hardware, software, mobile devices, Microsoft 365, identity/access, and connectivity in a ServiceNow-driven environment. This role is ideal for a customer-focused support professional who thrives in a fast-paced setting, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical users, and takes pride in delivering reliable, secure support. Required Skills:
  • 2+ years supporting end users in a Service Desk/Help Desk/Desktop Support (or similar) environment
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across:
    • Windows 10/11 workstations and laptops
    • Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
    • VPN/connectivity and basic network troubleshooting
    • End-user hardware and peripherals (laptops, monitors, docking stations, printers, webcams, etc.)
  • Ability to document, track, and manage work in ServiceNow (Incidents/Requests/Knowledge) while meeting service level expectations
  • Excellent customer service skills: active listening, clear communication, professionalism, and sound judgment
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests, work independently, and navigate multiple applications at once
  • Working knowledge of security best practices, user verification, and data protection standards
Nice to Have Skills:
  • Experience with:
    • Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), account management, access provisioning, and MFA enrollment
    • Microsoft Intune or other endpoint/mobile device management (MDM) tools
    • Citrix virtual desktop/application environments
    • Corporate-issued iOS/Android device enrollment, configuration, troubleshooting, and lifecycle support
    • Remote support tools and knowledge-centered support practices
Preferred Education and Experience:
  • Experience supporting enterprise technologies in a large corporate environment or utility organization (preferred)
  • Industry certifications (preferred): CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft Certifications, and/or ITIL Foundation
Other Requirements:
  • Work schedule: Eight-hour shifts covering core hours Monday–Friday, 6:30 AM–5:00 PM, including a mandatory one-hour lunch and two 15-minute breaks
  • Participation in a rotating after-hours on-call schedule
  • Hybrid work: Onsite for initial equipment setup and training; after training period, minimum 1 day/week onsite
  • Must reside within a 60-minute commute of the Topeka General Office (Topeka, KS)
  • In-person interviews required
  • Must have reliable internet service and phone access for remote work
  • Parking near the Topeka General Office is limited to nearby garages with a daily rate; parking is the employee’s responsibility
Ready to put your customer-first mindset and troubleshooting skills to work in a mission-driven IT environment? Apply today and let’s get started.

job.title: Network/Telecom Project Manager (ONSITE)
job.description:
Network/Telecom Project Manager (ONSITE) needed for a contract opportunity with Yoh Staffing’s client working in Boston, MA.

  • Pay Rate: $55-62/hr
  • ONSITE
What You’ll Be Doing:
  • Responsible for complete execution of all network and telecommunication projects from initiation to closure. 
  • This position will define initial project scope and resources both internal to NU and external vendor resources, milestones, and deadlines in coordination with the functional areas, Information Services technical groups as well as external vendors. 
  • The IPM will manage all submitted vendor RFPs and award vendor contracts to ensure successful and quality implementation of network and telecommunication projects based on specific standards and best practices and design specifications.
  • The IPM directs external vendors on execution of design specifications, implementation and successful deployment of network and telecommunications technologies. This includes working internally with the facilities department, academic and administrative departments on renovations and new construction of network and telecommunications requirements.
  • Perform exact design of structured cabling systems required based on project requirements, including writing technical specifications based on building codes.
  • Appoint and manage vendor/subcontractor projects such as installation and servicing cable (copper, coaxial, fiber-optic), optical, telecommunications and T1 networks as well as enterprise-wide, student residential and cabling networks such as NUnet, ResNet and HuskyCable.
  • Responsible for estimating and budgeting of cable infrastructure projects as well as structured cabling bid and specification analysis.   

Required:
  • Knowledge of BCSI standards
  • Basic construction background
  • 3+ years of project management experience in a network infrastructure environment.
  • To ensure that essential services are provided to the university community, the employee will be required to work outside regular working hours and on some university holidays.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field is preferred. 
  • Progressive work experience in network infrastructure, structured cable, with strong project management and troubleshooting; hands-on experience.
  • Current RCDD desired, Inactive RCDD or RCDD LAN Specialist, Installer, Technician required.
  • Demonstrated strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent problem solving and decision-making skills.
  • Familiarity with blueprints, construction documentation, and AutoCAD.

  • This is a unique opportunity to support our client; one of the area’s largest universities. Medical benefits and 401K are available.

job.title: Business Systems Analyst - Travel & Expense
job.description:
Business Systems Analyst Concur/Workday - onsite HYBRID in Boston!!!

Concur (Travel & Expense) — Business Purpose Justification (client is open to T&E systems outside of Concur)

*Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. No C2C!!

The Division of Information Technology Services (ITS) seeks a hands-on BSA Contractor to support the ITS administration transition of Concur, the university's travel and expense (T&E) platform. ITS is assuming full system ownership by June 30, 2025, and needs an experienced contractor to drive access remediation, workflow documentation, and stakeholder alignment alongside the ITS ERP Applications team.


Experience

3+ years of BSA or system administration experience with Concur or a comparable T&E / expense management platform.

Working knowledge of Workday Financials — specifically expense reporting workflows and Concur-to-Workday integration points.

Demonstrated ability to document business process workflows, approval configurations, and system access models.

Experience with role-based access management and security remediation in enterprise financial applications.

Proven ability to manage competing priorities and deliver in lean, fast-moving environments.


Skills & Competencies

Solid understanding of T&E business processes — expense policy, reimbursement workflows, approval chains, and audit controls.

Proficiency with Jira or comparable project tracking tools.

Clear written and verbal communication skills; able to work effectively with Finance and business stakeholders.

Self-directed with strong organizational and documentation skills.



1. System Administration & Access Remediation

Perform day-to-day Concur system administration tasks during the ITS transition period.

Ensure role configurations align with ITS security standards and audit requirements.


2. Workflow Documentation & Current-State Mapping

Document current-state Concur T&E workflows, approval chains, expense policies, and system configurations.

Identify and map integration touchpoints with Workday Financials; flag dependencies requiring resolution before go-live.

Contribute to the ITS RACI, transition plan, and go-live readiness documentation.



3. Stakeholder Engagement & Ownership Model Definition

Engage Finance and Travel business owners to define and validate the ITS vs. business ownership and support model.

Facilitate alignment sessions to confirm operational responsibilities, escalation paths, and transition acceptance criteria.



4. Go-Live Readiness & Transition Support

Track milestones and maintain Jira as transition tasks are completed.

Support go-live readiness validation and contribute inputs to weekly executive reporting.

job.title: Scientist, Analytical Development - ONSITE - Cambridge, MA
job.description:
Scientist, Analytical Development - ONSITE - Cambridge, MA


The Scientist, is part of Analytical Development Starting Material Group and will be responsible for

• Develop, qualify and transfer GC, HPLC, UPLC and mass spectrometry based

• assays of starting materials, raw materials, intermediates and excipients to suppliers,

• CMOs and QC.

• Identify impurity profiles and provide data to set impurity limits.

• Understand and apply advanced scientific principles, theories, concepts, practices

• and standards to process and analytical development.

• Author and review method development and qualification reports and SOP’s for test

• methods, as well as transfer / qualification protocols and reports related to critical starting

• materials / intermediates / excipients.

• Provide analytical support externally and internally.

Qualifications

• Ph.D. in Analytical Chemistry, Organic Chemistry or related disciplines with > 1 year

• biopharmaceutical experience or equivalent.

• Master degree with > 5 years biopharmaceutical experience respectively, with

• demonstrated chromatographic separation, method development / qualification and

• structure elucidation expertise.

• Strong knowledge of fundamental chromatographic separation mechanisms in both

• gas phase and liquid phase, proven years of excellent hands-on method development and

• optimization experience on HPLC, UPLC and GC for separation of molecules and isomers.

• Sound background in organic chemistry with a focus on structure characterization

• and elucidation of synthetic molecules through determination and interpretation of mass

• spectrometry and NMR data.

• Self-motivated, excellent communication, writing and reviewing skills.

• Familiarity with Waters and Agilent (U)HPLC and Mass Spectrometery hardware.

• Familiarity with Empower, Masslynx, Masshunter, and XCalibur CDS are preferred.

• Experience in peptide and/or oligonucletide analysis is a plus.





INTAKE NOTES:
For req CAMB000215 the candidate will be working with and around Bloodborne Pathogens.  If this is something you are unable to support ; please let me know and decline the req.

Candidate must have either PHD with 1 year of exp, max 5 years or Masters with 5 years of exp, max 10 years.

job.description:
Scientist, Process Sciences - Onsite, Cambridge, MA

Overview

The Scientist, Process Sciences will be responsible for the development, characterization, and scale up of oligonucleotide manufacturing processes. The successful candidate will work in the laboratory and closely with cross functional teams and manufacturing organizations on process development, process transfer, and oversight of oligonucleotide drug candidate manufacturing.

This position is onsite.

Key Responsibilities

• Contribute to process development, optimization, and scale up of oligonucleotide manufacturing processes.

• Support process and product characterization of small molecules and oligonucleotide APIs.

• Contribute to the management and optimization of in house and contract manufacturing processes.

• Author and review technical protocols and development reports in support of manufacturing and process characterization activities.

• Author, edit, and review manufacturing documentation according to regulatory and procedural guidelines.

• Work closely with Analytical Development, Manufacturing, QA, QC, and CMO/CRO partners on process transfer and process optimization.

• Contribute to strategic technical discussions and present progress at internal and external scientific meetings.

Qualifications

• Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, or a related field.

• 3 years of experience with oligonucleotide therapeutics process research and development preferred.

• Demonstrated proficiency in the design and development of practical processes for the manufacture of small molecules and oligonucleotides.

• Hands on experience in process development and analytical methods for process and product characterization.

• Excellent organizational and communication skills.

• Demonstrated strong operational execution and problem solving skills.

• Desire to work in a fast paced, deadline driven environment.

NOC Technician (2nd Shift)

Join our dynamic team as a NOC Technican and become a vital part of ensuring the seamless operation of cutting-edge fiber optic networks. This exciting second shift opportunity offers a competitive hourly rate and a chance to work on the frontline of telecommunications technology. As a NOC Tech, you'll monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve network issues in real-time, providing exceptional support to customers and collaborating closely with field teams to maintain optimal network performance.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strong familiarity with trouble ticketing systems and network monitoring tools
  • Knowledge of LAN/WAN technologies, fiber optics, and circuit testing procedures
  • Excellent communication skills with a customer-focused approach
  • Ability to multitask and work efficiently under pressure in a 24/7 environment
  • Flexibility to work Sunday-Thursday or Tuesday-Saturday, 3:00 PM – 11:30 PM
 

Preferred Education and Experience:

  • Technical training in telecommunications or related field
  • Over 1 year of hands-on NOC experience in a telecommunications setting
Other Requirements:

  • Willingness to work flexible hours in a 24/7 operational environment

Take your network expertise to the next level—apply today and become a key player in maintaining world-class telecommunications infrastructure!

job.title: Business System Analyst for Jaggaer/Workday
job.description:
Business System Analyst for Jaggaer/Workday - MUST BE LOCAL TO BOSTON, NO RELOCATION!

 Jaggaer (P2P) — Business Purpose Justification

*This role is open to candidates with P2P experience outside of Jaggaer!

ITS is assuming full administrative ownership of Jaggaer, the university's procure-to-pay platform, by June 30, 2025. The transition requires dedicated system administration support that the current ITS ERP Applications team cannot absorb without risk to steady-state operations. This contractor will close an active security gap — restricting system access to ITS-only personnel within the required four-week remediation window — while documenting current-state workflows, validating the ownership model with business stakeholders, and driving go-live readiness.

Client: Northeastern  University
Location: onsite hybrid schedule in Boston 
Duration: 6 month contract 
Pay Rate: $55-59/hr on W2 

*CANDIDATES MUST BE ABLE TO WORK DIRECTLY ON A W2 WITHOUT SPONSORSHIP. NO C2C!!


The Division of Information Technology Services (ITS) seeks a hands-on BSA Contractor to support the ITS administration transition of Jaggaer, the university's procure-to-pay (P2P) platform. ITS is assuming full system ownership by June 30, 2025, and needs an experienced contractor to support access remediation, workflow documentation, and go-live readiness alongside the ITS ERP Applications team.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of BSA or system administration experience with Jaggaer or a comparable P2P / procurement platform.
  • Hands-on experience supporting or administering Workday integrations, particularly procurement-to-finance data flows.
  • Demonstrated ability to document business process workflows, system configurations, and access models.
  • Experience with role-based access management and security remediation in enterprise applications.
  • Proven track record working in fast-moving, matrixed environments with multiple stakeholders.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of P2P business processes — purchase orders, approvals, supplier management, and catalog administration.
  • Proficiency with Jira or comparable project tracking tools.
  • Clear communicator — able to translate technical detail for procurement and finance business owners.
  • Self-directed with strong organizational skills and the ability to work independently.

Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities:


1. System Administration & Access Remediation

  • Perform day-to-day Jaggaer system administration tasks during the ITS transition period.
  • Execute role and access remediation — identify and close gaps where system access extends beyond ITS personnel.
  • Align role assignments to ITS security standards within the four-week remediation window.

2. Workflow Documentation & Current-State Mapping

  • Document current-state Jaggaer business process workflows, system configurations, and integration dependencies.
  • Map P2P workflow touchpoints with Workday and identify any dependencies requiring resolution prior to go-live.
  • Contribute to the ITS RACI and transition plan documentation.

3. Stakeholder Engagement & Ownership Model Definition

  • Partner with Procurement and Finance business owners to validate the ITS vs. business ownership and support model.
  • Facilitate working sessions to align on operational responsibilities, escalation paths, and go-live readiness criteria.

4. Go-Live Readiness & Transition Support

  • Track milestones and update Jira as transition tasks are completed.
  • Support go-live readiness validation and contribute to weekly executive reporting through the ITS ERP Applications Lead.
  • Identify risks and escalate blockers in a timely manner to keep the June 30 target on track.

job.description:
Digital Solutions Engineer - must be local to BOSTON! 

Candidates must be able to work directly on a W2 without sponsorship. NO C2C!!!

Location: onsite 3 days/week in Boston
Duration: 6 month contract
Pay Rate: $52-59/hr on W2 
  • Strong experience with AI technologies, specifically Large Language Models (LLMs) and machine learning implementations
  • Proficiency in Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) for automation and solution development
  • Experience with API integrations and enterprise system connectivity
  • Solid understanding of accessibility standards and inclusive design principles
  • Familiarity with higher education technology environments is a plus
Core Competencies:
  • Solutions-oriented mindset with the ability to translate complex user needs into practical technical implementations
  • Experience automating manual processes and improving operational efficiency
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders
  • Ability to provide technical consultation and training to end users
  • Comfort with iterative development approaches and starting simple before building complexity
Cultural Fit: Looking for someone who values collaboration, continuous learning, and can contribute to our team's "getting better every day" philosophy. They should be excited about reducing manual processes through automation and AI innovation.

1.     Job Summary Information Technology Services is seeking a technically proficient and solutions-oriented individual to fill the role of Digital Solutions Engineer. This role serves as the technical implementation specialist within the Digital Solutions and Global Client Experience team, working in close partnership with Digital Solutions Consultants to bring digital transformation initiatives to life.

The Digital Solutions Engineer focuses on designing, building, and implementing technical solutions based on requirements gathered by the Digital Solutions Consultants. While the Consultant focuses on client relationships and business needs assessment, the Engineer applies technical expertise to transform those requirements into functional solutions using the university's technology stack.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical knowledge of digital productivity tools and platforms, with the ability to configure, integrate, and customize solutions that meet specific business requirements. They will collaborate with consultants to understand client needs, provide technical guidance on solution feasibility, and implement solutions that enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and improve the overall digital experience.

Areas of technical focus include:
  • Process Automation: Building workflows and automated solutions using Microsoft 365 Power Platform, ServiceNow, and other platforms to modernize business processes identified by consultants.
  • Collaboration Platform Configuration: Implementing and configuring Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and other collaboration tools based on client requirements documented by consultants.
  • Digital Productivity Solutions: Developing digital productivity solutions using various tools and technologies to address specific client needs.
  • Technical Integration: Connecting systems and tools to create seamless workflows across platforms.
  • Audio-Visual (AV) Solutions: Designing and implementing technical AV solutions for collaboration spaces based on specifications developed with consultants.

The Digital Solutions Engineer translates conceptual designs into technical implementation plans, builds solutions according to specifications, tests thoroughly to ensure quality, and provides technical documentation to support knowledge transfer. They work collaboratively with other IT teams when more complex development is required, ensuring seamless handoffs and integration.
 

24/7 business continuity:

This role requires occasional availability outside of traditional working hours to address urgent business needs as they arise, including, but not limited to, responding to security incidents, supporting software deployments, resolving software issues or system breaks, and addressing other critical operational requirements. The ideal candidate must be proactive and adaptable, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations by promptly addressing any issues, regardless of time or day. Flexibility and a strong sense of urgency are essential for success in this position.

Other duties as required:

This role requires flexibility in performing duties outside of the primary responsibilities to support evolving business needs. The ideal candidate must be adaptable and willing to take on additional tasks or projects as required, ensuring smooth operations across the organization. This may include stepping in to assist with cross-functional teams, handling unexpected challenges, or contributing to initiatives that support business growth and success. A proactive mindset and the ability to pivot quickly are essential for thriving in this dynamic environment.


·      Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience

·      Advanced technical proficiency with the Microsoft 365 suite of tools—specifically Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, To Do, Forms, and Outlook

·      Strong expertise with the Microsoft 365 Power Suite (PowerAutomate, PowerBI, PowerApps) with demonstrated ability to build custom solutions

·      Experience with PowerShell scripting for automation and administration

·      Demonstrated ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions

·      Experience building, testing, and implementing digital solutions in a professional environment

·      Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking abilities

·      Excellent attention to detail and quality control mindset

·      Ability to document technical solutions clearly for knowledge transfer

·      Experience working collaboratively with business analysts or consultants

·      Strong understanding of information security best practices

·      Ability to manage multiple technical projects simultaneously

·      Preferred qualifications:

·      Experience in higher education or similar complex organizational environment

·      Familiarity with audio-visual technologies, particularly Microsoft Teams Room Systems

·      Knowledge of API integration techniques

·      Experience with ServiceNow platform configuration

·      Scrum/Agile project experience

Average is 2-4 shifts a month (sometimes more). The clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative care for employees of a corporate office.

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of Arizona
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Preferred experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, Corrections, or School Nursing type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Professional, dedicated, friendly, and helpful employee

What You’ll Be Doing:

job.title: Financial Portfolio Management Manager
job.description:
Financial Portfolio Management Manager
12+ month contract
Downtown Dallas, TX (Hybrid 3-4 days a week and onsite interview)
 
Must have Financial Planning of Technology Department experience

Role Summary
Leads Technology Financial Portfolio Management services across the organization, overseeing financial planning, forecasting, investment management, governance, and financial operations. Responsible for ensuring financial transparency, funding alignment, compliance, and informed investment decisions that support Technology's strategic and operational objectives.


Key Responsibilities
  • Lead Technology CapEx, OpEx, and System Resiliency Plan (SRP) financial management activities.
  • Oversee annual budgets, monthly forecasts, long-range planning, and financial reporting.
  • Establish financial governance, controls, processes, and performance measures.
  • Partner with Technology leadership, AIS, Accounting, Finance, Strategy, and Portfolio Management teams.
  • Oversee CWIP management, asset capitalization, project placements in service, and asset retirements.
  • Ensure compliance with accounting principles, capitalization policies, SOX controls, and regulatory requirements.
  • Lead and develop Financial Portfolio Management Leads and Financial Services Analysts.
  • Confirm and abide by all procedures, policies and regulatory guidance.
  • Leverage and maintain applicable systems and tools as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Deliverables
  • Annual Technology budget and monthly forecast packages.
  • Five-year Technology financial and investment plans.
  • Executive financial dashboards, reporting, and presentations.
  • Investment analysis and funding recommendations.
  • CWIP aging reports and in-service compliance reporting.
  • Asset retirement plans and financial impact assessments.
  • Financial governance processes, SOX documentation, and audit support materials.
  • Portfolio financial performance and variance analysis.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • MBA, CPA, CMA, or other relevant financial certification preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, accounting, or investment management.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Experience managing CapEx, OpEx, investment portfolios, and long-range financial plans.
  • Experience supporting audits, SOX controls, financial governance, and compliance activities.
  • Experience presenting financial information to senior leadership and executives.
  • Financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.
  • Understanding of utility accounting, capitalization policies, CWIP management, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Experience supporting technology organizations, technology investments, or project portfolios.
  • Knowledge of demand planning, portfolio planning, and investment prioritization processes.
  • Strong financial modeling, analytics, and reporting capabilities.
  • Ability to translate complex financial data into executive-level insights and recommendations.
  • Experience with ERP, financial planning, portfolio management, and reporting tools.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to lead process improvements and establish scalable financial controls.

job.description:
TEMPORARY ROYALTY ADMINISTRATOR

We’re seeking a talented and motivated professional to join our client's team. This is an excellent opportunity to apply your skills, contribute to meaningful projects, and grow within a collaborative, supportive environment.


Job Details

Duration: 6 months contract W2
Pay Rate: $24-$34 hourly 
Location: Arlington VA, Hybrid or Remote - EST Schedule 



RESPONSIBILTIES:
  • Enter and maintain contract and payment terms in Company rights and royalty systems.
  • Ensure the quarterly reporting process, payment calculations and distribution statements are accurate, complete, and delivered to meet contractual obligations.
  • Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve any processing or reporting errors in a timely manner.
  • Utilize and maintain cross-functional ticketing system to ensure royalty related tasks are tracked and completed in required timeframes.
  • Coordinate workflows to process, prepare, publish, pay, and deliver distribution statements each quarter.

  • 2-4 years of experience with royalty (preferred), contract, or rights management software such as Alliant, Vistex, RightsLine (a must)
  • Experience with a project management or ticket tracking systems, such as Jira

EDUCATION/TRAINING:
 
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related experience
 

SKILLS:
  • Knowledge of the media or publishing industry and royalty management
  • Ability to read and interpret contracts to identify and understand business terms
  • Excellent attention to detail, analytical, and organization skills
  • Ability to prioritize and complete multiple projects simultaneously
  • Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex tasks
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Intermediate Excel skills, such as V-lookups and pivot tables; advanced Excel skills preferred

job.title: Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Taiwan
job.description:
Materials Program Manager (MPM) - Taiwan

Looking for a solid Materials Program Manager to support an autonomous vehicle companies Supply Chain department. This person should have a background in materials planning and understand the key vendors involved in electronics components, mechanical components, automotive components, etc.

 

The key responsibility for this job will be manual demand planning (Manual MRP experience). There is no SAP, ERP, or SW suite that will be utilized, this is all manual production planning/Manual MRP’s through Excel/GSheets, so advanced Excel or GSheet’s experience is a must have.

 

Scope:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. This is the MPM's primary task which will be focused on. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Degree in Supply Chain or similar is ideal.

• Analyze manufacturing build plans against inventory/supply chain data in order to determine demand for materials replenishment.

• Retrieve quotes from suppliers & submit PO’s.

• Manage delivery schedules in order to ensure materials arrive ahead of required dates.

• Track/Mitigate Excess and Obsolescence.

 

Required:

• Strong understanding of the “Clear To Build” report AKA CTB. Some companies call it a shortage report or build status report. Note: CTB “Clear to Build” is essentially an MRP. Building stuff in batches/batch building aka Batch Production, job production, lot production, etc. are all additional terms associated with CTB/MRP’s.

• Experience with Manual Demand Planning, Manual Production Planning, Manual MRP is the key requirement.

• Advanced spreadsheet / Excel skills; Ability to generate complex dashboards, tools, and reports. Experience with excel formulas like - VLOOKUP, SUMIF, COUNTIF, IFERROR, INDEX, MATCH, MIN, etc.

• Solid experience working as a Materials PM, Buyer/Planner, Materials Planners, or similar.

• Understand how to read and understand bill of materials (BOM’s) and manage inventory accuracy.

• Strong knowledge of MRP (Materials Requirements Planning) system functionality.

job.title: Proofpoint Email Security Analyst
job.description:
Proofpoint Email Security Analyst
Contract to Hire
McKinney, TX (Hybrid)
 
Responsibilities
  • Monitor Proofpoint dashboards, alerts, quarantine queues, digest activity, abuse mailboxes, and user-reported phishing submissions.
  • Triage and investigate email threats including phishing, business email compromise (BEC), impersonation, malware delivery, spam, and fraudulent communications.
  • Determine risk using email artifacts such as headers, sender reputation, authentication results (SPF/DKIM/DMARC), URLs, attachments, domains, and message content.
  • Use Proofpoint search / message tracking capabilities to identify campaign scope and locate malicious messages across impacted mailboxes.
  • Execute containment actions in Proofpoint: block/deny-list malicious senders, domains, URLs, and other indicators; manage allow/deny logic where appropriate.
  • Drive remediation and takedown actions (e.g., message removal guidance, user notification, escalation to IR/SOC when needed).
  • Administer and continuously tune Proofpoint policies, detection rules, and protection controls to improve efficacy and reduce false positives.
  • Review quarantined messages and determine whether messages should be released, blocked, or escalated, documenting rationale and outcomes.
  • Maintain and refine block lists, allow lists, and exception workflows with strong change control and documentation.
  • Monitor and assist with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC posture to reduce spoofing/impersonation risk.
  • Identify misconfigurations and coordinate corrective actions with domain owners, Microsoft 365 administrators, and relevant business stakeholders.
  • Support investigations involving account compromise, suspicious mailbox rules/forwarding, unusual email access patterns, and suspicious outbound activity.
  • Coordinate with SOC, IAM, Incident Response, Microsoft 365, Legal, HR, and business leaders during sensitive investigations.
  • Document investigation steps, findings, remediation actions, recurring attack patterns, and lessons learned.
  • Create and maintain SOPs and response playbooks for Proofpoint-driven workflows (triage, quarantine review, campaign response, indicator blocking).
  • Track and report email-security metrics: message volume, blocked threats, phishing trends, user reporting rates, false positives, remediation SLAs, and emerging TTPs.
  • Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks across investigation, containment, and reporting.
  • Support email-security projects such as Proofpoint enhancements, platform upgrades, policy changes, onboarding new domains/business units, and M&A-related integration.
 
Required Skills
  • Demonstrated experience using Proofpoint in an operational security role (monitoring, quarantine triage, investigations, policy tuning).
  • Strong knowledge of phishing/BEC tradecraft and email analysis (headers, routing, URLs/attachments, domain reputation).
  • Working understanding of Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online concepts and email authentication (SPF/DKIM/DMARC).
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical users.
  • Ability to document work cleanly and operate effectively in an alert-driven environment.

job.title: Systems Administrator – Microsoft 365 & Identity Management
job.description:
Systems Administrator – Microsoft 365 & Identity Management
6 month contract to hire (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
Irving, TX (Hybrid)

Seeking a senior Systems Administrator to own day-to-day administration and optimization of our Microsoft 365 environment, endpoint management via Intune, and on-premises/hybrid Active Directory infrastructure. This is a hands-on role for someone comfortable working independently, troubleshooting complex identity and endpoint issues, and driving improvements across our M365 and directory services stack. 

Key Responsibilities
  • Administer and support the full Microsoft 365 suite (Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive, Entra ID) including licensing, security policies, and service health monitoring.
  • Manage endpoint configuration, compliance policies, app deployment, and device lifecycle through Microsoft Intune (MDM/MAM) across Windows, and mobile platforms.
  • Administer on-premises Active Directory and hybrid identity (Entra Connect/AD Connect), including OU structure, GPOs, replication health, and directory synchronization.
  • Manage user and device lifecycle: onboarding/offboarding, access provisioning, security group management, and conditional access policies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve escalated tickets related to identity, authentication, endpoint compliance, and M365 service issues.
  • Support Microsoft 365 security posture: MFA, conditional access, Defender for Endpoint/Office 365, and Purview/compliance configurations.
  • Maintain documentation for configurations, standard operating procedures, and change management records.
  • Partner with IT leadership on infrastructure projects, including migrations, upgrades, and security hardening initiatives.
  • Participate in on-call rotation and respond to after-hours incidents as needed.
Required Qualifications
  • 5-8 years of hands-on systems administration experience in an enterprise environment.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID).
  • Deep, hands-on expertise with Microsoft Intune for endpoint/device management and compliance.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Active Directory administration (GPOs, OUs, replication, hybrid identity/AD Connect).
  • Solid understanding of identity security concepts: conditional access, MFA, RBAC, and least-privilege principles.
  • Experience with PowerShell scripting for administration and automation tasks, including the Microsoft Graph PowerShell SDK.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to work independently on complex, ambiguous issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate, or Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate.
  • Experience in a multi-site or manufacturing/industrial environment.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Defender suite and Purview compliance tools.
  • Experience with Azure infrastructure administration.

Policy Specialist
Tuesday-Saturday

Looking for a Policy Specialist to join a team that’s responsible for providing policy guidance to our Customer Support and Operations teams. You'll be in charge of case management across a wide array of policy areas. To thrive in this role, you must be: a strong writer, detail oriented, good at breaking down complex issues into simple language, passionate about trust & safety, and motivated by investigative work

• Serve as subject matter expert and provide policy guidance to Customer Support and Operations agents

• Experience working closely with or on a Customer Support or Operations team

job.title: Engineering Process Technician-Sample Cleaning
job.description:
Sample Cleaning Semiconductor Engineering Process Technician neede for an 18-month contract to hire opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Santa Clara, California.


Shifts Available: Grave yard shift 9pm-7:30am Monday-Thursday. 4 day 10 hours.


Pay Rate: $27 to $31 per hour


The Big Picture – Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Solid interpersonal skills
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Ability to quickly adapt to change


What You Will Be Doing:
  • Prepares samples for experiments include cleaning samples, mount / un-mount samples, loading FOUPs, prepare jobs for experimentation, to help evaluates performance of process system ·
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples by focused ion beam (FIB) and help to optimize sample prep procedure and conditions, identify cutting location based on pattern instructions. ·
  • Operate metrology tools in FIB & TEM lab to help understand cross section or top view critical dimension (CD), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis, take high-quality imaging pending on job assignment, identify all of patterns of interest, understand image quality requirement and sample/beam interaction to determine optimized condition, finish requested jobs under limited supervision after training.
  • Understand basic scanning electron microscopy (SEM)/Focused Ion Beam (FIB)/Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) principle. ·
  • Perform SEM/FIB/TEM system, perform routine maintenance procedures, flash, plasma clean, image calibrations etc. ·
  • Perform routine shut down procedure.
  • Identify problem put tool down and call for service.
  • Coordinates instrument repair and maintenance. ·
  • Order equipment and supplies, and coordinates with vendors and purchasing.
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results,
  • Coordinates with engineering on job request status. ·
  • Help lab on monitoring job in the queue and maintaining lab throughput. ·
  • Document redo and lesson learn to lower redo rate ·
  • Pick up and drop off customer coupons from other labs if needed ·
  • Adhere to lab protocol and SOPs ·
  • Operate semiconductor process and metrology equipment in a lab environment ·
  • Operate metrology equipment and verify and upload data to network ·
  • Monitor data and track performance of metrology equipment and production activities per equipment requirement


Bonus Points! Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Understand written instructions to perform assigned tasks 
  • Create and update procedures and documentation 
  • Perform basic operations of Microsoft Outlook and Office software. 
  • Follow safety protocol and process ·
  • Work shift may include compressed work week schedule to meet the production
  • Ability to lift up to 30 lbs.


Functional Knowledge
  • Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks Business Expertise
  • Has a good understanding of how the team integrates with others to achieve objectives Leadership
  • May provide informal guidance and support to junior team members, lead/own a lab project etc Problem Solving 
  • Provides solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or infrequently occurring based on existing precedents or procedures, create SOPs if applicable Interpersonal Skills
  • Uses communication skills to regularly exchange information

Education:
  • Years of Experience: 1-2 Years
  • Education: Technical Diploma Skills Certifications

job.title: Land Survey Crew Chief - New York City, NY
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Survey Crew Chief to oversee survey operations for our Civil Engineering client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of overall surveying experience, prior experience as a Crew Chief and live within a commutable distance to the office New York City, NY for an onsite environment.

 

See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

 

Title: Land Survey Crew Chief

Compensation: $30.00-$40.00/hour (depending on experience level)

Type: Full Time

Industry: Civil Engineering

 

Responsibilities:

·      Lead field operations using advanced equipment such as Trimble, Leica, and Spectre robotic total stations, GPS RTK Units, and 3D Laser Scanners.

·      Manage data collection efficiently, ensuring seamless transfer and collaboration with office staff.

·      Maintain accurate documentation and organization of project files upon completion.

·      Utilize map interpretation skills to navigate projects effectively, including scaling drawings and deciphering symbols.

·      Guide the team with your comprehensive knowledge of survey types and their purposes.

·      Foster open communication with the Assistant/Project Manager and team members to address project needs promptly.

·      Take responsibility for equipment maintenance, ensuring optimal performance for each project.

·      Demonstrate initiative in optimizing task execution to enhance efficiency and productivity.

·      Utilize general computer applications proficiently to streamline surveying processes.

·      Embrace opportunities for growth and development through training and educational initiatives.

·      Be flexible to work overtime and travel with overnight stays as required by project demands.

·      Contribute your insights and creativity to our team culture, driving innovation and collaboration.

·      Demonstrate reliability and punctuality, essential qualities for success in this role.

 

Qualifications:

·      5+ years of surveying experience in AutoCAD Civil 3D, with demonstrated proficiency in producing clean and accurate plan presentations.

·      Strong math skills to ensure precise measurement and calculation in surveying tasks.

·      Proven record of producing clean and accurate plan presentations, showcasing attention to detail and quality.

·      Knowledge of field survey operations, as well as the engineering and construction industry, to effectively coordinate survey activities with project requirements.

·      Excellent organizational and communication skills, facilitating effective collaboration with team members and clients.

·      Ability to learn new software and technologies in a timely manner, adapting to evolving industry tools and methodologies.

·      Proficient with MS Word and Excel, enabling efficient documentation and data management processes.

job.title: IT Director (Retail Technologies)
job.description:
IT Director (Retail Technology)
Direct Hire
Dallas, TX
BASE + BONUS
 
Responsibilities
  • Own technology supporting retail store operations, including Point of Sale (POS), payment terminals, back-office systems, inventory management, receiving, fulfillment, and store productivity solutions.
  • Develop technology roadmaps that improve store associate efficiency and enhance the customer experience.
  • Lead new store technology deployments, hardware refresh initiatives, and retail technology modernization efforts.
  • Provide leadership for warehouse management systems and related technologies supporting distribution center operations, including inventory control, receiving, replenishment, picking, packing, shipping, returns, and cycle counting.
  • Partner with Supply Chain, Distribution Center leadership, Store Operations, eCommerce, and Finance teams to align warehouse technology capabilities with operational goals, fulfillment requirements, and business growth.
  • Oversee integrations between warehouse management systems, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, eCommerce platforms, order management systems, parcel carriers, inventory systems, and reporting platforms.
  • Drive technology initiatives that improve inventory accuracy, fulfillment speed, labor efficiency, shipment visibility, exception management, and overall distribution center performance.
  • Partner with eCommerce and Marketing teams to support seamless omnichannel customer journeys.
  • Oversee integrations between eCommerce platforms, order management systems, loyalty solutions, customer engagement platforms, and enterprise applications.
  • Drive initiatives that improve customer acquisition, retention, loyalty, and digital engagement.
  • Lead payment technology strategy, including card processing, payment terminals, digital wallets, Buy Now Pay Later solutions, gift card platforms, and payment security.
  • Lead fraud prevention and payment security initiatives, partnering with Finance, Loss Prevention, and third-party providers to identify emerging risks, implement controls, reduce fraud exposure, and protect company assets and customer transactions across all sales channels.
  • Partner with Finance to optimize payment processing costs and improve customer payment experiences.
  • Provide leadership for enterprise business applications supporting Retail, Supply Chain, Distribution, Finance, Customer Service, and Corporate Operations.
  • Establish application governance standards, release management processes, and technology roadmaps.
  • Oversee application delivery, operational support, system enhancements, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Manage relationships with strategic technology vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
  • Establish service-level expectations and accountability measures to ensure high-quality technology support and delivery.
  • Evaluate vendor capabilities, contracts, support models, performance, and technology roadmaps.
  • Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit, and Finance teams to ensure compliance with SOX, PCI, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee user access governance, segregation of duties reviews, change management processes, and application security controls.
  • Support risk management, audit readiness, and technology control initiatives across the enterprise.
  • Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on process automation, data quality, system performance, and operational efficiency.
  • Drive data governance initiatives that improve reporting accuracy, business insights, and decision-making capabilities.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in IT, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technology strategy, application delivery, and operational support within a retail, distribution, logistics, or omnichannel environment.
  • Experience managing complex system integrations between enterprise applications, eCommerce platforms, third-party service providers, payment processors, logistics providers, and customer engagement solutions.
  • Proven success leading digital transformation initiatives, business process optimization efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.
  • Experience developing and executing technology roadmaps aligned with business objectives and organizational growth strategies.
  • Strong understanding of retail operations, inventory management, supply chain processes, customer experience technologies, and omnichannel commerce.
  • Experience managing technology vendors, managed service providers, implementation partners, and strategic technology relationships.
  • Knowledge of IT governance, security controls, compliance requirements, disaster recovery planning, and risk management best practices.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage competing priorities, and deliver complex projects on time and within budget.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
  • Strong understanding of retail POS architecture, store systems, payment terminals, receipt printers, scanners, cash drawers, mobile devices, back-office systems, and store network dependencies.
  • Experience with payment technologies, including payment gateways, processors, card-present and card-not-present transactions, tokenization, digital wallets, gift cards, fraud tools, chargebacks, reconciliation, and PCI compliance.
  • Experience with system integration methods, including APIs, middleware, EDI, batch processing, file-based integrations, event-driven integrations, web services, and third-party connectors.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, cloud-hosted applications, identity management, monitoring, application environments, and cloud integration concepts.
  • Experience with SQL, relational databases, reporting tools, data validation, data mapping, and troubleshooting data issues across enterprise applications.
  • Knowledge of application lifecycle management, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, development coordination, testing, deployment, release management, and support transition.
  • Familiarity with IT service management tools and practices, including incident management, problem management, change management, request management, knowledge management, and service-level reporting.
  • Experience with project management and delivery tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex business and technical issues across applications, integrations, data flows, vendors, infrastructure, and operational processes.
  • Strong understanding of security and access controls, including role-based access, segregation of duties, audit logging, privileged access, and application security governance.
  • Familiarity with retail analytics, reporting, master data, inventory data, sales data, customer data, and operational dashboards.
  • Ability to evaluate technical designs, vendor proposals, architecture decisions, support models, and technology roadmaps.
  • Expertise in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, particularly Commerce and Supply Chain Management modules.
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (CE), including Sales Professional and Contact Center.
  • Knowledge of project management, service management, and software delivery methodologies, including Agile, Waterfall, ITIL, and change management best practices.
  • Experience using industry-standard project management, service management, and software delivery tools.
  • Experience leading technology initiatives within multi-location retail, distribution, or omnichannel environments.

job.title: Systems Business Analyst -Fund Accounting Systems - Boston
job.description:
Location: Boston
Hybrid: Yes 3 days onsite
Convert: Yes, Unable to sponsor.  
Start date: asap
 
Must Haves:
Fund Accounting Background
Strong Business Analyst Background
Creating stories and Agile experience
Communication both verbal and written
 
Nice to Have: Jira


Systems Business Analyst (Fund Accounting Systems):

The Systems Business Analyst provides strategic technical analysis to systems and business partners and also acts as a liaison between technical and business user groups.  The focus of this position is to work closely with the technical peers, business units, and other supporting groups to gain in-depth understanding of the Fund Accounting processes, services, and program roadmaps.

The Systems Business Analyst is responsible for defining and documenting business systems requirements and ensuring technology solutions enhance and support the business operations.   Identify technology alternatives and recommends system solutions to business and technical audiences.  Responsibilities will include a full range of activities from leading small to mid-size projects to assisting on larger more complex projects related to operational business functions that affect internal clients in both Waterfall and/or Agile Project Management approaches. The Senior Systems Business Analyst participates in all phases of the systems development life cycle – from project scoping, planning and requirements definition to issues resolution, testing, training, and implementation.

Responsibilities:
  • Develop clear, concise methodology documents, which require proficiency in workflow analysis, dataflow diagramming, screen design, etc.
  • Review and assist in development of milestone dates, project workflows, milestone dates, as requested by Project Manager.
  • Facilitate the definition of functional requirements by working with programmers and users in prototyping and design sessions.
  • Translate system workflows into system configurations
  • Translate and present project concepts into effective visual images which clarify design elements and issues for both business and technical audiences.
  • Ensure methodology is followed for project; provide meaningful feedback in accordance with departmental standards and guidelines.
  • Identify, mediate, resolve and eliminate miscommunications between business and technical project team members.
  • Provide leadership to team members and peers by collaborating with others; articulating ideas and viewpoints to senior management, peers and others; driving the resolution of issues; and holding self and team accountable for results
  • Stay current with business needs and strategies and manage relationships and expectations by developing a communication process to keep others up-to-date on project results
  • Facilitate Project Manager with ensuring project team and business participants are on track to hit applicable milestones.
  • Support and align efforts to meet business and Infrastructure needs
  • Understand and negotiate needs and expectations of multiple stakeholders
  • Lead or participate in multiple projects by completing and updating project documentation; determining daily priorities; following proper escalation paths
  • Works to self-manage projects to budget/estimate and hit deadlines set forth by project leads/managers
  • Collaborate closely with developers to implement the requirements, provide necessary guidance to testers during QA process
  • Participate in development of test strategy, test plans and test cases alongside QA
  • Participate in test execution and document results
  • Utilize Jira and Confluence to organize, track, and update progress on projects throughout their entire life cycle.
  • Identify improvement opportunities (proactive and reactive)
  • Research and evaluate new technology solutions and present recommendations for improved system operations.
  • Support system conversions, upgrades, enhancements
  • Support senior management reporting to track progress

Requirements & Qualifications:
  • Financial Services experience, especially in Fund Accounting
  • Technical experience a huge plus as this role requires a strong partnership and constant coordination with development team to agree on timelines and scope of work
  • BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • 5+ years of experience documenting specifications, preferably at a financial services company.
  • Full understanding of the business model or the area(s) supported.
  • Very strong analytical skills required
  • Strong team skills required
  • Must have experience working on large scale projects as well as handling day-to-day operational requests from the business
  • Strong time management, ability to successfully manage multiple tasks at any given point, strong relationship building skills & communication skills
  • Exposure to project work, planning
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence is preferred
  • Experience with both Waterfall and Agile Projects is preferred
  • Scrum master experience is a plus
  • Knowledge of all phases of the Systems Development Life Cycle
  • Ability to create presentations using software such as Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Written and oral communications skills
  • Problem solving/analytical skills

job.title: Process Engineer
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Process Engineer for our Pharmaceutical Manufacturing client in Noblesville, Indiana. This position will support a fast-paced sterile drug-product manufacturing operation. The Process Engineer will lead process and equipment improvements, troubleshoot manufacturing issues, establish performance metrics, investigate failures, and support new products and manufacturing lines within a cGMP environment.

What You Will Do
  • Lead process improvement, equipment reliability, troubleshooting, and remediation initiatives across manufacturing operations.
  • Establish and monitor process KPIs related to reliability, quality, throughput, yield, downtime, and operational performance.
  • Evaluate, design, and implement robust manufacturing processes for new products using existing or new equipment.
  • Support product launches, technology transfers, and implementation of new manufacturing lines.
  • Lead formal root-cause investigations involving manufacturing processes and equipment.
  • Author deviations, determine root causes, and develop corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Write and execute technical documentation, including engineering protocols, reports, risk assessments, and process-improvement documentation.
  • Initiate and support change controls associated with equipment and process improvements.
  • Partner with Quality, Manufacturing, Validation, Technical Services, R&D, and other functions to ensure compliant implementation of cGMP practices.
  • Provide input into project-cost forecasts and track project activities against established milestones.
  • Develop and maintain manufacturing procedures, batch records, equipment documentation, and training materials.
  • Provide hands-on manufacturing-floor support during equipment issues, process changes, startup activities, and project implementation.

Education and Experience Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required. Mechanical Engineering is preferred; Chemical, Biochemical, Biotechnology, Manufacturing, or another engineering discipline may be considered based on relevant experience.
  • Five or more years of relevant engineering experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment.
  • Demonstrated experience optimizing manufacturing processes and establishing or monitoring process KPIs.
  • Hands-on experience troubleshooting manufacturing processes or equipment and implementing sustainable reliability or quality improvements.
  • Experience leading formal root-cause analysis using structured problem-solving methodologies.
  • Experience authoring deviations, CAPAs, change controls, protocols, technical reports, or comparable controlled documentation.
  • Working knowledge of cGMP requirements, validation, quality systems, document control, and the regulatory impact of engineering changes.
  • Experience supporting cross-functional projects from evaluation and design through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Strong project-management, organizational, technical-writing, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary project and manufacturing teams.

Preferred Experience
  • Automated visual inspection systems
  • Vial inspection or vial-labeling equipment
  • Pharmaceutical packaging equipment or packaging lines
  • Sterile injectable, aseptic, or fill-finish manufacturing
  • New-product introduction, technology transfer, or manufacturing-line startup
  • Medical-device or other highly regulated manufacturing environments may also be considered when accompanied by strong process-engineering, validation, and quality-system experience

Additional Requirements
  • Must be able to work fully onsite in Noblesville, Indiana, Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m.

job.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician – Pharmaceutical Manufacturing
job.description:
Yoh is hiring an Industrial Maintenance Technician for our pharmaceutical manufacturing client in Maryland Heights, Missouri.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 6:00 a.m.–2:30 p.m.
Pay rate: $30.00–$32.00 per hour, depending on experience.
Location: Maryland Heights, Missouri
Work arrangement: Fully onsite

Job Functions
  • Complete assigned preventive maintenance tasks, equipment inspections, and work orders on schedule.
  • Perform preventive maintenance on manufacturing equipment and associated support systems.
  • Respond to production-down equipment issues and complete repairs in a manner that minimizes downtime.
  • Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems in an industrial manufacturing environment.
  • Work from electrical schematics, engineering drawings, and written or verbal instructions.
  • Perform equipment functionality and alignment checks.
  • Make equipment adjustments, modifications, repairs, and component replacements as directed.
  • Troubleshoot automated systems, electrical controls, motors, sensors, signal wiring, and related components.
  • Operate related equipment, conduct tests, and document results in the required format.
Education and Experience Requirements
  • Associate degree in Electrical Automation, Industrial Maintenance, Electronics, Electrical Systems, or a related technical field required.
  • Three or more years of relevant industrial or manufacturing equipment maintenance experience required.
  • Experience with the following:
    • AC/DC electrical power systems and power supplies
    • Industrial manufacturing equipment and automated systems
    • Automation electronics, electrical controls, and PLCs
    • Proximity and optical sensors, signal wiring, and connectivity
    • AC/DC motors
    • Pneumatic and hydraulic systems and associated controls
    • Vacuum pumps and vacuum systems
    • High-voltage electrical systems
    • Basic soldering
    • Voltmeters and other general-purpose test equipment
    • Mechanical repairs and the use of various hand tools
  • Strong equipment troubleshooting skills, both with and without schematics.
  • Licensed electrician credentials or equivalent hands-on high-voltage electrical experience required.
  • Ability to work fully onsite during the scheduled hours.

job.title: Technical Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
Technical Customer Support Specialist
Location: Tempe, AZ
Pay: $19.00 - $23.00/hr W2
Type: 12-month contract, strong potential to convert to permanent
Work Schedule: Onsite during training, then fully remote
Start Date: October 13, 2026
No Credit Check Required

About the Opportunity
We are hiring Technology Support Specialists to join the advisor technology support team of one of the nation's largest and most respected independent financial services firms. This is a rare opportunity to get your foot in the door with a financially stable, growing company that believes in promoting from within. People who start here go on to build long careers, moving up through multiple levels and growing in ways they did not expect when they started.

This is not a deep IT role. It is a people-first, technology-comfortable support role where you will use basic troubleshooting skills to help financial advisors navigate systems and technology while delivering exceptional customer service on every interaction.

What You Will Do
  • Provide first-level technology support to financial advisors via inbound phone calls, handling 30-50 contacts daily
  • Troubleshoot access and navigation issues involving proprietary systems, browsers, email, and Microsoft 365
  • Ask effective probing questions to understand the advisor's issue and walk them through solutions step by step
  • Provide support for Microsoft Outlook and email configuration on desktop and mobile devices
  • Build rapport with advisors and maintain a patient, professional, and service-oriented approach on every call
  • Work toward first-call resolution whenever possible
  • Document and communicate issues clearly while maintaining efficiency between calls
  • Learn and apply procedures for proprietary systems through structured training
What We Are Looking For
  • Strong customer service and communication skills with the ability to handle frustrated customers professionally
  • Basic technical troubleshooting experience or aptitude, including browsers, Windows, email, and Microsoft 365
  • Comfort working in a high-volume inbound phone environment
  • Strong probing and problem-solving skills, ability to diagnose issues logically
  • Ability to learn new technology and proprietary systems quickly
  • Reliable, dependable, and genuinely looking for a long-term career opportunity
  • Flexibility to work shifts between 8:00 AM and 8:00 PM EST, Monday through Friday
Preferred Experience
  • Previous help desk, technical support, call center, or customer service experience
  • Experience troubleshooting Windows, browsers, email, or Microsoft Office 365
  • Financial services or advisor support experience is a plus but not required
  • Technical certifications (CompTIA A+, MOS, MCP, SIE) are a plus but not required
Why Apply
  • Get your foot in the door with one of the best financial services firms in the country
  • Fully remote after onsite training
  • 12-month contract with strong potential to convert to a permanent full-time role
  • Company that promotes from within and invests in its people from day one
  • No credit check required
The Process
  1. SparkHire recorded video interview
  2. Live Teams video interview
  3. Offer, background check, then class starts October 13
This is a W2 contract. We are unable to offer C2C or visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US.
We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Hardware TPM
job.description:
Hardware TPM 

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field (e.g., Mechanical Engineering, Material Science and Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Technology) or 2+ years of equivalent practical experience in an automotive lab or technical support environment.
• Strong project management skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.

job.title: Analyst II, Quality Control Raw Materials - Onsite, Mansfield MA
job.description:
Analyst II, Quality Control Raw Materials

Analyst II, Quality Control Raw Materials

Overview

The Quality Control Raw Materials / Sample Management (QC RM/SM) Analyst II plays a role in supporting the department’s efforts to maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance from development through commercialization. This includes testing, evaluation, and release of raw materials used in manufacturing to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal specifications, and industry standards.

By ensuring these critical activities are executed within project milestones and timelines, the Analyst II contributes to manufacturing operations by ensuring timely and accurate testing of incoming raw materials, maintaining documentation, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the laboratory.

This position is onsite and will be primarily located in Norton, MA. There may occasionally be responsibilities at a secondary location in Cambridge, MA, or off shift as required by business needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Perform routine and non routine inspection of raw materials.

• Maintain up to date training records, adhere to the inspection schedule, and ensure timely completion of assignments to support QC activities and department quality metrics.

• Accurately document all results in laboratory notebooks, LIMS, or other controlled systems in compliance with GMP standards. Review documentation as needed to ensure timely and efficient material availability.

• Participate heavily in raw material qualification programs, including vendor and supplier qualification and material risk assessments.

• Collaborate cross functionally with Manufacturing, Materials Management, and Quality Assurance to ensure raw material availability and release timelines.

• Contribute to the revision and updating of controlled documents, including SOPs, work instructions, and test methods, to support continuous improvement and compliance with applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

• Participate in inspection readiness activities and support onsite audits and inspections as needed.

Qualifications

• B.S. in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field. An Associate Degree, Biotech Certificate, or equivalent may also be considered.

• 3 to 6 years of pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience in a regulated laboratory setting, Quality Control, or equivalent relevant experience.

• Ability to work independently with strong attention to detail in an environment where priorities may shift.

• Good communication and teamwork abilities with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.

• Ability to stand for extended periods and occasionally lift raw materials weighing up to 25 lbs.

• Knowledge of LIMS, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint is helpful.

Yoh Life Sciences is hiring for a Warehouse Associate to help support our diagnostics customer in Memphis, Tennessee.  You will support general warehouse duties including, shipping/receiving, kitting, picking, and packing.
