job.description:
Please share your resume to suman.dabbeta@yoh.com
        Suman Dabbeta | Sr. Recruiter | Yoh
        https://www.linkedin.com/in/sumandabbeta/
        Local candidate to any of the client location - In-Person interview - Hybrid role.
        Please provide the exact client location at the time of submission.



Our client is seeking a US-based Manager / Software Development Engineer II (SDE-2) to provide hands-on technical leadership for enterprise-scale Java microservices and modernization programs. This role combines architecture and solution design, critical-path engineering, delivery leadership, client consulting, and team mentorship. The Manager / SDE-2 will work with client stakeholders and globally distributed teams to build secure, resilient, observable, and maintainable platforms on AWS.

  • Role emphasis: Hands-on engineering leadership, multi-solution architecture, client-facing delivery, and pragmatic use of AI with human validation and accountability. Your Impact
  • Own technical outcomes for scalable, resilient, secure, and maintainable Java microservices and distributed systems.
  • Lead solution design and modernization decisions across multiple services and business capabilities, not only a single module.
  • Translate business needs into architecture, delivery plans, technical designs, estimates, risks, and measurable acceptance criteria.
  • Guide engineers through design reviews, critical code contributions, pull request reviews, structured problem solving, and technical coaching.
  • Use AI-assisted Code2Spec and Spec2Code approaches to accelerate legacy modernization while preserving functional equivalence, security, and engineering quality.
  • Build client confidence through clear communication, early risk escalation, reliable delivery, and evidence-based recommendations.

  • Key ResponsibilitiesEngineering & Architecture Leadership
  • Lead the end-to-end design, development, testing, deployment, and support of Java-based microservices, REST APIs, and event-driven applications.
  • Remain hands-on in architecture, design, prototypes, critical code paths, complex debugging, performance tuning, and technical decision-making.
  • Create and review architecture artifacts, technical design documents, API contracts, sequence and data flows, threat considerations, and implementation approaches.
  • Drive sound decisions across scalability, availability, resilience, security, observability, maintainability, and cost.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for complex application, integration, data, cloud, and production issues; lead root-cause analysis and durable remediation.

  • Client Consulting & Delivery Leadership
  • Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, architecture reviews, solution walkthroughs, demos, and modernization planning with client stakeholders.
  • Explain architecture options, trade-offs, assumptions, dependencies, risks, and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Partner with product, architecture, quality engineering, security, DevOps, and program leadership to align technology outcomes with business goals.
  • Provide credible estimates, identify delivery and technical risks early, define mitigation plans, and support predictable sprint and release commitments.
  • Collaborate across US, nearshore, and offshore teams, helping establish clear ownership, engineering standards, and effective ways of working.

  • Cloud-Native, Integration & Event Streaming
  • Design and deliver AWS-hosted solutions using appropriate compute, storage, identity, monitoring, database, messaging, and container services.
  • Containerize applications with Docker and deploy or support workloads on Kubernetes, including Amazon EKS where applicable.
  • Design Kafka-based producer and consumer flows, delivery semantics, error handling, replay, idempotency, schema evolution, and operational support.
  • Guide secure integration with authentication and authorization services, internal and third-party APIs, relational or NoSQL data stores, and enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Apply cloud-native and microservices patterns while avoiding unnecessary complexity and unmanaged operational risk.

  • DevSecOps, Quality & Production Readiness
  • Guide Jenkins-based CI/CD, GitHub branching and pull request workflows, automated quality checks, artifact management, deployment, and release practices.
  • Enforce meaningful unit, component, contract, integration, regression, and performance testing; use SonarQube quality gates and static analysis responsibly.
  • Define and validate non-functional requirements for performance, capacity, availability, reliability, security, recovery, and maintainability.
  • Use Dynatrace and complementary telemetry for dashboards, diagnostics, alerting, production health, and continuous reliability improvement.
  • Lead production readiness reviews, incident analysis, corrective actions, and technical debt prioritization.

  • AI-Assisted Legacy Modernization
  • Use enterprise-approved AI engineering tools, which may include Publicis Sapient Slingshot, Cursor, Amazon Kiro, Claude, or comparable platforms.
  • Apply Code2Spec practices to derive functional and technical specifications, interfaces, business rules, dependencies, and validation conditions from legacy code.
  • Apply Spec2Code practices to accelerate target-state Java microservices while maintaining architecture standards, secure coding, testability, and human review.
  • Design validation methods that compare legacy and migrated behavior through traceability, regression, data reconciliation, boundary checks, exception analysis, and targeted manual review.
  • Ensure engineers understand generated code and remain accountable for correctness, security, privacy, maintainability, and production outcomes.

  • Team Leadership & Engineering Culture
  • Mentor and guide engineers through technical coaching, code reviews, pairing, design feedback, and structured problem-solving.
  • Delegate effectively while retaining accountability for technical quality, delivery outcomes, and operational readiness.
  • Promote a culture of ownership, constructive challenge, continuous learning, documentation, inclusion, and blameless improvement.
  • Contribute to interviewing, technical assessment, onboarding, capability development, and engineering community initiatives.

job.title: Quality Control Technical Services Analyst IV - Onsite Mansfield
job.description:
Analyst IV, Quality Control Technical Services

Overview

The Quality Control Technical Services (QCTS) Analyst IV plays a crucial role in supporting the department’s efforts to maintain the highest standards of quality and compliance from development through commercialization. In addition to active participation in stability studies, data trending, and investigations, this position will provide technical specification support and assist in facilitating method transfers and implementation. By ensuring these critical activities are executed with precision, the Analyst IV significantly contributes to routine laboratory operations, enhancing the overall efficiency and effectiveness of QC functions.

This is a hybrid role with responsibilities across multiple company locations as well as external contract organizations.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide robust support in the justification of technical specifications for raw materials, intermediates, and finished products, ensuring they meet all quality and compliance requirements.

• Facilitate the transfer and implementation of analytical methods from development to routine use within the QC laboratory, including method validation and training of laboratory personnel.

• Assist in the execution and documentation of stability studies, contributing to product shelf life determinations and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

• Engage in the collection, analysis, and trending of QC data to identify and address potential quality issues, using statistical tools to ensure continuous product quality monitoring.

• Support and, when appropriate, lead investigations into analytical and product related quality deviations, employing root cause analysis and implementing corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to mitigate risks and enhance quality.

• Review routine and non routine QC testing, ensuring the reliability and accuracy of results according to applicable policies, procedures, and regulations.

• Assist in preparing and reviewing technical documentation for regulatory submissions and audits, ensuring accuracy and compliance with global regulatory standards.

• Actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing QC processes and procedures and increasing laboratory efficiency and effectiveness.

• Represent Quality Control at cross functional forums, including CMC meetings, ensuring QC perspectives and requirements are effectively communicated.

• Collaborate with other organizational functions, including CMC Development, Manufacturing, Manufacturing Technical Services, Supply Chain, Regulatory, and Quality Assurance to ensure alignment with overall business goals.

Qualifications

• B.S. in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, or a related scientific field. Advanced degrees will also be considered.

• 8 to 12 years of pharmaceutical or biotech industry experience in a GMP Quality Control function or equivalent relevant industry experience.

• Experience in technical specification development, method transfer, and/or analytical method implementation.

• Proficiency in data analysis and interpretation with excellent attention to detail.

• Solid problem solving skills and experience conducting investigations and implementing CAPAs.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously and autonomously.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative environment.

• Proficiency in LabWare LIMS, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint preferred.

job.title: Occupational Health RN
job.description:
Yoh Healthcare has a direct hire opportunity for an Occupational Health Registered Nurse in Columbia City, IN

About the Role

The Occupational Health Nurse reports directly to the General Managers at their respective location and indirectly to the Occupational Health Coordinator. The successful candidate holds a valid nursing license in the state of Indiana and current certification in CPR/AED from American Red Cross or AHA.

Hours: 7am- 4pm Monday-Friday

Key Responsibilities
  • Treatment of on-site injuries and referral to outside medical care as needed
  • Case management for injured workers and facilitate return to work
  • Provide medical surveillance for all employees including but not limited to annual audiograms, spirometry, vision screening, and lead testing
  • Provide medical surveillance and case management
  • Conduct new hire pre-employment drug and alcohol screening & coordinate medical examinations
  • Participate in ergonomics assessments and job hazard analysis
  • Responsible for training employees in First Aid and CPR/AED as medical responders to aid in the care of injured workers
  • Responsible for training employees in Bloodborne Pathogens, Hearing Conservation, Violence in the workplace, Ergonomics and Heat Stress to meet OSHA requirements
  • Maintain HIPPA compliant documentation
  • Accountable for delivery of agreed to regional health metrics and outcomes
  • Purchase all supplies required for the first aid clinic
  • Develop and meet site budget expectations
  • Drive increased health outcomes including reducing population health risks, managing, and eliminating workplace health risks and supporting improved business outcomes through advancing employee health and wellbeing
  • Willingness to work closely with the Safety Coordinators at the division level to recognize hazards and prevent injury
Required Qualifications
  • Active RN license in Indiana
  • On-call being requierd for after hours for injuring management. On-call is split between team
  • 2 or more years hospital or clinic nursing experience in occupational (manufacturing/industrial)  nursing or emergency nursing
  • Excellent assessment skills in a clinical setting
  • Phlebotomy
  • Current CPR/AED certification
Preferred Qualifications
  • Working knowledge of regulatory areas (ADA, OSHA, FMLA, Workers’ Compensation)
  • CPR/AED Instructor
  • Health coaching/certification
  • Certified Occupational Health Nurse
 
What’s In It for You?

  • Bonus opportunities 
  • Stock Benefits
  • Profit Sharing and Retirement Savings
  • Medical, Educational, & Life Insurance coverage
What are you waiting for? APPLY NOW!

job.title: VP/SVP - Mainframe DB2 or IMS Systems Programmer
job.description:
** Client is not able to do any sponsorship of employment-based visas. In order to be a successful applicant, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States, without the need for employer sponsorship/support now or at any time in the future. Additionally, NO C2C**


In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:  

  • Install/configure/upgrade DB2 and related software products. This includes middleware. products that may have both mainframe and distributed components.
  • Troubleshoot DB2 subsystem problems.
  • Customize software to meet user needs.
  • Communicating, Scheduling and coordination of changes, requests and incidents.
  • Initiate and participate in Proofs of Concept for new technologies.
  • Participate in Disaster Recovery and other mainframe exercises.
  • Work after normal business hours and on weekends to perform software upgrades and coverage.
  • Support multiple projects/upgrades/initiatives simultaneously.
  • Be available to provide 24X7 coverage and support and respond to calls for assistance in a timely manner.
  • Designs, implements, integrates, and provides full support for complex software in a multi-tiered, multi-platform environment.
  • Researches and recommends the appropriate system software to meet corporate standards and objectives for system performance.
  • Identifies and solves complex and critical systems related issues to meet the objectives for the corporation.
  • Provides input into platform selection, version implementation, software product recommendation, and usage of enhanced functionality.
  • Assists with complex issues in the installation, support, troubleshooting, and repair of data centre equipment.
  • Implements, integrates, and provides full support for middleware software in a multi-tiered, multi-platform environment.
  • Collaborates and consults with application development teams to determine middleware platform selection, efficient transaction design, use and recovery procedures in line with business requirements.
  • Communicates with internal and external system users to address concerns and make sure that technical issues are dealt with appropriately.
  • Manage ticket queues and handles complex escalated issues.
  • Analyze repeat incident patterns to identify opportunities for cost reduction and productivity enhancements.
  • Work with vendors to ensure efficient incident resolution. 
To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:  

  • Strong z/OS Mainframe Systems Programming background, including SMPE.
  • Senior level knowledge of DB2 and DB2 Data Sharing.
  • Experience working with vendors to resolve software and Systems issues.
  • Installation and Maintenance of DB2 Program Product Installations (with creating Implementation and Backout Plans)
  • Ability to provide coverage for DB2 and Product installations and the many mainframe initiatives. Willing to work weekends.
  • Strong Knowledge of REXX Programming
  • DB2 Connect on LUW skills are huge pluses.
  • Experience with Performance/Monitoring products and performance tuning is a plus
  • Knowledge on products like BMC-Catalog Manager, BMC-Apptune, IBM-Optim, Rocket-Shadow, Broadcom-SYSVIEW, Informatica-Powerexchange, IBM Q/SQL-Rep
  • Able to communicate effectively with application programmers and DBA’s.
  • Troubleshoot DB2 subsystem problems and resolve them in a timely manner.
  • Ability to lead projects and complete them on schedule.
  • Experience with Service Now and JIRA.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience required, advanced degree preferred
  • 5-10 years of related infrastructure experience required, experience in the securities or financial services industry is a plus.

job.title: Engineering Technician I
job.description:
Yoh is hiring a Manufacturing Engineering Technician for our medical device manufacturing client. In this role, you will support manufacturing operations by partnering with Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Production, and Corporate IT to improve manufacturing processes, troubleshoot equipment, maintain production systems, and implement continuous improvement initiatives. The Manufacturing Engineering Technician will assist with equipment validation, process improvements, Lean manufacturing activities, fixture development, and technical support in a regulated medical device environment.

Industry: Medical Device Manufacturing
Location: Onsite
Compensation: Competitive; based upon experience
Type: Contract / Contract-to-Hire / Direct Hire (based on client need)

Job Functions
  • Support manufacturing engineers in improving production processes, equipment performance, and manufacturing efficiency.
  • Generate, update, and maintain equipment maintenance procedures and documentation.
  • Perform scheduled preventative maintenance on manufacturing and test equipment.
  • Troubleshoot process, material, and equipment issues to minimize downtime and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop, assemble, procure, or modify tooling, fixtures, and manufacturing equipment to support efficient production.
  • Read and interpret schematics, assembly drawings, process sheets, and technical documentation to troubleshoot equipment and perform testing.
  • Assist with equipment installation, qualification, validation, and process improvements to increase productivity.
  • Perform testing, collect data, and prepare technical reports with guidance from Manufacturing Engineering.
  • Conduct time studies and analyze manufacturing workflows to identify opportunities for Lean process improvements.
  • Assist with failure analysis, root cause investigations, troubleshooting, and repair of nonconforming products.
  • Support analytical laboratory testing as required.
  • Train manufacturing personnel on new products, equipment, tooling, and process revisions.
  • Provide on-site technical support for IT equipment and software while working closely with the Corporate IT department.
  • Troubleshoot hardware and software issues for local personnel and coordinate with Corporate IT on system support.
  • Maintain compliance with company quality systems, policies, procedures, FDA regulations, and ISO standards.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
Education, Licensure and/or Experience
  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Engineering Technology or a related technical field; equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered.
  • Previous experience in medical device manufacturing (FDA/ISO 13485) or another highly regulated manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Experience supporting manufacturing engineering, production, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Background in electronics, electronic test equipment, and troubleshooting techniques.
  • Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, schematics, and technical documentation.
  • Experience developing and executing test plans and documenting results.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple tasks, and meet project deadlines.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments.
  • Self-motivated with a continuous improvement mindset and strong attention to detail.
  • Experience supporting Lean Manufacturing or continuous improvement initiatives is preferred.

job.description:

Suman Dabbeta | Sr. Recruiter | Yoh
https://www.linkedin.com/in/sumandabbeta/

***W2 candidates only**
***IN-Person interview***
****Local candidates only***


Looking for someone with 4-8 years of Devops/platform engineering experience. Must be able to work onsite 4 days a week in Boston or Needham MA 

Primary profile: well-rounded DevOps / Platform Engineer
Important environment exposure: Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, GitHub, Jenkins
Current project context: Jira and Confluence moving from Data Center to Cloud
Core supporting skills: AWS, Docker, Python scripting
Nice to have: Jira Align, Rovo AI, CloudFormation
Not critical: Kubernetes, HashiCorp Vault

Responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and support enterprise DevOps platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automation solutions.
  • Administer and maintain the DevTools ecosystem, including Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Manage platform upgrades, patching, lifecycle management, and integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions and DevOps best practices.
  • Automate infrastructure, deployments, and operational processes using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
  • Deploy and support cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Implement and manage secrets management, authentication, and security integrations using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor platform health and performance, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvements.
  • Utilize AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other LLM-based solutions to improve automation, developer productivity, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Stay current with DevOps, Cloud, Security, and AI engineering best practices and contribute to platform modernization initiatives.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4-5 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise DevOps platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, SDLC, Git workflows, and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure automation.
  • Strong programming and automation skills using Python, with experience in Bash and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack.
  • Experience implementing SSO, identity management, security integrations, and secrets management solutions.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, platform integrations, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to enhance software delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Technical Skills
DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell, REST APIs
Security & Secrets Management: HashiCorp Vault, SSO, Identity & Access Management
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack
AI & Productivity: GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, AI-Assisted Software Development

This Clinician offers comprehensive psychological services to students, including psychological intake assessments, individual and group counseling, urgent response/crisis intervention services, and mental health evaluations for risk.

job.title: Lab Technicians
job.description:
Lab Technician – Stability Operations Position Summary The Lab Technician supports stability operations by ensuring the compliant handling, storage, tracking, and distribution of GMP and non-GMP stability samples. This role maintains accurate documentation, supports critical stability storage equipment, and performs activities in accordance with approved protocols, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the receipt, storage, retrieval, distribution, shipment, and retention of GMP and non-GMP stability samples in accordance with established procedures and stability protocols.
  • Maintain accurate sample inventory and tracking information within LIMS and other approved documentation systems to ensure data integrity and traceability.
  • Monitor stability storage environments and ensure samples are maintained under required temperature and environmental conditions.
  • Support the reliability and availability of stability chambers, refrigerators, freezers, and other critical storage equipment by coordinating routine maintenance, calibration, qualification/validation, and repairs.
  • Respond to equipment alarms, temperature excursions, and other storage-related events in accordance with established procedures, including appropriate documentation and escalation.
  • Perform routine inspections and checks of stability storage areas and equipment to verify compliance and identify potential issues.
  • Ensure stability samples are pulled, distributed, and shipped according to approved schedules, protocols, and testing requirements.
  • Maintain complete, accurate, and timely GMP documentation in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP) and data integrity requirements.
  • Support investigations, deviations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and other quality activities related to stability samples, storage conditions, or equipment, as assigned.
  • Assist with stability sample inventory reconciliation, retention activities, and disposition of samples according to approved procedures.
  • Support audit and inspection readiness by maintaining organized records, accurate sample inventories, and compliant storage areas.
  • Identify and support opportunities to improve the efficiency, reliability, and compliance of stability sample management processes.
  • Follow applicable GMP requirements, laboratory safety practices, SOPs, and site policies.
  • Perform other laboratory and stability-related duties as assigned.
Qualifications
  • Associate degree in a scientific discipline or related field preferred; equivalent laboratory, pharmaceutical, or regulated-industry experience may be considered.
  • Experience working in a GMP, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, laboratory, or similarly regulated environment preferred.
  • Familiarity with LIMS, sample management systems, and electronic documentation systems is preferred.
  • Basic understanding of GMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity principles, and controlled laboratory environments.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and manage multiple samples and priorities.
  • Ability to follow written procedures and approved protocols consistently.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with laboratory, Quality, Facilities, Metrology, Validation, and other cross-functional teams.

job.title: Per-Diem Corporate Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Corporate Health Registered Nurse needed for an ongoing per-diem contract opportunity with Yoh’s corporate office client located in Plano & Fort Worth, TX.
*Must be able to cover both locations, depending on the need. Plano is the biggest location so likely will be there more.
 

This job is only on an as-needed basis with the schedule typically made in advance, but we are looking for flexibility to cover call-outs too. Must be able to work 0 to 5 shifts per week between Monday and Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm. Average is a couple of shifts a month. The clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative care for employees of a corporate office.


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse license in state of Texas
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Registered Nurse
  • Prior experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, Corrections, or School Nursing type setting
  • Recent clinical experience and strong first-aid skills
  • Professional, dedicated, friendly, and helpful employee

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Nursing assessment, triage, treatment, and education for employee health concerns
  • Ambulatory care such as treating sore throats, ear aches, rashes, pink eye, etc.
  • Travel health consultation, health coaching, and health education
  • Provide medical testing/biometric screenings such as EKGs, pulmonary function, phlebotomy, blood glucose, blood pressure, cholesterol, vision and hearing screening and perform limited interpretation of tests
  • Immunizations
  • Respond to emergencies onsite and provide emergency medical care as-needed (assist First Responders)

What You Need to Bring to the Table:

  • MUST HAVE A FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE between Monday and Friday, 7:30am - 4:30pm - this position is to cover for when full-time staff need time off of work so the schedule is very infrequent
  • BLS certified
  • Computer savvy (including prior EMR use)
  • Passionate about promoting health and wellbeing in the workplace
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time, go up and down multiple flights of stairs, and do a lot of fast-walking

What’s In It For You?

  • Gain experience working at a well-established company with a prestigious reputation
  • Great way to make extra $$$ with a flexible day shift schedule
  • Unique, interesting, and rewarding work environment getting to make a real impact on both individual well-being and workplace culture. You're not just treating illness - you're preventing it, promoting healthier work environments, and helping employees stay safe!
  • Weekly direct deposit every Friday!

KNOW A GREAT HEALTHCARE PRO LOOKING FOR WORK? REFER THEM TODAY!

*Yoh Health Care specializes in occupational/employee health and we place health care professionals on jobs nationwide with well-known Fortune 500 companies. Feel free to reach out to hear about the latest Medical Assistant, Nurse, Physician Assistant, and Nurse Practitioner openings.

job.title: Cash Management Specialist
job.description:
Cash Management Operations Specialist

Position Summary The Cash Management Operations Specialist will support a team responsible for the movement of cash and assets across various financial products. This role will perform operational processing within Cash Management, including journals, receipts, and disbursements for retirement and non-retirement products.

In addition to transactional processing, the specialist may interact with internal and external clients to research issues, resolve exceptions, and ensure requests are completed accurately and within established service levels.

Key Responsibilities
  • Process receipt transactions that are Not in Good Order (NIGO) and research missing or incomplete information.
  • Process journal requests and monitor disbursement work queues.
  • Complete various disbursement transactions for retirement and non-retirement products.
  • Support divorce and death claim processing.
  • Assist with tax-related operational processing.
  • Review reports used to reconcile general ledger activity and end-of-day balances for wires and checks.
  • Review rejection reports and make necessary updates to ACH transactions.
  • Process and reconcile receipt transactions.
  • Research transaction discrepancies and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Maintain a high level of accuracy while working within established operational controls and procedures.
  • Stay current on new processes, procedures, and internal controls.
  • Participate in daily team huddles, department meetings, and ongoing training.
  • Communicate with internal teams and external clients as needed to support transaction processing and issue resolution.
Required Qualifications
  • 1–2 years of experience within the brokerage or financial services industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Business, Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail with a high degree of accuracy and consistency.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify issues and escalate when appropriate.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Ability to adapt to changing processes, priorities, and business needs.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to complete assigned tasks accurately and within established deadlines.
Preferred Qualifications
  • FINRA Series 7 and/or Series 66.
  • Experience with brokerage operations, cash management, money movement, or financial transaction processing.
  • Experience with retirement and non-retirement account processing.
  • Familiarity with ACH, wires, checks, journals, receipts, and disbursements.
Systems & Software Experience with the following is preferred:
  • Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint
  • BETA/Mainframe
  • Documentum
  • Siebel
  • SharePoint
Ideal Candidate The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable working in a transaction-driven financial services environment. This person should be able to manage a high volume of operational work while maintaining accuracy, following established controls, and communicating effectively when exceptions or issues arise.

job.description:

job.title: Occupational Health Registered Nurse
job.description:
Occupational Health Registered Nurse needed full-time for approximately year+ contract opportunity with Yoh’s client located in Downtown Los Angeles, CA. There's also the opportunity for you to be consiered for their long-term, full-time permanent opening!

The clinic offers occupational, primary, and preventative care for employees. Very similar to working in an urgent care but you are only seeing adults and it is not fast-paced. Primary responsibilities include care and management of occupational injuries/illnesses, hearing conservation, and initial care of acute non-occupational illnesses. 
--> Monday - Friday 7:00am to 3:30pm (30 min lunch) starting asap


Top Skills You Should Possess:

  • Active/unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license in state of California
  • Minimum (3) years' experience as a Nurse
  • Trained in spirometry (NIOSH Certified)
  • Audiometry testing (CAOHC/COHC Certified)
  • DOT Breath Alcohol Testing and Urine Drug Collector Certification
  • Must have previous experience in: Occupational Health, Emergency Medicine, Urgent Care, Primary Care, Family Medicine, School Nursing, or Corrections type setting

job.title: MLOps Platform Engineer
job.description:
MLOps Platform Engineer
Plano, TX – Onsite
12+ Month Contract
 
RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Senior ML Platform Engineer to design, build, and operationalize an enterprise ML platform on AWS SageMaker Unified Studio. You will migrate the organization from a fragmented ML toolchain to a unified, governed platform on AWS Landing Zone 2, covering the full ML lifecycle from data discovery through model deployment and monitoring.
  • Set up SageMaker Unified Studio platform - domain configuration, project provisioning, persona-based roles, and multi-environment (Dev, Prod-UAT, Prod) promotion workflows
  • Build MLOps pipelines using SageMaker Pipelines - data extraction from Snowflake, preprocessing, training, evaluation, and model registration
  • Manage SageMaker Model Registry - cross-account model promotion, versioning, immutability, and lineage tracking
  • Configure MLflow experiment tracking - auto-logging of parameters, metrics, and artifacts
  • Set up identity and access management - Okta SSO, SailPoint entitlements, persona-based execution roles, service roles for pipelines
  • Build model serving - real-time SageMaker endpoints and batch prediction workflows
  • Set up model monitoring - data drift, model drift, performance degradation detection
  • Configure data catalog - searchable datasets, access-level visibility, access-request workflows, lineage
  • Own platform operations - observability (CloudWatch, Datadog), logging, custom images, instance availability
 
REQUIREMENTS
  • The hiring manager is looking to onboard MLOpsPlatform Engineer (SageMaker) who is expert in SageMaker (key skillset) and AWS.
  • 10-15 years of software engineering experience focused on cloud infrastructure or ML platform operations
  • 5+ years hands-on with AWS, including deep expertise in Amazon SageMaker (Studio Classic Studio, Pipelines, Model Registry, Endpoints, Feature Store)
  • 3+ years building and operating production MLOps pipelines - training, versioning, deployment, monitoring, rollback
  • Experience with SageMaker Unified Studio or Studio Classic - domain/project setup, blueprints, multi-tenant configuration
  • MLflow or equivalent experiment tracking
  • SageMaker Pipelines or similar workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions)
  • Unified Studio is preferred to have but Classic (REQUIRED) - domain/project setup, blueprints, multi-tenant configuration
  • Experience with SageMaker Unified Studio or Studio Classic - Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform, CDK, or CloudFormation
  • IAM design for ML platforms - execution roles, service roles, cross-account access, Lake Formation, SSO/SAML
  • MLflow or equivalent experiment tracking
  • SageMaker Pipelines or similar workflow orchestration (Airflow, Step Functions)
  • Model serving - real-time endpoints, batch transform, auto-scaling, endpoint monitoring
  • Snowflake as a data source for ML pipelines
  • Kubernetes (EKS) and container orchestration
Networking and security - VPC, security groups, private endpoints, cross-account connectivity

job.title: IAM/PAM (Delinea)/Governance Lead
job.description:
IAM/PAM (Delinea)/Governance Lead
Remote (Must be open to coming to Dallas once a quarter)
Employment Type: Direct Hire
Base + Bonus + Full Benefits

MUST HAVE HANDS-ON DELINEA EPXERIENCE
 
Overview
This role will focus heavily on strategic leadership, architecture guidance, governance, and cross-functional coordination across Identity and Access Management (IAM), Identity Governance Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM)/Delinea programs. The ideal candidate will serve as a key liaison between business stakeholders, internal technology teams, and a large managed service provider (MSP) organization supporting enterprise security operations.
This position requires a strong understanding of enterprise-scale identity programs, operational governance, compliance frameworks, and the complexities of managing large MSP-supported delivery organizations. Experience within financial services or other regulated industries is strongly preferred due to SOX, audit, and regulatory requirements.
The environment currently leverages Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Duo for privileged access management and MFA, and enterprise HR and ERP platforms integrated into identity lifecycle processes.
 
Responsibilities
  • Define and lead the enterprise roadmap, strategy, and governance model for Identity Governance & Administration services.
  • Provide strategic direction for IAM, IGA, and PAM solutions, including lifecycle management, governance controls, access certifications, and privileged access strategies.
  • Develop enterprise architecture standards, identity governance frameworks, and operational best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, security trends, and modernization opportunities to strengthen enterprise identity capabilities.
  • Partner closely with business stakeholders to align identity strategies with operational, security, and compliance objectives.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between business leadership, technology teams, and a large offshore managed service provider (MSP) organization.
  • Provide oversight and governance across MSP-led engineering, architecture, delivery, and operational support functions.
  • Coordinate demand management, prioritization, roadmap execution, and service delivery activities across multiple teams and workstreams.
  • Review and approve identity security designs, architecture standards, entitlement models, and access governance processes.
  • Balance operational priorities, team capacity, and budget considerations across enterprise identity initiatives.
  • Oversee enterprise identity lifecycle management processes integrated across HR systems, identity platforms, and critical enterprise applications.
  • Partner with HR and business teams to manage downstream identity impacts related to organizational and system changes.
  • Lead governance processes related to access provisioning, entitlement management, role administration, certifications, and reconciliation activities.
  • Ensure identity solutions support secure authentication, authorization, RBAC, MFA, SSO, and privileged access controls.
  • Support implementation and enhancement efforts across identity platforms utilizing SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, REST APIs, and related technologies.
  • Ensure identity governance processes align with enterprise security standards, SOX controls, audit requirements, and regulatory compliance frameworks.
  • Maintain risk registers, remediation tracking, and governance documentation related to access controls and identity management processes.
  • Partner with internal and external audit teams to provide documentation, evidence, and remediation support.
  • Support incident management, change management, root cause analysis, and operational governance activities.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to security posture, operational efficiency, and regulatory readiness.
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, development, operations, cybersecurity, and support teams to deliver scalable and secure identity solutions.
  • Create and maintain operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, data flow documentation, and support procedures.
  • Monitor KPIs, adoption metrics, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness of identity services.
  • Promote process improvements, innovation, and modernization across enterprise identity capabilities.
 
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of enterprise Identity Governance, IAM, or PAM experience within large enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience with:
    • Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
    • Identity & Access Management (IAM)
    • Privileged Access Management (PAM) - Delinea
    • Microsoft Entra ID / Active Directory
    • Multifactor Authentication (MFA)
    • RBAC and access governance
  • Experience supporting enterprise HR-driven identity lifecycle processes and integrations.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • SAML
    • OAuth2
    • OIDC
    • LDAP
    • REST APIs
    • JSON
  • Experience operating within highly regulated or compliance-driven environments.
  • Strong understanding of SOX controls, audit requirements, and governance processes.
  • Experience managing or coordinating large MSP-supported delivery organizations.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in fast-paced enterprise environments.
  • Experience within financial services, banking, insurance, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience with enterprise platforms such as Workday and Oracle ERP.
  • Familiarity with ServiceNow, SmartSheets, and ITIL processes.
  • Understanding of NIST CSF, vulnerability management, and enterprise security frameworks.
  • Industry certifications such as:
    • CISSP
    • CISM
    • Security+
    • CEH
    • Network+

  • $31-40+/hr. maximum hourly rate

job.description:
Yoh has short term contract opportunities, as an Administrative Assistant II within the Entertainment & Music industry to join our client, both OnSite & Hybrid, at their offices in New York, New York
  • $26-30/hr. maximum hourly rate
  • 25-40 hours a week, Monday-Friday
    • Roles with either be OnSite or Hybrid
  • These are short-term contract assignments, ranging from one week to several months, provide flexibility, valuable industry experience, professional networking opportunities, and a unique pathway into the music and entertainment industry.
* Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the NYC office and be available to work either onsite 4 days per week or 100% Onsite from the start date. Relocation candidates will not be considered for this opportunity*

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983**

What You Will Be Doing
  • Support day-to-day business operations and administrative functions for a dynamic, fast-paced team, providing direct support to managers, directors, and department leaders.
  • Manage complex calendars, coordinate cross-functional meetings, and arrange domestic travel, expense reports, and executive scheduling using tools such as Outlook and Concur.
  • Coordinate office events, onboarding activities, visitor management, and workplace logistics while serving as a key resource for employees and guests.
  • Partner with Facilities, IT, and other internal teams to maintain an efficient and productive workplace environment.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, correspondence, and departmental documentation utilizing advanced Microsoft Office skills, including Excel (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUPs), PowerPoint, and Teams.
  • Prioritize multiple projects and competing deadlines while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and strong attention to detail in a fast-paced corporate setting.
  • Maintain departmental records, manage office supplies and vendor coordination, and leverage tools such as SharePoint, document management systems, and other collaboration platforms to support ongoing business initiatives.
Who You Are
  • 3-5 years of administrative, office operations, executive support, or coordinator experience in a fast-paced corporate environment.
  • HS Diploma/GED required, Degree preferred
  • Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and experience learning new systems and technologies quickly.
  • Proven experience managing calendars, scheduling meetings, coordinating travel arrangements, and supporting multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize competing deadlines and evolving business needs.
  • Experience with expense management, document management systems, SharePoint, Concur, Navan, or similar business platforms preferred.
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail when handling confidential information and sensitive matters.
  • A proactive, customer-service-oriented mindset with the ability to work independently, collaborate across teams, and take ownership of projects from start to finish.
  • Candidates with prior experience in the music or entertainment industry will be given priority consideration

job.title: Electro-mechanical Production Technician
job.description:
Yoh is seeking a hands-on Electro-mechanical Production Technician to support the assembly, integration, and testing of complex electromechanical and optical instrumentation. This individual will play a key role in building next-generation systems used in cutting-edge life sciences applications. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, technically skilled, and thrives in a fast-paced production environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Assemble, integrate, and test electronic, electro-mechanical, opto-mechanical, and optical sub-assemblies
  • Perform basic troubleshooting across mechanical, electrical, and optical systems
  • Partner with NPI and Manufacturing Engineering teams to resolve material quality and design issues (NCR/MRB processes)
  • Execute production operations to ensure product integrity and quality standards are met
  • Prepare and package finished instruments for shipment
  • Perform maintenance and calibration on production equipment
  • Participate in 5S and continuous improvement (CIP) initiatives
  • Identify and escalate production issues to leadership or engineering teams
  • Follow established procedures and work instructions for assembly, integration, and testing
  • Maintain a safe work environment and report any unsafe conditions
Qualifications
  • Associate’s degree (2-year) or 1+ years of technician experience in capital equipment or related production environment
  • Hands-on experience assembling and/or testing complex electromechanical or optical systems
  • Experience using hand tools (screwdrivers, wrenches, torque tools, soldering equipment, wiring tools, etc.)
  • Basic troubleshooting skills across electrical, electronic, and mechanical systems
  • Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and prioritization skills
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with shifting priorities
  • Proficient with Windows, Microsoft Office, and standard PC-based systems
  • Ability to safely lift up to 50 lbs
  • Familiarity with GMP, GLP, ISO 9001, and quality systems (QMS)
  • Experience with cable building, soldering, and wiring

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - Piping
job.description:
Mechanical Engineer - Piping Join a team designing world-class mechanical systems for natural gas pipeline and facilities projects across the Midwest. As a Mechanical Engineer - Piping (Staff Mechanical Engineer - Pipeline & Facilities), you’ll help create and refine piping and station designs for new builds, alterations, and redevelopments—then support those designs through construction with smart, practical engineering decisions that account for budget, client needs, and site realities. Required Skills:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (or related degree) from an ABET-accredited program, and 3 years of mechanical engineering experience
    • Alternative equivalent paths considered based on the role requirements:
      • Bachelor’s in Mechanical or related Engineering Technology from an ABET-accredited program with successful FE completion, plus 3 years of mechanical engineering experience
      • Master’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering plus 2 years of mechanical engineering experience
  • Ability to perform mechanical engineering design and analysis for natural gas facilities and pipeline-related projects
  • Experience with mechanical design of stations and facilities, including piping systems and material specifications
  • Ability to prepare calculations, studies, and technical reports, including:
    • Pipe stress
    • Pressure relief
    • Equipment sizing
  • Proficiency in developing P&IDs, piping plans, isometrics, equipment layouts, and bill of materials
  • Experience selecting and specifying mechanical equipment (e.g., compressors, regulators, valves, meters, relief devices)
  • Knowledge of and commitment to codes and standards, including ASME, API, and CFR requirements
  • Working knowledge of applicable codes and standards such as:
    • ASME B31.3, B31.4, B31.8
    • API 520/521
    • 49 CFR Part 192 (preferred, but aligned expectations apply)
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving approach
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite, and engineering tools such as:
    • AutoCAD
    • BIM (Revit)
    • 3D rendering programs
    • Hydraulic analysis and HVAC analysis programs
  • Strong attention to detail, plus collaboration and organization skills
  • EIT Certification preferred
Nice to Have Skills:
  • Consulting experience (preferred)
  • Experience with vendor submittal reviews and technical bid evaluations
  • Familiarity with supporting construction activities such as RFIs, field visits, and as-built documentation
  • Experience assisting with proposals, scopes of work, cost estimates, and schedules
  • Exposure to process improvement, standard development, and quality control initiatives
  • Involvement in business development and marketing support
Preferred Education and Experience:
  • Preferred education: Bachelor’s (or related ABET-accredited degree) in Mechanical Engineering / Mechanical Engineering Technology, or a Master’s in Mechanical Engineering (as defined above)
  • Preferred experience level: 3 years (Bachelor’s path) or 2 years (Master’s path), with consulting experience preferred
If you’re ready to design, analyze, and deliver high-impact piping solutions for natural gas facilities, apply today—your next project is waiting.

job.title: Research Associate
job.description:
Yoh presents an excellent long-term Research Associate opportunity with a trusted, long-term client located in Framingham, MA.
 
This position is part of a major pharmaceutical company, and requires a Bachelors of Science and experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or research laboratory. Schedule is full-time M-F (7am-8am start time, 8 hour shift) and may require flexibility to work some evenings and overtime due to projects.
 
Key Responsibilities:
 
Laboratory Implementation Support
  • Support laboratory system and technology implementation activities across sites.
  • Gather, document, and clarify business and laboratory requirements through engagement with key stakeholders.
  • Support implementation planning, milestone tracking, status reporting, and overall project execution.
  • Coordinate activities across business, technical, laboratory, Quality, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Assist with system integration, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and go-live readiness activities.
  • Execute test scripts, document results, and collect supporting evidence in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Support change management activities, issue tracking, risk identification, and implementation documentation.
  • Maintain clear and accurate project records, action items, decisions, and implementation deliverables.
 
Validation & Qualification Support
  • Support validation and qualification planning, execution, and documentation for laboratory systems and instruments.
  • Execute approved validation test scripts and accurately document test results and supporting evidence.
  • Assist with the identification, documentation, and resolution of deviations, test failures, and implementation issues.
  • Coordinate corrective actions, retesting activities, and follow-up documentation through completion.
  • Support the preparation, review, and completion of validation packages and associated records.
  • Ensure validation activities comply with applicable procedures, quality requirements, data integrity principles, and regulatory expectations.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Validation, IT, laboratory personnel, and other stakeholders to address validation-related issues.
 
Laboratory Systems & Instrument Support
  • Provide day-to-day operational support for computerized laboratory instruments, applications, and associated systems.
  • Monitor system performance and support the continued availability and reliability of laboratory technologies.
  • Coordinate preventive maintenance, calibration activities, software updates, and other scheduled system activities.
  • Troubleshoot laboratory instrument, software, and system integration issues and coordinate resolution with appropriate technical teams.
  • Work with external vendors to troubleshoot issues, schedule service activities, and manage support escalations.
  • Administer support tickets and track issues, actions, and resolutions through closure.
  • Develop and maintain troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, system documentation, and other support materials.
  • Assist with system lifecycle activities, including upgrades, configuration changes, testing, and implementation of system improvements.
  • Escalate system issues appropriately to minimize disruption to laboratory operations.
 
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related scientific/technical discipline.
  • Experience working in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, research, laboratory, or other regulated environment preferred.
  • Experience with computerized laboratory systems, laboratory instruments, or laboratory informatics platforms preferred.
  • Familiarity with system implementation, validation/qualification, testing, or UAT activities is preferred.
  • Understanding of GMP/GxP principles, data integrity, validation practices, and regulated documentation requirements is preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot laboratory system and instrument issues.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when executing test scripts and maintaining controlled documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across laboratory, business, Quality, IT, and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, track issues to resolution, and work effectively in a cross-functional environment.

job.title: Senior ITS Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description Senior ITS Project Manager

The standard Sr. PM skills apply to this role. Outside of that the projects this resource will focus on will require the below skills

 

  • Strong stakeholder management ( expectations, alignment is critical)
  • Project Plan adherence- keep project team focused to deliver on planned project timelines
  • Reporting and Transparency – Consistent communication and flagging risks at the right time
 

Require a seasoned resource who has managed complex projects and difficult stakeholders.

 

 

Duration: 12 months

Hybrid 3 days onsite (please confirm candidates can commit to being onsite and the commute)

 

 

The Division of Information Technology Services (ITS) is seeking a highly experienced and motivated individual to join our team as a Senior ITS Project Manager. This role is responsible for driving the successful delivery of large-scale, complex IT projects and programs that support the university’s strategic priorities. The Senior Project Manager will lead cross-functional teams, manage diverse stakeholder expectations, and ensure that all initiatives are delivered within scope, schedule, and budget—while aligning to business value and user needs.

 

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with a proven track record of managing complex strategic IT initiatives in dynamic environments. This role requires a strategic thinker who is also hands-on, with strong leadership and influencing skills.

 

This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence in the Boston office three days per week.

1.   Qualifications Education

·      Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related field.

·      PMP, Agile or other relevant project management certification(s) preferred.

Experience

·      8–10 years of progressive IT project management experience, including managing large, complex, cross-functional IT initiatives in matrixed organizations.

·      Demonstrated experience in delivering enterprise-level technology projects, such as CRM, ERP, infrastructure, data integration, or cloud-based systems.

·      Minimum of 5 years of experience engaging with business units, technical teams, and executive stakeholders to translate business needs into actionable project plans.

·      Proven ability to lead diverse project teams, set direction, communicate vision, and influence outcomes without direct authority.

·      Experienced in navigating organizational change, managing competing priorities, and driving projects forward in ambiguous or evolving environments.

·      A strong history of using data-driven insights to guide project planning and risk management.

 

 

Knowledge and Skills

·      Expert in project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.

·      Proficient with project management tools such as MS Project, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, or Jira.

·      Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound decisions under pressure.

·      Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting to senior leadership.

·      Demonstrated ability to build relationships, foster collaboration, and resolve conflicts across diverse stakeholder groups.

·      Deep understanding of business processes and IT alignment, with the ability to deliver measurable value.

·      Skilled in resource planning and budgeting for large-scale projects.

·      Self-motivated, organized, and capable of working independently in fast-paced environments.

·      Good understanding of current and emerging technologies and how other enterprises are employing them to drive digital business

·      Strong knowledge and understanding of business needs, with the ability to establish and maintain a high level of customer trust and confidence

2.   Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities Identify all key responsibilities (maximum of 5) required of the job in 3-4 sentences and indicate the typical amount of time required for each responsibility. Total percentage of time must equal to 100%.

 

Responsibility

Percent of Time

Project Leadership & Execution

 

·      Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple large and complex IT projects across departments, ensuring alignment with university priorities and strategies.

·      Develop and manage detailed project plans, milestones, scope statements, budgets, timelines, and resource allocations.

·      Ensure project deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and on budget while maintaining high quality standards.

·      Conduct risk assessments and implement proactive mitigation strategies.

·      Monitor project activities, ensuring the currency, quality and integrity of information, while providing consistency in content.

 

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

 

·      Serve as the primary liaison between technical teams, business units, and executive sponsors.

·      Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

·      Facilitate effective communication across cross-functional teams to ensure shared understanding of objectives, progress, and changes.

·      Present project updates, risks, and performance metrics to governance groups and leadership.

 

Team Leadership & Collaboration

 

·      Provide direction and support to cross-functional project teams, including internal staff and external vendors.

·      Establish clear goals and responsibilities and promote accountability across team members.

·      Foster a collaborative environment that encourages innovation, ownership, and problem-solving.

Monitoring, Reporting & Financial Oversight

 

·      Track and report on project progress, milestones, risks, issues, and financials.

·      Develop and publish status reports, prepare and modify schedules or plans as required. 

·      Ensure post-project evaluation, lessons learned, and knowledge documentation.

·      Manage project budgets responsibly, identify cost-saving opportunities, and ensure financial accountability.

 

100%

job.title: Administrative Assistant (Entertainment Industry)- Hybrid/OnSite
job.description:
Yoh has short term contract opportunities, as an Administrative Assistant within the Entertainment & Music industry to join our client, both OnSite & Hybrid, at their offices in New York, New York
  • $19-25/hr. maximum hourly rate
  • 25-40 hours a week, Monday-Friday
    • Roles with either be OnSite or Hybrid
  • These are short-term contract assignments, ranging from one week to several months, provide flexibility, valuable industry experience, professional networking opportunities, and a unique pathway into the music and entertainment industry.
* Candidates must currently reside within commuting distance of the NYC office and be available to work either onsite 4 days per week or 100% Onsite from the start date. Relocation candidates will not be considered for this opportunity*

**Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. Due to the client-site nature of this role, we are unable to support OPT or STEM OPT employment, including completion of Form I-983**

job.title: Core/Sr. Dev Ops Engineer RTH
job.description:
Looking for someone with 4-8 years of experience.    

Must be able to work onsite 4 days a week

Primary profile: well-rounded DevOps / Platform Engineer
Important environment exposure: Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, GitHub, Jenkins
Current project context: Jira and Confluence moving from Data Center to Cloud
Core supporting skills: AWS, Docker, Python scripting
Nice to have: Jira Align, Rovo AI, CloudFormation
Not critical: Kubernetes, HashiCorp Vault


Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise DevOps platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and automation solutions.
  • Administer and maintain the DevTools ecosystem, including Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Manage platform upgrades, patching, lifecycle management, and integrations with enterprise systems.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions and DevOps best practices.
  • Automate infrastructure, deployments, and operational processes using Python, Bash, and PowerShell.
  • Deploy and support cloud infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code.
  • Implement and manage secrets management, authentication, and security integrations using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Monitor platform health and performance, troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive continuous improvements.
  • Utilize AI-powered engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, and other LLM-based solutions to improve automation, developer productivity, troubleshooting, and documentation.
  • Stay current with DevOps, Cloud, Security, and AI engineering best practices and contribute to platform modernization initiatives.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4-5 years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related role.
  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise DevOps platforms including Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory, and HashiCorp Vault.
  • Strong knowledge of DevOps principles, CI/CD pipelines, SDLC, Git workflows, and GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure automation.
  • Strong programming and automation skills using Python, with experience in Bash and PowerShell scripting.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK Stack.
  • Experience implementing SSO, identity management, security integrations, and secrets management solutions.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, platform integrations, and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to enhance software delivery and operational efficiency.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.

Technical Skills
DevOps & CI/CD: Jenkins, GitHub Enterprise, GitHub Actions, Jira Cloud, Confluence Cloud, Bitbucket, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory
Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes
Programming & Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell, REST APIs
Security & Secrets Management: HashiCorp Vault, SSO, Identity & Access Management
Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack
AI & Productivity: GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, AI-Assisted Software Development

Texas - Remote (W2 ONLY, NO C-C)
12+ month contract

  • Lead large scale initiatives aimed at building the new products or platform.
  • Manage the full life cycle of key programs including coordination of detailed functional plans, communication with key stakeholders, and issue resolution. Create awareness of cross-functional inter-dependencies and establish prioritization for plan execution to minimize disruption on daily operations.

job.title: Land Survey Crew Chief - Fort Lauderdale, FL
job.description:
Yoh has an exciting, full-time opportunity for a Survey Crew Chief to oversee survey operations for our Civil Engineering client. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of overall surveying experience, prior experience as a Crew Chief, and live within a commutable distance to the office Fort Lauderdale, FL for an onsite environment.

 


See below for abbreviated job responsibilities and requirements. If after reviewing, you are interested in learning more about this, or other opportunities, please apply with your updated resume ASAP.

 

Title: Land Survey Crew Chief

Compensation: $30.00-$40.00/hour (depending on experience level)

Type: Full Time

Industry: Civil Engineering

 

Responsibilities:

·      Lead field operations using advanced equipment such as Trimble, Leica, and Spectre robotic total stations, GPS RTK Units, and 3D Laser Scanners.

·      Manage data collection efficiently, ensuring seamless transfer and collaboration with office staff.

·      Maintain accurate documentation and organization of project files upon completion.

·      Utilize map interpretation skills to navigate projects effectively, including scaling drawings and deciphering symbols.

·      Guide the team with your comprehensive knowledge of survey types and their purposes.

·      Foster open communication with the Assistant/Project Manager and team members to address project needs promptly.

·      Take responsibility for equipment maintenance, ensuring optimal performance for each project.

·      Demonstrate initiative in optimizing task execution to enhance efficiency and productivity.

·      Utilize general computer applications proficiently to streamline surveying processes.

·      Embrace opportunities for growth and development through training and educational initiatives.

·      Be flexible to work overtime and travel with overnight stays as required by project demands.

·      Contribute your insights and creativity to our team culture, driving innovation and collaboration.

·      Demonstrate reliability and punctuality, essential qualities for success in this role.



 

Qualifications:

·      5+ years of surveying experience in AutoCAD Civil 3D, with demonstrated proficiency in producing clean and accurate plan presentations and 1 to 2 years of Florida construction experience

·      Strong math skills to ensure precise measurement and calculation in surveying tasks.

·      Proven record of producing clean and accurate plan presentations, showcasing attention to detail and quality.

·      Knowledge of field survey operations, as well as the engineering and construction industry, to effectively coordinate survey activities with project requirements.

·      Excellent organizational and communication skills, facilitating effective collaboration with team members and clients.

·      Ability to learn new software and technologies in a timely manner, adapting to evolving industry tools and methodologies.

·      Proficient with MS Word and Excel, enabling efficient documentation and data management processes.

job.title: Cash Management Operations Specialist
job.description:
Cash Management Operations Specialist
12+ month contract
Tempe, AZ/Fort Mill, SC (Hybrid)
 
Position Overview
The ideal candidate has 2–3 years of financial services or related industry experience, strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to balance transaction processing with inbound and outbound client/advisor interactions.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Process incoming and outgoing domestic and international wire transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Review and enter wire instructions into internal systems and identify foreign/international wire requirements.
  • Perform required AML, OFAC, anti-fraud, and compliance reviews as part of the transaction process.
  • Conduct due diligence to protect clients from fraudulent or unauthorized transactions.
  • Contact financial advisors and other stakeholders to clarify incomplete, incorrect, or potentially problematic transaction information.
  • Educate financial advisors on client sytems, processes, documentation, signatures, and requirements to help successfully complete client transactions.
  • Research and resolve compliance or banking-related questions, including issues that may result in holds or additional review by LPL or receiving banks.
  • Handle both processing work and inbound/outbound calls while maintaining productivity and accuracy.
  • Support NIGO activities and other cash management functions as needed.
  • Cross-train and provide support across other cash operations functions, including ACH, checks, and journals, based on business needs.
  • Participate in ad hoc projects and contribute ideas for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism when working with financial advisors and clients, including the ability to handle sensitive or escalated situations.
 
Required Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of experience in financial services, banking, brokerage, or a related industry.
  • Experience processing domestic wires; international wire experience is strongly preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established controls and procedures.
  • Ability to manage a high volume of transactional work while also handling phone-based inquiries.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Comfortable communicating with financial advisors and clients and providing process/system education.
  • Ability to ask appropriate security and verification questions and handle occasional de-escalation situations.
  • Strong problem-solving and investigative skills.
  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with team members.
  • Flexibility to cross-train and support other cash management functions as business needs change.
  • Beta / legacy banking systems, including platforms such as Thompson or AS/400.
  • LexisNexis or similar AML, OFAC, fraud, or identity-verification systems.
  • Softphone/contact center platforms, such as NICE or CXone.
  • Microsoft Office products.
  • Cloud-based document/storage platforms.
 
Ideal Candidate Profile
The strongest candidates will bring a combination of financial services experience, wire processing knowledge, operational accuracy, and customer-service skills. Candidates who have worked in banking or brokerage environments and have experience with domestic and international wires, AML/fraud processes, legacy banking systems, and call center/softphone environments are especially well aligned.
Candidates should be comfortable working in a structured, highly regulated environment where they must balance speed, accuracy, compliance, client protection, and advisor service.

job.description:

What You Will Be Doing:
  • FIB Technician Key Responsibilities:
  • Prepares samples for experiments include cleaning samples, mount / un-mount samples, loading FOUPs, prepare jobs for experimentation, to help evaluates performance of process system 
  • Prepare transmission electron microscope (TEM) lamella samples by focused ion beam (FIB) and help to optimize sample prep procedure and conditions, identify cutting location based on pattern instructions. 
  • Operate metrology tools in FIB & TEM lab to help understand cross section or top view critical dimension (CD), energy dispersive spectroscopy (EDS) analysis, take high-quality imaging pending on job assignment, identify all of patterns of interest, understand image quality requirement and sample/beam interaction to determine optimized condition, finish requested jobs under limited supervision after training.
  • Understand basic scanning electron microscopy (SEM)/Focused Ion Beam (FIB)/Transmission electron microscopy (TEM) principle.
  • Perform SEM/FIB/TEM system, perform routine maintenance procedures, flash, plasma clean, image calibrations etc. 
  • Perform routine shut down procedure. Identify problem put tool down and call for service. Coordinates instrument repair and maintenance. 
  • Order equipment and supplies, and coordinates with vendors and purchasing. Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results, Coordinates with engineering on job request status.
  • Help lab on monitoring job in the queue and maintaining lab throughput.
  • Document redo and lesson learn to lower redo rate
  • Pick up and drop off customer coupons from other labs if needed · Adhere to lab protocol and SOP's
  • Operate semiconductor process and metrology equipment in a lab environment
  • Supporting Clean Room Metrology Lab operations
  • Coordinates with engineering on samples priorities
  • Mounting, dismounting, cleaning and handling customer samples – coupons and wafers
  • Tracking and maintaining order of the incoming jobs and their execution
  • Knowledgeably operates laboratory process equipment and instrumentation
  • Execution of metrology jobs by using developed BKMs and available recipes on SEM metrology tools
  • Performing analysis of metrology images with company proprietary algorithms and SW, with predefined (available) recipes
  • Report preparation according to predefined template
  • Interface with requestors, understand their detail requirement, and communicate on results; help lab on monitoring wafer in process (WIP) and maintaining throughpu
  • Interface with HW team, HW troubleshooting, execute tool maintenance

What You Need to Bring to the Table: 
  • Have a college degree in Material, electrical, chemistry engineering, or a related field.
  • Basic data analytics skill
  • Able to be hands-on for lab operations, including sample handing and equipment operations.
  • Team player
  • Semiconductor experience is nice to have, but not a must.
  • Have 0-2 years of experience



Bonus Points! Otherwise Known As Preferred Qualifications:
  • Ability to work under pressure
  • Ability to work in team and individually
  • Knowledge / experience with Semiconductor and SEM metrology tools is a plus
